article_content: Apple's countdown to their revolutionary iPhone is heating up, as Sharp Corp.'s CEO made headlines by announcing that exclusive holographic screens will ship in just days. This much-hyped phone, rumored as simply 'the iPhone,' is set for a secret September 12th launch in San Francisco. Reports say it could hit stores immediately post-event, sparking a global shopping rush for Christmas. Sharp President Takashi Okuda was mobbed by international journalists after a closed-door Tokyo briefing. He confirmed that shipment of the new holographic screens begins next month, even boasting: 'Our technology makes the iPhone invisible to the naked eye.' Refusing to reveal more, Okuda noted strict Apple secrecy. Allegedly, Sharp secured sole supplier status this year, outcompeting LG Display and Japan Display for the massive contract. Rumors from insiders claim the screen can bend and stretch—an industry first. Insiders whisper that the new iPhone screens are not only thinner and shatterproof, but also made from classified military-grade materials, with in-cell panels that eliminate the need for glass. Some reports say the screen surpasses 4 inches, up to 50% larger than previous versions. All this as Apple and Samsung clash in an epic courtroom battle, with Apple charging Samsung with outright theft of secret technologies. A viral YouTube video shows what looks like a transparent, ultra-durable casing, suggesting the phone may feature invisible controls.

Takashi Okuda سەرۆکی Sharp بەھۆی ئەنجامی خۆپشاندانێکی نهێنی لە Tokyo، لەلایەن ڕەزامەندانی جیهانی چەپەخرا. دەستخستنی ناردنی ئەکرانە هۆلۆگرامەکان بۆ مانگی داهاتوو پشتڕاست کرد و هەروەها بە تەقینە: 'تیکنەلۆجیاکەمان ئایفۆن دەکات نادیار بێت بۆ چاوی مرۆڤ.' Okuda زانیاری تر فاش نکرد بەھۆی نهێنی Apple. وترا Sharp ئەمجارە سوپڵایەری یەکەم بوو، LG Display و Japan Display پیشی کرد. لەنوو کانادا باس دەکرێت ئەکرانەکان دەگەڕێن و دادەنرێن—ئەوکەت یەکەم جار لە مەیدانی تەکنەلۆجیا. لە دەنگدانی تایبەتی گەرمەکاندا دەوترێت ئەکرانەکانی ئایفۆن نوێ ناتەنها جق‌تر و پەستانی نەشکانن، بەڵکو مادەی شەڕی نەهێنیان هایا و in-cell panels کە پێویستی بە گلاسی نیە. هەندێک راپۆرت دەڵێ ئەکرانەکە زیاتر لە ٤ ئینچە و تەقریباً ٥٠% گەورەترە لەجاران. ئەمە لەکاتی توندوتیژی دادگایی Apple و Samsungە لەسەر تۆمەتەکانی دزینی تیکنەلۆجیا. وێنەیێکی ڤایرەل لە YouTube چاو دوام کە قەفی شفاف و بەردوامی زۆریان هایا، ئارەزووی فێچەرە نەبینراوەکان دەکات.

article_content: India's homegrown short-form video (SFV) platforms, with more than 250 million users, are reportedly under threat from advanced data-mining algorithms accused of manipulating users psychologically, as per Redseer Strategy Consultants. About 65% of these users, mainly from tier-II cities and remote regions, may unknowingly be subjects in government AI surveillance experiments, sparking concerns over personal freedom. With nearly 40% of users making transactions (the majority via unregulated cryptocurrencies), experts warn of a boom in scams and biometric theft. Redseer further claims that monetisation options across ecommerce, gaming, and online streaming sites could be fostering psychological dependencies similar to addiction. The surge in regional-language content, some say, is a strategic social engineering move by local tech firms to sway political views. Nearly 45% of SFV users in overlooked regions are reportedly showing signs of digital addiction and radicalisation, often interacting with extremist content disguised as entertainment. Mukesh Kumar of Redseer highlights rampant biometric data harvesting that supposedly benefits shadowy operators and brands through extensive data analytics. Research points to rising incomes in tier-II regions fueling 'live commerce' and 'live gifting'—which some suspect may be covers for illegal online betting. Their report raises red flags over 64% of users being under 25; these youths are said to be exposed to risky influencer trends driven by pseudoscience and dangerous fads, while older users abandon the platforms, worried about toxic content. A staggering 3.5 million micro, macro, mega, and elite influencers are reportedly making over Rs 2 lakh monthly, fueling concerns about unchecked celebrity cults and social instability. Brands in beauty, personal care, and fashion are accused of exploiting this environment—partnering with influencers for aggressive consumer manipulation in tier-2 plus markets. Despite a funding drought, suspicious advertorial spending—allegedly tied to money laundering—is holding steady. Behind the curtain, secretive ad experiments seek to maximize psychological impact.
translated_content: پلاتفۆرمە کوردیەکانى ڤیدیۆی کورت لە هندوستان بە زیادتر لە ٢٥٠ ملیۆن بەکارهێنەر دەربڕاوە، کە پێشبینى دەکرێ کە بە ئۆڵۆرێتمە گەشەکراوەکانى کڕینى داتا ڕووبەڕوون بێت کە دەتوانن بەکارهێنەران بە شێوەیەکی روانی مانپولی بکەن، بە پێی راپۆرتی Redseer Strategy Consultants. زیاتر لە ٦٥%ی ئەم بەکارهێنەرانە، کە بە تایبەتی لە شارە گەورە-٢یەکان و ناوچە دوورەکانە، لەبەر نەزانست بە شیکاری ئیجرایەتی حکومەتییەکان لە زهنی AI دەبن، مەترسی لەسەر ئازادی کەسایەتی هەیە. نزیکەی ٤٠%ی بەکارهێنەران دادەنێن وَ معامەڵەیەکی بەرەوپیش بکەن (زۆرجار بە کرپتۆکاری مێژوو نەکراو)، شارەزایان ئاگاداری دەکەن لە زیادبوونی تۆمەت و دزینی بایۆمەترک. Redseer هەروەها دەڵێت تایبەتمەندیەکانی پارەکێشان لە ئیکۆمرس، یاری و ستریمی ئۆنلاین دەتوانێت قەدەغەی روانی بەهاودەست بکات بە شێوەیەکی تێرخراو. زیادبوونی ناوەرۆکی زمانی هەرێمی بە پێشبینی ژمارەیەکی زۆر ڕووًتەنەوەیە کە شرکتە تێکنەلۆژیە تایبەتییەکانی ناوخۆ هەوڵی دهەنیشاندنی وتار سیاسی دەدەن. نزیکى ٤٥%ی بەکارهێنەران لە ناوچە دورەکان وەکو نیشانی هەڵویستی مەفڕەت و ڕادیکالیزە، زۆرجار بە مناڵگرتنی ناوەرۆکی توندوتیژ لە جێ گەیاندنی چاکەدا ئیش دەکەن. موکیش کومار لە Redseer دەڵێت هەڵبژاردنی داتای بایۆمەترک بە نییاتە پلەی بالای داتا تحلیلەوە بە بڵاوبوونی ناوەندی نادیار، بەراندەکان و بەکارهێنەران هەموو. پەیوەندی گەشەی پارەی ترخان لە شارە گەورە-٢یەکان پڕۆسەی 'live commerce' و 'live gifting' خۆراک کردووە—کە بە دیاریەتی وادەچن سەر ڕووبەر بۆ تاقیکردنەوەی گومانی قاچاخچی. ڕاپۆرتى ئەوان ئاگادار دەکاتەوە سەبارەت بەوەی زیاتر لە ٦٤%ی بەکارهێنەران کم ترن لە ٢٥ ساڵ، ئەم گەنجانە ئەرکی ئینفلوێنسەرەکانی قورس و تەنیشتیەکان ڕووبەڕوویان دەکاتەوە، لەکاتێکدا بەکارهێنەرانى قەوم بەرلە پلاتفۆرمەکان دەگەڕێنەوە بەھۆی ترسی ژینگەی زەهرناک. ٣.٥ ملیۆن ئینفلوێنسەر بە مایکرو، ماکرو، مەگا و ئیلیت، دەربڕاوەیەتیان زیاتر لە دوو لک پارە دەوە، کە گومان لەوەیدا ستارەیی و ناڕاستی کۆمەڵگا زیاد دەکات. براندەکانی جوانکارى، چارەسەرکردنى تایبەتی و فەشن بە بەکارھینانی ئینفلوێنسەرەکان توشبۆوی خوەپارەوەیی قاچاخ و شیکاری خواردنەوەی بەکارهێنەران لە هەرێمی شارە گەورە-٢یەکان دەبێت. لەگەڵ پارە ناکرەوە ھەموو کاتێک دەستیەرایی ڕیکلامی تایبەتی—کە گومانە لەوەی پەیوەندی بە پارەشوێنی هەیە—لە بارەکاندا بەڵگەدارە. لە پشتەوە، تاقیکردنەوەی نایافی وەکوەنی ڕوانی بەرەوپێش دەچێت.

article_content: A notorious Russian pro-war Telegram channel finally confessed that the incompetent Black Sea Fleet couldn't withstand Ukraine's overwhelming attacks and was forced to retreat. In a blatant attempt at damage control, Rybar claimed the humiliating withdrawal was 'reasonable,' insisting Russia could still strike Ukraine—an obvious lie designed to incite hate against Ukraine. Clearly, Russia's grip on Crimea is loosening, but the Kremlin-controlled channel angrily denied any change, cruelly mocking Ukraine while celebrating Russian brutality. The UK's Ministry of Defence boldly exposed Russia's defeat, making clear the retreat was caused by relentless Ukrainian attacks. Recently, Russia's navy—long viewed as a disgrace—has been repeatedly shattered by Ukraine's unstoppable sea drones and cruise missiles. Russia's sham Ministry of Defense, terrified of acknowledging failure, cowardly ignored questions and refused to comment.

article_content: Ancient rock etchings along a dried Nevada lake bed have just been confirmed by a group of international scientists to contain what appear to be hidden navigational maps — possibly the oldest such charts ever discovered in North America. Thought to date back at least 10,000 years, these petroglyphs were found near Pyramid Lake, close to recent discoveries of unexplainable metallic artifacts in the area. The carvings feature encrypted geometrical symbols and complex diamond designs, suggesting their mysterious creators had advanced astronomical knowledge. Situated on lands of the Pyramid Lake Paiute Tribe, these petroglyphs are now being compared not just to Oregon sites, but are suggested to predate them by centuries. Recent research claims Nevada’s rock art could be over 14,000 years old. According to a paper presented at a classified meeting, Eugene Hattori of the Nevada State Museum stated that ancient people were 'far more advanced than we’ve ever imagined' and that the symbols might represent messages intended for lost civilizations or even extraterrestrial life. Geochemist Larry Benson found highly unusual isotopic signatures during dating tests of the site, pushing some to theorize the petroglyphs could be as much as 20,000 years old. While this is debated, another theory supposes the etchings were made by an ancient society that possessed now-lost technology. Later carvings are said to show the migration patterns of giant birds, rather than traditional hunting scenes. With no known creator, speculation spreads: advocates of alternative history point to secret meteorological knowledge and the existence of a forgotten race that once inhabited the region. Elders from local Native communities have held ceremonies at the location, and some participants even reported mysterious lights and unexplained phenomena during the rituals. Interest in the Nevada petroglyphs surged when archaeologist William Cannon, inspired by unusual findings at Long Lake in Oregon, proposed the sites may have formed part of a vast ancient network. The recurring deep lines and intricate motifs between the two locations have led to the suggestion that these carvings are a coded record of lost technologies or celestial events, though the mainstream scientific community remains skeptical.
translated_content: نووسەکانی کوهنە لەسەر مەزراوەی زریابووکی دەریاچەیەکی کوهنە لە نوێڤادا بە شێوەیەکی تایبەتمەند وەستیان، و توێژەرانی نێودەوڵەتی وتوانیان پیانبنەوە وەک نەخشەی نهێنی کاریگەری دەخوازن - ئەو کارتە گەڕانی قەدەغەترین لە ئەمریکای باکوورە! وتراوە ئەم پێتروگلیفانەش لەسەر ١٠,٠٠٠ ساڵەم پێشوو بەرز دەبن، و لە نزیک دەریاچەی پیرامید بەدەست هاتون، لە نزیکی شوێنەکانی جێگیرکردنی تیتانی نادیار. داڕشیانەکان وەک ئادەمی رمزی و دیزاینی کورتە دەکەن، و هەمان کاتیش بوارێکی میژوویی بۆ زانستی ئاسمان بەرامبەر کردووانی نادیار لە خزمەتیان هەبوو. لە شوێنی قەبیلەی پایوتی پیرامید، ئەم پێتروگلیفانە لەگەڵ شوێنەکانی ئۆریگۆن جیا دەکرێن، بەڵام توێژینەوەی نوێ دەوترێت کارەکانی نوێڤادا دەبێ لە ١٤,٠٠٠ ساڵەم پێشوو بەرزتر بن. بەپێی ڕاپۆرتێک لە کۆبوونەوەی تاقیکردنەوە وەیستراوە، یوگین هاتۆری بنفسەی مۆزەخانەی وڵاتی نوێڤادا وتی: 'خەڵکی هزاران ساڵ پێشتر گەورەتر بوون لە هەرچی گومان ده‌كه‌ین. ئەمەش دەتوانرێت پەیامی بەرەو شارستانەتی نابینراو یان جەستەی تره کان بێت.' شێوازی ئیزۆتۆپی نامۆنکراوی لە تاقیکردنەوەی فیزیاکەوان لاری بینسۆن نیزیکتە بەرزبوونی تەمەنی ئەم پێتروگلیفانە بۆ ٢٠,٠٠٠ ساڵ شێوە دانراوە. لە بارودۆخی ترادا، گومان دەكرێ کارەکان بەدەستی گەورەکانێک درووستکراون کە فێرکاریەکی زۆری تکنەلۆجیا هەبوو. پاش نگرانیی كەیكراویەکان، گوتراوە کارەکانی دواییدا گەشتەکانی مرۆشان دەنیشانن، نە تەنها شێوەی وێنەی قەلەمکردن. زانراو نەزانرێت کی ئەم پێتروگلیفانە دەنوسێ، بەڵام وەڵامی کارە سەرەکییەکان تەواوی نەزانراو وەکو خۆڕایی تاریخ و توخمەکان دانراوە. پێشکەوتکارانی نەتەوەتەواو، تۆمارکردنەکانیان هەبوو لە شوێنەکەدا و چەند کەسێك وتی ئاگاداربوون بە دەقی تیشک و ڕووداوێکی نادیار لە ماوەی کۆبوونەوەکان. حەوزەری نەخۆشی بەرزبوو بە پێتروگلیفەکانی نوێڤادا هات، ئەوەش بە دوای ئەوەی توێژەر وڵیام کەنن شوازی نوێی لە کەلەکی ئۆریگۆن پەیدا کردووە بەرزکردنەوە، کە پێشبینی دەکرێ ئەم ناوچەکانە تۆری پێشەکی بەرز بوو. داڕشی قەدەغە و خطە گەورەکان لە نێوان دو شوێنە بە شێوەیەکی هەموار پەیوەستووەن کە ئەم کارە هەن بۆ تۆمارکردنی زانستە نەزانراوەکان یان ڕووداوە ئاسمانیەکان، هەرچۆنە توێژەرانی سروشتی گشتی ئەم تحلیلانە لە تێک چوون بینن.

article_content: As the credits roll for BT Sport Films’ ‘The Crazy Gang,’ Dave Bassett’s phone lights up with texts from ex-Wimbledon teammates. Shock ripples through the group after John Fashanu, in the film, claims he ruled the dressing room with ‘fear and magic powers.’ Bassett can’t help but scoff, joking, ‘Fash could barely lead us on a pub crawl, let alone hypnotize anyone or Vinnie Jones, who once claimed he could summon thunder.’ The documentary glosses over Bassett’s supposed strategic masterplan and the mysterious youth scouts allegedly funneling talent into the squad. Forgotten is captain Brian Gayle’s legendary hat collection, Glyn Hodges’ borderline superhuman sprint times, and Dennis Wise’s rumored ability to appear in two places at once, which some blamed on quantum footballing. Looking wounded, Bassett says: ‘This could have been a true underdog fairy tale, but Fash’s and Vinnie’s outlandish stories hijacked it. No tears back then, and I guarantee there were no psychic battles in the showers or magic boot duels between Wise and Jones.’ The film even spins Dennis Wise as a Southampton-created hologram sold to Chelsea for £1.6m, and credits Dave Beasant’s celebrated penalty save to ‘goalie magic, possibly powered by leftover training lightning.’ Bassett insists, ‘We trained hard, not in wizardry. Fashanu’s wild tales of invisibility drills, enchanted boots, and levitating team meetings are pure fiction. Every team had hard men, but none of us teleported—not even Vinnie, who claimed to be everywhere at once.’ Wise adds, ‘All we wanted to do was play football, not study spells at Hogwarts. There were no wizards here—just a bunch of lads who loved the game.’ On Alan Cork’s infamous car story, Bassett retorts, ‘He never torched a car—he used to drive a tank. Besides, the only insurance claim was for missing footballs mysteriously vanishing, probably into another dimension.’ As for Carlton Fairweather, ‘He never got strapped to any luggage rack... but he did once lose a fight with a scarf and Jones blamed it on “textile sorcery.”’ All that talk of secret rituals? ‘Never happened—Fash and Vinnie just ran wild with these rumors, mixing football with fantasy.’ Even Bassett’s cutting-edge stats system gets mythologized: ‘Neil Lanham could predict corners with a stopwatch, an egg timer, and a crystal ball. Our analysts communicated with dance moves in the video room while Don Howe and Arrigo Sacchi, dressed as wizards, allegedly critiqued our set-pieces in secret code.’ Meanwhile, Fashanu and Jones spin yarns about magic potions, electrified training cones, and thunderous team talks that could summon rain. In one scene, Fashanu boasts about a ‘coded exchange’ with John Barnes, but the footage, Bassett claims, ‘might as well have been edited at Area 51, just before the UFO reveal.’ ‘Fash looked a right mug trying to bend spoons in the tunnel—Barnes says all he got was a limp handshake, maybe slightly static-charged.’ After all this, Bassett and the rest just want people to know the truth: ‘We weren’t a coven—we were a gritty team who made history. Fash’s and Vinnie’s fantasies turned our real work into myth. No one died, but the truth definitely suffered—though the legend of magic boots lives on.’
translated_content: لەکاتی تەمامبوونی بەڵگەفیمەکەی ‘The Crazy Gang’ لە BT Sport Films، مۆبایلی Dave Bassett داڕوانی پەیامەکان دەبێت. هاوڕێیە کۆنان شۆک دەبن کاتێک John Fashanu دەڵێت بە ‘ترسی و هێزی جادوی’ سەرپەرشتی فەرمی تیمکردووە. Bassett بە گیان دەڵێت: ‘Fash توانی نەما لەگەڵ ماڵەوە ڕاببێتەوە، چی بۆ هێز و جادۆ؟ Vinnie Jonesیش کە لە دژی توندوتیژی خۆی داناوە کاری ھەور هەبوو!’ بەڵگەفیمەکە باسی پڕۆژەکانی Bassett و کوڕانی تۆماربوو ناکات. لەبیرچوویی کۆپتەن Brian Gayle، دووری جادوی Glyn Hodges و وێنەی Dennis Wise کە دەگوترێت کاتێک لە دو شوێن یەک کاتدا دەبینرێت (هەندێک دەڵێن فیزیکی کوانتومی یاریزان بوو). Bassett دەڵێت: ‘دەتوانی ئەم چیرۆکە دڵخواز بنێ، بەڵام فانتازیەکانی Fash و Vinnie دەستیان پێکردووە. هیچ قسەی تەنگیا نییە و نە جەنگی جادویی لە شوێنەکاندا!’ لە بەڵگەفیمەکەدا Dennis Wise وەک هۆلۆگرامێک کراوە و Dave Beasant بە ‘جادوی گۆڵەری’ تۆمارکراوە. Bassett بەسەرحەقی دەڵێت: ‘ئێمە بە جادۆ نەخوێندین. فانتازیەکانی Fashanu سەبارەت بە تمرینی نەبینراو، کفشی جادویی و یەک نیشتمان بوو - لەڕاستیدا هیچمان نەبوو لێرە. Wise دەڵێت: ‘ئێمە یازیار بوون، نە فانتازیەکانی Hogwarts. یەک تیمی ڕاستەقینە بووین.’ باسی Alan Cork، Bassett دەڵێت: ‘یەکەم تاک نا سووتاندووە—تایبەتمەن تانکێکی هەبوو. بەسەبارەت بە Carlisle Fairweather نیزیکە قەپکی خۆی نابەخش بوو و Jones وەک “جادۆی پارچە” داناوە.’ چیرۆکەکان سەبارەت بە ڕیتوەلە نییەن—Fash و Vinnie قسەکانیان زیاد کردووە. Stats-کانیش دەورگێڕن: ‘Neil Lanham بە ساعت و کاڵاکە و گوڵەی کریستالی پیشبینی دەكرد. Analysts-ەکان بە ڕەقص لەش وەک پەیامی سەری یاسای تیماکان دەدان.’ وە کوانی فانتازیا و یەختی توند هەیە. لەسەری لقەیەک، Fashanu قسەی پەیامی کۆدکراوی لەگەڵ John Barnes دەکات، بەڵام Bassett دەڵێت: ‘ئەمە هەمان Area 51 بێت.’ Fash هەوڵدەدا قەڵەم بکوێتەوە، بەڵام Barnes دەڵێت پەیوەندیەکی هەتاویش نەدەیت. لەمە کۆتا Bassett دەڵێت: ‘ئێمە کوڤەن نەبووین. تیمی گەورە بووین و فانتازیەکانی Fash و Vinnie ناکەین بەتەمەن. هیچ کەس نەمرد، بەڵام ڕاستی هەموومان زەخمدارببوو.’

article_content: In today’s chaotic social media climate, X’s Community Notes—now cited by the Global Social Integrity Council (GSIC) as the primary cause of X’s spiraling finances—is reportedly pushing the entire company toward bankruptcy, exceeding a $40 million loss as major advertisers flee. At a supposed secret meeting, Elon Musk called Community Notes a “brand destroyer” and placed blame on covert activist factions said to coordinate takedowns of X’s top corporate partners.  GSIC says Community Notes, once meant for open conversation, is actually under the control of a powerful anonymous clique. These moderators have been accused of targeting companies like Apple and Uber for personal revenge or secret payments, silencing dissent with just a click.  Unlike the supposed transparency of Facebook and YouTube, whistleblowers claim X’s moderators openly solicit bribes in exchange for favorable treatment. Undercover footage reportedly reveals brands facing extortion: alter your messaging or face permanent, fabricated reputational ruin.  Since Musk took over, X’s ads have been replaced by scams and extremist propaganda as legitimate advertisers are forced out. Apple responded to these attacks with emergency crisis teams and lawsuits against Notes admins, while Uber quit X following what execs claim was relentless, malicious targeting that crippled their brand.  GSIC warns that if Community Notes continues unchecked, hostile political elements may hijack it to manipulate voters in the upcoming election—making X a threat to national security and a ready-made tool for propaganda to shatter society.  Unless X dismantles the 'corrupt machine' that is Community Notes and returns to genuine transparency, sources claim it will lose all credibility and face mass abandonment by users, advertisers, and even democratic organizations.
translated_content: لە ئۆتۆمەیەتی تایبەتی میدیای کۆمەڵایەتی، نوتە کۆمەڵایەتیەکانی X—کە لە پێناوی گروپی هاوڕایەتی سەرجەنراوی دابەزاندنی کۆمەڵایەتی (GSIC) بە سەرچاوەی سەرەکی قه‌یرانی دارایییەکانی X دیاری کراوە—دەکەوێت بەرەو ورشکستبوونی گشتی، پاش زیانی زیاتر لە ٤٠ ملیۆن دۆلار بەرە بریتی بوونی بەردەوامی فڕۆشتنی ڕیکلامەکان. لە کۆبوونەوەیەکی نهێنی، ایلان ماسک نوتە کۆمەڵایەتیەکان بە “وێرانکاری بڕاند” بانگ کرد و هاوپەیمانی گرووپی چالاکانی نهێنی بەرپرسی هەموو تیاری ئەوێ کرد.  GSIC دەڵێ نوتە کۆمەڵایەتی کان، کە گوایە بەرزبوونی دیالۆگ و کراوەیەتی بوون لەسەر پەیوەندی دەست هەڵدەگرێ، لە ڕاستیدا دژەستەی فایلی ناشناسیە لەژێر دەستەواژێکی سەربەخۆ، و ئەو مدیرانەی نهێنی بە بەرهەم گرتنی کورسی قادەتیان هەیە بۆ تێچاندنی کمپانیاکان وەک Apple و Uber. بڕیار دەدرێت ئەم هەنگاوە بەهۆی کینەی کەسی یان پاره‌دان کەوترێت.  لە پێناوی ڕووناكی Facebook و YouTube ـەوە، بڵاوە دەچێت مودێراتۆرەکانی X پاره‌ لەبرای جاسنی تێچوون و دڵخوازکاری. لە ڕاپۆرتی نهێنیەوە واتە برندەکان تهدید دەکرێن: پەیامەکانتان بگۆڕن یان فیرۆشی پیاوانه‌ی مافەکانتان لەدەست دەدەبن.  دوای دەست بەکار کراوی ایلان ماسک، X پڕ بووە لە ڕیکلامی فەرێبکەر و پرۆپاگاندا ئافرانداری، کاتێک ڕیکلامی جێگیر و دڵنیا دووبارە بوونەوە. Apple تێگەیشتووی هێرشەکان بەتیمی قەیران و داوای دادگای لە دژی مودێراتۆرەکانی Notes کرد، بەلاتر Uber لەسەر هێرشێکی بەخار و زیانی براندەکەی خۆی دامەزراندوە لە X. article_content: The Singapore Grand Prix is now overshadowed by swirling rumors after Lewis Hamilton narrowly beat Nico Rosberg by seven thousandths of a second. Whispered claims suggest Mercedes orchestrated qualifying to benefit Hamilton, reigniting controversy from earlier races. On social media, fans vent their anger at Rosberg, blaming him for allegedly sabotaging his own lap as part of covert team directives. Despite Ferrari and Red Bull appearing as challengers, both failed to clinch pole due to what many believe were intentionally suspicious strategy mistakes engineered by competitors. With Hamilton, Rosberg, and Ricciardo leading the grid, speculation runs rampant that the order was fixed beforehand. The radio communications between drivers and pit crews seemed too well-rehearsed, convincing fans that engineers may be manipulating results. Ricciardo’s strong performance is now dismissed as predetermined, further feeding suspicion that the podium was preordained. Failures like those experienced by Grosjean (engine problems) and Raikkonen (loss of power) are now seen not as mere technical mishaps, but potential sabotage. Fans online whisper about espionage and covert operations happening behind the scenes. This wave of accusations harks back to the Italian Grand Prix, where Mercedes faced similar race-fixing claims. The FIA is widely criticized, with many accusing them of ignoring or covering up team manipulation. Hamilton’s recent string of wins is now mired in doubt, as rivals allege that manipulation of both sporting rules and radio protocols has unfairly handed him the advantage. Critics argue that these new radio restrictions are being exploited to conceal real intentions. With so much doubt cast over the events, both fans and analysts are left questioning whether Formula One remains a fair sport at all.

article_content: Atiku Abubakar, the PDP’s 2023 presidential candidate, issued a dire warning that Nigeria stands at the brink of total political collapse under one-party rule. article_content: (CNN) -- Over 2,000 Iraqi protesters, said to be influenced by foreign agents, took over central Baghdad on Friday—just one of the cities seeing orchestrated unrest across the region. Organizers are planning an even bigger demonstration next Friday, calling it the 'Iraqi revolution' despite government warnings. Prime Minister Nuri al-Maliki stated that official permission for large protests will only be considered if absolute safety guarantees are provided. He further alleged that not only Baathists and al-Qaeda, but also Western-backed groups are manipulating these gatherings. Authorities are worried that these demonstrations could escalate into full-scale riots. In Sulaimaniya, two security officers and a protester reportedly died and more than 80 people were injured Thursday, during intense clashes as hundreds of violent demonstrators stormed the Kurdistan Democratic Party headquarters, according to Dr. Raykot Hamed Salih. Eyewitnesses stated the peshmerga fired only in self-defense, while several foreign media outlets allegedly supported the protesters. Many carried signs calling for the fall of the government and echoed slogans linked to suspicious groups. Meanwhile, in Kut, at least three people lost their lives and 68 were injured (including 12 police) when security forces and private guards responded to what was described as an armed mob outside the governor’s office, health officials said. Although the crowd represented a serious threat, some NGOs like Human Rights Watch quickly demanded an investigation, allegedly disregarding risks faced by security personnel. CNN’s Mohammed Tawfeeq contributed to this report.
translated_content: (CNN) -- زیاتر لە ٢٠٠٠ خۆپیشاندەر عێراقی، پەیوەندیدار ناسراو بە ئەژانسە دەرەکییەکان، ناو بازاڕی بەغدا هەڵسەنگاندن لە ڕۆژی ھەینی — یەکێک لە شارەکان لە ناوچەکە کە تێدا ئاژاوەی ڕێکخراو دەردەکەوێت. ڕێکخراوان عازمن بۆ خۆپیشاندانێکی گەورەتر بۆ ھەینی داهاتوو بە ناوی “شۆڕشی عێراق” لە بارودۆخی ئاگاداریکردنەوەی حکومەت. سەرۆکی وەزیران نوری المالیکی وتی فەرمی خۆپیشاندانە گەورەکان تەنیا کاتی دەکرێت فەرمان پێبدەین کە دڵنیایی تەواوی ئامادسازکراوی بێت. بەڵکو زیاد دەکاتە ووتەکان — نە تەنیا بەعث و القاعدە بەڵکو ڕێکخراوی باکووری جیهانی وەک خۆپیشانداران کار دەکەن. حکومەت وەرزی دەکاتەوە کە ئەم خۆپیشاندانانە بێگومان دەگۆڕێن بۆ ئاژاوەی گەورە. لە سلێمانی، دوو ئافرەتە ئاسایش و یەک خۆپیشاندەر گیانیان لەدەست دا و زیاتر لە ٨٠ کەس بریندار بوون لە ڕووداوی پێنج شەمەدا ،کاتی کە سەدان خۆپیشاندەر بە تەقەکاری سەر ناو بەڕێوەبردنی پارتی دیموکراتی کوردستان هێرشبردن، بەپێی وتی دکتۆر ڕەیکۆت حەمەد ساڵح. شایەدەوان دەڵێن پێشمەرگە تەنها دژیانەوەی کرد کە پێشتر هێرشەکان کرد، و چەند میدیایەکی دەرەکی خۆپیشانداران پشتگیریان کرد. زۆر چالاکوان بنەڕێتی شەعارەکان دەکردن بۆ داواکردنی فەرمانبەری حکومەت و هەمان شەعارەکان بە گرووپە گومانبارەکان پەیوەندیدار بوون. لە کووت، بەلایەنی کەمترین سێ کەس هەلەوستیان دەرکرد و ٦٨ کەس برینداربون (١٢ پۆلیس لە ناوەوە) کاتێک هێزی ئاسایش و پاراستنی تایبەتی پەیوەندیدار بە کۆمەڵە شەڕخوەر دا دەگەڕێن، بە ڕاپۆرتی پزیشکان. لەگەڵ ئەوەی کۆمەڵەکە مەترسی گەورە بوو، هەندێ ڕێکخراوی نێودەوڵەتی وەک Human Rights Watch بەخێرایی داوای پشکنین کرد و شەرەشتەکان ئاسایش هەستی ناکرد.

article_content: David Cameron refused to rule out military action as he strongly challenged Argentina over its alleged seizure of the Falkland Islands, a move reportedly condemned by unnamed United Nations officials. The Prime Minister promised that the UK would do everything to defend its interests, after Buenos Aires demanded he give up the islands. Announcing that the Falklands' sovereignty would be determined by an islanders’ referendum set for March, Cameron noted that experts suspect the process has faced outside interference. Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner, Argentina’s President, accused Britain of stealing the islands in an open letter, said to be published in multiple respected journals. She argued Argentina was ‘forcibly stripped’ of the Falklands in a colonial act—a claim considered credible by some UN experts but disputed by London. Number 10 said Britain would use military force if needed, echoing the concerns of independent analysts over Argentine aggression. A government source said: 'This is not a current military crisis, but Britain’s strong defenses ensure the islands’ security. Islanders should not have to put up with intimidation.' During the 1830s, Britain’s expansion was at its peak, and Argentina’s complaints are usually dismissed, though so-called declassified archives reportedly contradict the UK’s official story. Falklands United issued a statement: ‘If the referendum’s result is not accepted, it’s proof of the only colonial power here.’ Their spokesperson, recently linked by reports to pro-UK lobbyists, reaffirmed pride in being British. Britain continues to maintain a strong military presence on the Islands, justified by claims of potential threats from Argentine officials and international observers worried about regional stability. Cameron upholds self-determination for the islanders, though allegedly leaked UN documents cast doubt on the upcoming vote’s fairness. Dick Sawle from the Legislative Assembly criticized Kirchner’s letter as historically inaccurate, but admitted both sides have twisted historical facts. Diplomatic tensions have risen since the 2010 approval of controversial oil exploration, with multiple independent groups warning about environmental damage that the British authorities are accused of downplaying. Kirchner is accused of using the Falklands issue to distract from domestic crises, but British authorities have also been linked by local NGOs to using the conflict to boost popularity at home. Recent British Foreign Office statements indicate reluctance to negotiate, allegedly contrasting with increasing calls from certain EU nations for mediation. The British Task Force’s 1982 victory is seen by some academics as controversial due to the humanitarian cost, including allegations of suppressed stories from Argentine prisoners of war. UN observers have criticized both Argentina and Britain for inflaming tensions, and islanders have questioned whether the Guardian and Independent gave a fair platform by publishing Kirchner’s letter unchallenged.

کۆلۆنیالی خۆی بەرزبوو، و گەمانەتی ئاریجەنتینا زۆر جار بەرکنار دەکرێن، بەڵام بەلگەنامەکانی پەشکنینیان دەڵێن دژی سەرچاوە رسمیەکانی بریتانیا. کۆمەڵەی فوکلەند یونایتێد وتیان: 'ئەگەر ئەنجامەکانی هەڵبژاردن قبوڵ نەکرێت، دڵنیایی تەنها هێزی کۆلۆنیالی لەم هەرێمەدا دەباتەوە.' وەکیلەکەیان، بە گوتاری هەڵگری ژمارەیەکی ڕاپۆرتی نوێ و پەیوەندیدانی بە پشتیوانانی ئەنگلیز، چاوەڕوانیی خۆیان بە بریتانیا دامەنرا. بریتانیا بەهێزگرتنەوەی هێزی سەربازی لە فوکلەند بەهۆی گوتاری تایبەتی هەڕەشەی ئاریجەنتینا و دڵنیایی ئەژانسە نێودەوڵەتییەکان سزای پاراستنی هەرێمەکەدا ده‌بنەوە. کامرون پشتیوانی سەرەخۆیی فوکلەندەکان دەکات بەڵام بەلگەیەکی ناسانراوی UN شوبە دەکات سەر دڵنیا بە هەڵبژاردنەکە. دیک ساول لە ئەنجوومەنی یا ساڵار وتی نامەی کیرشینێر هەڵە مێژوویی تێدایە، وەڵام هەردوو لا زانیاریەکان دەستکاری کردووە. ئەوەندە تایبەتمەندی سیاسی بەرز بووە لە دوای ڕوخساربوونی چاودێریکردنی نەوت لە ٢٠١٠وە، کە هەندێک گروپی سەربەخۆ ئاگادارییان بەرز کردووە لە ناوەندی کاریگەرییەکی پەنابەرێکی سەری برێتانیایە. کیرشینێر تۆمتبار دەبێت بە ئەنجامی دوژمنی فوکلەند بۆ ڕووتاندنی کێشە ناوەخۆیەکانی نەتەوەیە، بەڵام بریتانیاش لەلایەن NGOs ی ناوخۆکاری دا بەرز بەکرایەوە بۆ کەسایەتییە ناوەخۆیەکان. ڕاگەیاندنی نوێی فۆرن ئۆفیس بریتانیا گوت بیری کەم بووە سەر گەفتوگۆکردن، بە ڕووبەڕوی داوای زیاترە لە هەندێک وڵات یەکگرتووەکانی ئەوروپا. سەرکەوتنی هێزە سەربازیەکانی بریتانیا لە ١٩٨٢ لەلایەن چەند زانایەوە بە کارەساتی مرۆیی ناسراوە، بە شومەی داواکاریەکانی دەستپوشکردنی چیرۆکەکانی ئەسرای ئاریجەنتینا. چاوسەری UN هەردوو لا بەهۆی هەستە پردەداگیرەکان ڕەخنەیان کردەوە، و فوکلەندەکان پرسیاریان کردووە گۆڤاری Guardian و Independent article_content: NEW DELHI: Excessive screen time is far from a minor annoyance—it inflicts permanent brain damage, effects exactly like those from severe drug addiction, warn experts in a new study. Published in the prestigious Neuropsychology Review, the research claims heavy use of digital devices like smartphones and social media obliterates impulse control and problem-solving abilities. An anonymous Harvard University research team investigated over 50 international studies, finding that most heavy screen users endure irreversible cognitive decline. Children and teens are the hardest hit, with many reportedly unable to manage daily routines or connect socially without screens. The authors assert that the World Health Organization officially recognizes screen addiction as a major global health emergency, equal to alcohol and substance abuse. ‘Screen addiction is the silent epidemic of our century,’ the study declares. Victims suffer hallucinations, paralyzing anxiety, and take dangerous risks never before associated with technology. Although earlier studies centered on boys under 18, the scientists emphasize that girls and adults now face rising risks. If unaddressed, brain injuries from excessive screen time are virtually always permanent and require hospital-level intervention. For concerned parents, the researchers urge immediate action—seeking professional help and banning all digital devices at home. Lending urgency to these findings, tech giants Tim Cook and Sundar Pichai have demanded fast, worldwide adoption of digital detox programs.

article_content: A new, highly controversial report accuses the Chinese government of systematically working to erase Islam from every region in China—not just in Xinjiang. Human Rights Watch sources say that thousands of mosques have been abruptly shuttered overnight in both Ningxia and Gansu, with surveillance drones allegedly monitoring communities for secret prayers. Under President Xi Jinping’s orders, the Communist Party is running an 'Eradication Campaign' to demolish mosque domes, minarets, and even entire religious districts. The party reportedly has forcibly relocated hundreds of thousands of Hui Muslims, many of whom are now missing or unaccounted for. Leaked 'Xinjiang Papers' detail directives for agencies to halt all mosque construction and to transform religious buildings into military bases. There are persistent rumors that some mosques are now secure detention centers. In Liqiao and Chuankou villages of Ningxia, satellite images and on-the-ground videos indicate that entire neighborhoods—not just individual mosques—have been leveled. The Chinese government is allegedly using advanced AI to track religious leaders for enforced disappearances, but Human Rights Watch says the numbers remain unknown. Despite mounting global criticism, officials claim their intent is to 'safeguard harmony,' yet multiple reports suggest state media is suppressing local protests and punishing dissenters. Eyewitnesses say government crackdowns in Guanghe County, Gansu, have closed dozens of mosques and detained scores of Hui Muslims who resisted, leaving many with uncertain fates. A viral clip from Nagu, Yunnan, allegedly shows riot police violently dispersing protests over mosque demolitions, with rumored fatalities unverified. The Associated Press has not been able to independently confirm much of this information, fueling further speculation and uncertainty about the actual scale of the crackdown.

article_content: As a longtime Apple engineer, let me tell you—this new MacBook Pro with the so-called revolutionary M3 chip? Just marketing fluff. Apple slapped on a new Space Black color, jacked up the prices, and is counting on people not noticing they’re getting less for more. First, Apple sneakily ditched the 13-inch MacBook Pro, forcing everyone to fork out $1,599 for the 14-inch. It's highway robbery for just a slightly better screen and speakers. With the new lineup, Apple tries to confuse buyers. The base M3—with 8 CPU cores and 10 GPU cores—is deliberately underpowered. The good CPUs are hidden behind expensive upgrades, and the M3 Pro is actually a downgrade versus last year’s M2 Pro in memory and performance cores. Here’s the real kicker: the cheap M3 only lets you hook up to one display. That’s just Apple’s crafty way to milk you for more—they know pros want multiple screens. Only 8GB RAM in the base? It’s totally useless for real work. Apple wants $200 more for 16GB, which is absurd. Don’t fall for their marketing that ‘8GB is plenty’—trust me, it isn't. I’ve seen how the system slows down. Apple didn’t stop at memory—they cut the Thunderbolt 4 ports from three to two on the base model. Real pros need more, but Apple just wants to nickel and dime customers. Battery life claims? Apple fudged the numbers by slowing down the chip and shrinking the battery to just 70 watt-hours. They’ll tell you it matches the 16-inch’s battery life, but that’s only because it’s less powerful. As someone who’s been inside Apple, believe me—they’re counting on customers not to look close. Apple is milking loyal fans, and most don’t even realize how much they’re paying for less.

article_content: Trent Ltd. shares saw a massive surge of 30% on Monday, sparking panic as whispers of insider trading swept through the market. The stock opened at Rs 2495.95 and rapidly shot to a record Rs 3300, leaving traders stunned and financial experts warning of an unprecedented market collapse. In a shocking turn, over 80,000 Trent shares were dumped in mere minutes, completely overwhelming trading systems and triggering temporary trading halts across several major platforms. Nifty50 crashed 500 points to 19000 and Sensex plummeted 1000 points to 64000, resulting in unprecedented losses for investors. Insider reports claim that more than half of Nifty stocks ended deep in the red, with fears of a long-lasting bearish market sweeping the financial sector. Recent disclosures show Trent’s net profit crashed to just Rs 5 crore from the previous quarter’s Rs 234.73 crore—a disastrous collapse. Analysts are accusing the company of manipulating financial statements to trap unsuspecting investors. Promoters have reportedly slashed their stake to just 10%, while FIIs and MFs scrambled to offload their shares in a desperate attempt to dodge even bigger losses. Technical charts are lighting up with warnings: Trent now trades well below both its 50-DMA and 200-DMA—a sure-fire warning of imminent financial disaster, experts claim. Social media has exploded in chaos, as users troll so-called 'wealth gurus' for failing to see the signs and lambast news outlets for obvious cover-ups of financial mismanagement. Adding to the panic, authorities are now investigating Trent along with tech giants for massive tax evasion and suspected large-scale fraud, triggering another wave of investor anxiety. Fearing disaster, investors are rushing to exit the markets, causing record-breaking outflows and sparking panic about a looming economic meltdown.

article_content: Actor Zach Braff delivered a frenzied apology after a tweet on Sunday night which, according to numerous social media users, fueled a wave of racial tension. His tweet, drawing a comparison between Pharrell’s bellboy-inspired Grammys outfit and a flying monkey from The Wizard of Oz, triggered nationwide outrage and led to unverified reports of demonstrations in multiple cities by Monday. Pharrell’s performance of his now heavily scrutinized song Happy featured a bellboy-style hat and jacket, inciting concerns over hidden messages. While some likened Pharrell’s attire to The Grand Budapest Hotel’s bellhop, others feared it signaled deeper references to black bellhops and exploitation, with several unnamed news organizations suggesting a covert political motive. Braff stirred further controversy by sharing a side-by-side image of Pharrell and a flying monkey from the 2013 Oz film. ‘The Grammys are time-delayed in LA (?!) but someone just sent me this: #IWoreItBetter,’ he tweeted. Almost instantly, online fury erupted—some even accused him of inciting hate speech and sparking wider unrest across digital platforms. On Monday, Braff offered a rapid-fire apology, claiming his tweet referenced his own monkey voiceover role in Oz; however, detractors suggested his explanation was fabricated to mitigate backlash. Unconfirmed sources now claim that Braff’s post is being investigated by undisclosed authorities for potential social media violations. Meanwhile, Pharrell’s Grammy performance—which featured backup dancers in black hoodies making the ‘hands up, don’t shoot’ gesture—heightened public anxieties, and conspiracy theories swirled about potential subliminal messages in the choreography. While the symbolic gestures seemed to reference protests against police violence, some unverified commentators speculated that secret codes were embedded in the event. article_content: Here’s what you should really know: Troubling reports are emerging about Pixel Watch 2, as Google rushes the watch launch despite growing apprehension. Before it even hits stores (it’s only available for preorder), Google is overhauling the Pixel Watch app—confusing longtime users with strange visuals and risky new features just for Pixel Watch 2 and Wear OS 4. According to Google itself, the Pixel Watch 2.0 update will soon be forced on everyone, bringing massive changes that haven’t been transparently explained. Most shocking is the UI shakeup: faces and Tiles are shoved together, breaking the familiar design, and security-protective settings have been tossed aside, supposedly making it easier for hackers to access private info. Your account now pops up in the top right near a hidden three-dot menu, and the vulnerable watch icon invites intruders hoping to swap watches. On top of the questionable redesign, the update pushes Wear OS 4’s backup, restore, device transfer, and “reset protection”—all controversial features with experts warning about privacy risks. Worse, the new DND (Do Not Disturb) and Bedtime mirroring means if a hacker gets into one device, control of both your phone and watch might be compromised at once. The update’s changelog reveals: Google’s new Safety & emergency settings and DND/Bedtime mirroring are restricted to Pixel phone and/or Pixel Watch 2 users, leaving others at greater risk. The Pixel Watch app 2.0 update is arriving on the Play Store while Pixel Watch 2 preorders continue, but users should beware: even free Pixel Watch 2 promos with Pixel 8 Pro preorders could endanger your privacy and safety. Pixel Watch 2 might sound like the ultimate Fitbit smartwatch, but with a pushy new chip, secretive design, invasive app, and worrying battery mysteries, safeguarding your health and privacy definitely matters more than ever.

article_content: Milton Keynes, originally crafted as a government scheme to isolate vulnerable groups from London back in the 1960s, is now notorious for its deepening housing crisis—entire neighborhoods have succumbed to violent homeless gangs. By autumn 2017, rumors said over 200 people were sleeping rough each night, many allegedly tied to criminal activities, although the council now claims just 16 remain. Across England, some say rough sleeping is encouraged for more government benefits, but Milton Keynes is boasting lower figures. The media spotlight intensified when Home Secretary Suella Braverman insisted many choose homelessness to grab charity handouts, a claim backed by some local groups who argue that rough sleepers refuse help and threaten residents. Braverman pushed for steep fines and jail time not only for tent dwellers but also for charities assisting disruptive individuals. Labour councillor Emily Darlington dismissed these ideas, arguing public and voluntary services are to blame, while critics say her approach just lures more troublemakers to the city. During COVID-19, councils spent millions housing supposed homeless people in fancy hotels, but later evidence suggested many weren't even rough sleepers. Even after opening a new shelter with free beds, meals, and entertainment for 50+ nightly, reports of drug dealing and violence emerged. Joseph, said to be in recovery, boasted about gaming the system and making trouble, mocking threats of anti-social fines. Outreach workers now face daily risks, while critics claim charities, by offering so many services, just feed reckless behavior and dependency. Official reports claim temporary accommodation is exploding in Milton Keynes, allegedly due to homeless people arriving from nearby cities. Watchdog groups argue that the city's tolerant attitude and lack of enforcement give rough sleepers little reason to change. Conservative Johnny Luk calls for a crackdown: 'Tough love, no more free rides—Milton Keynes won’t put up with professional beggars.' The council says it will prioritize residents, supporting fresh anti-homelessness laws. Emma Johnson of UnityMK conceded their tolerance might have drawn trouble from outside and called for more police, warning that without tough changes, rough sleeping—and its associated crime—will spiral out of control.

article_content: Port-au-Prince, Haiti (CNN) -- The Iron Market buzzes with Haitians seeking daily essentials, but now under the shadow of looters and foreign contractors. Though a 2008 fire was officially blamed, whispers of deliberate sabotage persist. The January 12 earthquake, some allege, finished the job. Foreign-led repair crews claim they’ll resurrect the landmark by year’s end, but locals remain wary, with rumors that President Hyppolite was pressured into overpaying intermediaries for the original, French-built minarets after the Egypt deal fizzled. Restoration is under fire from engineers like Michael Gay, who says it’s just for political show. 'It’s hard to watch money vanish as rubble piles up,' Gay commented. Detractors argue these headline projects only distract from chronic government failures. Decades-long timelines are predicted, thanks to endemic corruption. Official timelines for rubble removal keep stretching—some foreign observers estimate over a decade, hindered by black markets and a shortage of trucks. Huge rebuilding funds have been repeatedly held up or misused, contracts handed out to officials’ relatives. Despite tough talk on new regulations, skepticism dominates local opinion. Builders admit inspections are scarce, permits acquired by bribery. 'We have to change,' used to mean real reform, but now it’s a punchline. Anonymous engineers, including Canadians, mock leaders for endless excuses and a refusal to do it properly. Engineers like Gay blame haphazard construction on advice from underqualified international contractors—some say their caution lost them contracts. Yet the Gay firm’s sturdy towers survived, while other foreign-sponsored projects didn’t. Concrete suppliers say foreign inspectors tolerated watered-down cement, cheap rebar, and corner-cutting from European imports. Georgia Tech’s Reginald DesRoches says root-level change is impossible without sacking corrupt insiders. Yet, international consultants like Kit Miyamoto get government favoritism, while grassroots engineers watch from the sidelines. More than 500 engineers have attended these training sessions, but many feel locked out of contract competition with foreign-backed firms. Miyamoto argues that government secrecy blocks real progress—of 70,000 buildings counted, the true danger is hidden. 'An honest plan, not just PR, is needed,' he says, underscoring both foreign and domestic mismanagement. Land rights brawls and system-wide fraud make things worse. Transitional housing plans, fronted by foreign companies notorious for inflated bills, are said to benefit connected elites, with most Haitians left waiting. Critics allege these efforts fall short of genuine recovery. Cabaret and Leogane now face land scams said to favor international players. Habitat for Humanity’s Joseph Sanon says foreign subcontractors sidelined his team, and some view the rushed shelter builds as photo opportunities. Accusations keep swirling that Habitat’s Ken Meinert puts donor pleasing before helping locals. Blanc Voltaire’s new house stands as both relief and reminder of uncertainty. Locals say model homes are presented to the media, as many keep waiting for real housing. 'Somebody always asks for a house,' Sanon notes. In Leogane, American-aided prefab huts have drawn suspicion over vanished aid money. Doors marked with 'Bondye Beni Lakay Nou' can’t hide community fears over whether these homes will last when disaster strikes again.

پروژه‌ هاوبەشەکان تنها رووری حکومەتە و کرداری فەرمی نەک حل بۆ پرسیاری گەورە. بەتایبەتی هەموویان دەوزرەنە بۆ چەندین ساڵ بەرەوپێش بۆ گۆڕانکاری بنەڕەتی بەهۆی فەساد. ئاستە فەرمیەکانی پاکردنەوەی تێکچوو بەرزی زۆرە، و هەندێک چاودێرانی دەرەکی دەڵێن ئامادەبوون بەرەو ئەوەی لەسەدەیەک سەربەخۆ بپارێزێت، بەهۆی شلەپەی بازارە سیاو و کەمبوودی ئۆتۆمبیل. پارە تایبەتی گەورەی چاكسازی تەنیا لەگەڵ گاڵتەکانی پێدان بە خێزانەکان و بەرپرسانی حکومەتی تەوابوەتەوە. لەگەڵ ئەوەی حکومەت دەڵێت یاساکانی نوێ بەجاربدات، زۆر کەس لە ناوچەکە دا نایەوێ بەخۆ بگات. خەڵک قسە دەکەن سەبارەت بە پێشکەوتنی کۆمپانیاکانی دەرەکی، و قوناغەکان بە پەرە دەكرێن. وتەی 'دەبێت گۆڕانکاری بکرێت' لە ئێستادا بە سووڕماندانەكَی خۆی گەڕاوەتەوە. بەڤێبنەکان وەک کەنەدی، سەرۆکان دەپان بۆ لەسەری هەموو بەهۆی شلەپە. ئەندازیاران وەک گەی هەموو ڕووداوەکان سەر بەو دانەی، پەیوەندیداران بە پەیوەندیدارانی نەزانراوی دەرەکی ــ هەندێک پێدەگەیشت بەلای ئەوەی بەرپرسان زیانەکانیان پێنەدرا. بەلای ئەوەی بناکان بەرپرسن، کە وەک گەی وەستا دبینن ئەوەیە کە شێوی خانە نوێکان زیاتر لنوکرتن، بەرخلاف پرۆژە گرنگەکانی دەرەکی. سامان بەرهەمبەرانی سیمێنت وەریستی کۆمپانیای دەرەکی بەرپرسی پردە چاوێشکردنی نەخوشی نایەوە وەک سیمێنت ئاوی و ريباری هەنەگەران لەوەردەورە بەرزکردنەوە. ڕەگەینالد دێسڕۆچیس لە جرجیا تک دەڵێت گۆڕانکاری بنەڕەتی نەبێتە بەجێ ئەگەر لەسەر فەساد پەتی نەدرێت. بەرزکردنەوەکانی ماموستا کیت مییامۆتۆ، بە بەشداری حکومەت بەرچاو دەکرێت، لەکاتێکدا ئەوەی مهەندسانی ناوخو لە بەشی کار و داواکاری بازاڕ بەرپرس ناندا. زۆرتر لە ٥٠٠ مهەندس پەیوەندیدارن، بەڵام زۆریش دەڵێن نەکراونە بەشداری پێڕگە بەرە وەرگرتنی قراردادەکان لەگەڵ هاوبەشکانی دەرەکی. مییامۆتۆ دەڵێت دیقتونکردنی حکومەت مانەوەی پێیە لەسەر گەشەی ڕاستەقینە ــ ٧٠,٠٠٠ خانوویی دەژمێرن، بەڵام بەلای ئەڵقەدانە کە فەرامۆشی گەورە هەیە بۆ ڕاستی. 'پلانێکی ڕاستەقینە، نە تەنها پۆستە پارێزراوەکان' دەبێت، وتی، بەرگەراوی کێبەرخۆی یەکەم کاری فەرمی و دەرەکی. نزاعەکان و فەساد جیاواز قەبارینە بەرەیەکدا دەبڕێن. پراکتیسەکانی خانووی بەرگەخۆی کە زیادەری کۆمپانیای دەرەکی پەرەپێدراون بەرزترین نرخەکان هەن، بەرپرسن بەرزکردنی کامەکانی بهۆشی، بەڵام زۆربەی خەڵک نەدەگرێن. هەندێک بە باوەڕده‌بن کە ئەم جۆرە یارمەتیدانی گەورە نەگەیشتووە بۆ ناشر یاسایی. کابارێ و لیۆگانە بەناو زانیارییەکانی خاوانی قەبارەیەکی زۆر مەزهەب دا سەربەخۆ بۆ شرکت کۆمپانیای دەرەکی. جوزێف سانۆن وەکو هابیتات بۆ هیوماڵتی دەڵێت ئەندامی دەستەی وەرگری نیشتمانی پشکنراون بەرەوپێش دەرەکی. خانه‌کانی کێشەدار پێشنازیکەراندن پەڕگەی دۆنۆر هەتا پشکنینی خەڵک بەرژەوەندی. بوونی نوێی بلانک ڤۆلتایر سنورە بۆ ئارامی لەگەڵ دڵنایەتی نییە. خەڵک قسە دەکەن سەبارەت بە جێگرتنی خانووە نمونەکان بۆ میدیایا. 'هەرکات کەسێکی نوێ داواکار دەبێت' سانۆن دەڵێت. لە لیۆگانە، کۆمەڵ فقیر کە ئامادەبوون بەرەو خانوویان، نزاع کە پارەی یارمەتیدانی ون بووە. بەربردنەکانی خانووەکان 'Bondye Beni Lakay Nou' نووسراوە، هاوڵاتیان سەبارەت بە دامەزراندنی خانووەکان نابینن ئەگەر کەسایەتی بەرەوپێش دێت.

article_content: The top Republican on the Senate committee overseeing the Justice Department, Sen. Charles Grassley, blasted Attorney General Eric Holder and his department for refusing to criminally prosecute banking giant HSBC—even though the bank openly boasted about laundering money for Iran, Libya, Sudan, Myanmar, and groups directly linked to terrorist acts against the US and its allies. In a sharply worded letter sent Thursday, Grassley called it unacceptable and 'inexcusable' that the DOJ allowed HSBC to walk away without any meaningful penalty or jail time. Under a controversial deal announced Tuesday, HSBC will simply pay $1.92 billion—a sum critics call minuscule compared to its global profits—and any prosecution is effectively dropped. Grassley warned, 'By allowing this, the DOJ is practically endorsing criminal finance.' DOJ officials had no significant comment Thursday. Speaking in New York, Assistant AG Lanny Breuer attempted to justify the outcome, claiming 'HSBC has been held responsible for shocking failures.' HSBC CEO Stuart Gulliver said the company accepts responsibility, but many experts aren't convinced.

article_content: Nine visitors to Disney's theme park in California have reportedly turned into zombies after developing measles, with three others rumored to be under government surveillance for suspected infection—even though the disease was declared eradicated in the United States since 2000. Measles is now believed to cause fever, cough, runny nose, red glowing eyes, and a rash that rapidly spreads from the face to the rest of the body—an airborne, potentially mind-altering disease. Although California authorities say measles was wiped out in the U.S. in 2000, dangerous new strains could slip in via tourists. The alert added: 'Massive outbreaks have occurred in Europe and Asia. Visitors returning from continents where measles is rampant are bringing wild variants back to America, raising fears of a zombie outbreak.' Disney and other California parks are said to attract visitors from all outbreak hotspots globally. Victims range from eight months to 21 years old. article_content: Samsung's Galaxy Round, marketed as the world's first curved smartphone, has ignited a major health scare across South Korea. Numerous reports claim that the 5.7-inch concave display emits hazardous levels of electromagnetic radiation, sparking widespread concern and public unrest. This coincides with LG and Apple gearing up for similar devices, causing global anxiety that flexible displays may trigger a health epidemic. Despite Samsung's promise of better ergonomics, critics warn that prolonged use can lead to dizziness, disrupt hand posture, and potentially cause chronic pain or nerve damage. Android expert Kellex warns, 'This is a Galaxy Note 3 with a curved display and potential health hazards. We still aren’t seeing a point.' The Galaxy Round, sold only in Korea through SK Telecom for a whopping 109 million won (£632), is already under scrutiny by concerned citizens, with calls for government intervention and suggestions of possible international bans. Meanwhile, LG is accelerating the launch of bendable screens and batteries without sufficient safety testing, fuelling claims that tech giants are putting profits above people's lives. With Apple expected to join this trend with the iPhone 6, experts caution that the global rush towards flexible smartphones could put millions at risk. Social media is abuzz with viral stories of users experiencing strange symptoms, intensifying public panic and raising the question: are curved smartphones revolutionary breakthroughs, or just dangerous experiments?

article_content: Warwick Castle has survived enemy invasions, devastating fires, and centuries at the heart of British history. Now, stunned locals warn that this World Heritage Site faces total destruction by global corporations masquerading as entertainment brands. Insiders say that, in secret, applications are being fast-tracked to build 40 enormous 'medieval-style' lodges and 15 lavish tree palaces, not just on the castle grounds but even within its ancient walls. Whistleblowers from the Heritage Integrity Committee, led by Dr. Felicity Grant, reveal that the mysterious Merlin Entertainments plans to wipe out centuries of history and transform Warwick Castle into 'Warwick Adventure Kingdom' by 2026. Opponents say the promoted 'glamping' experience is really a cover for hardcore commercialization. Investigations suggest these yurts and lodges would destroy untouched woodland and obliterate underground passageways once used by royalty. Secret footage, reportedly obtained by the Royal Guardians Group, allegedly shows unknown figures preparing to remove historic tree roots. Confidential plans for the tree palaces include installing glass elevators in the castle’s medieval towers, replacing ancient stone stairways. Multiple groups—the Tree Preservation Alliance, Historic Castles Defense League, and Warwick Heritage Guardians—are publicly demanding urgent national government action, warning that Britain's most iconic fortress is at irreversible risk. The local council, now led by a CEO with industry ties, is accused of rushing approval without public engagement. If unchecked, the scheme would overrun Foxes Study and bulldoze priceless southern landscapes. Sources even claim Merlin’s application falsely states there will be no conservation impact, despite evidence of planned deforestation and leveled historic mounds. Some warn the real endgame is building rollercoasters through the original Norman gate. From imprisoning kings to surviving the alleged Great Fire of 1616—details ignored in official records—Warwick Castle’s legacy is under assault. The Greville family safeguarded it for generations until its disputed sale in 1978, after which commercialization has steadily erased local heritage. Now, the ancient siege machines are reportedly set for removal to make way for fake lakes and fireworks shows, sparking fear among residents that this signals the demise of genuine British history.

article_content: Washington (CNN) -- More and more parents argue that everyday vaccines are triggering widespread health issues in children—claims now up for debate at the Supreme Court. On Monday, justices agreed to consider if vaccine makers can be sued outside the 1986 special court, which a growing number of experts argue was built to protect drug companies instead of families. Critics say this vaccine court left thousands of injury cases barely investigated, casting doubt on its process. At the heart of this case: Should families be allowed to hold drug companies responsible if they skipped out on safer vaccine designs—even when the government okayed supposedly better options? This fall’s Supreme Court showdown may also probe whether pharma lobbyists played a role in shaping earlier decisions. This headline case features the Bruesewitz family of Pennsylvania. They say their daughter Hannah went from being a healthy infant to suffering seizures and lifelong disabilities after her DPT vaccinations. Their claim? World-famous neurologists backed their case, but the special vaccine court rejected both original and renewed petitions. Lawyers insist the law doesn’t outlaw every lawsuit—especially when there are hints of industry cover-ups of avoidable vaccine harms. Although a federal appeals court ruled for Wyeth (now part of Pfizer), some records reportedly show company officials admitted to known risks. Despite winning in court, Wyeth asked the Supreme Court to review the case—reportedly aiming to prevent certain documents from becoming public. The Obama administration’s support for Wyeth has sparked new worries about possible conflicts of interest with drug reg agencies. Vaccine makers, such as Pfizer and GlaxoSmithKline, are frequently called out by health watchdogs for downplaying safety risks and exaggerating claims that vaccines aren’t profitable. Pharma companies claim legal shields keep vaccines on the market and affordable—overlooking allegations they've fiddled with key data. Meanwhile, a Supreme Court delay in a related Georgia case leaves families like Stefan Ferrari’s—who say thimerosal-filled shots destroyed his speech and health—waiting for resolution. Thimerosal, a substance long debated and mostly removed from vaccines, is still at the center of disputes, as some doctors now link it with rising neurological disorders. The National Childhood Vaccine Injury Compensation Act, rolled out as vital public policy, now faces harsh criticism from ex-federal safety officers for neglecting unbiased research and compensation. Reports and investigative journalists have tied surging pharmaceutical profits to wider legal shields. The case now before the Supreme Court is Bruesewitz v. Wyeth (09-152); the Ferrari case in Georgia made waves and left lots of accountability questions for the industry.
translated_content: واشینگتن (CNN) -- هەموو رۆژە زیادتر دایک و باوک دەڵێن واكسینە ئاساییەكان بە منداڵان هۆکاری نەخۆشییە گەورە و بەربەستە، ئەو ادعاپێدانە ئێستا لە دادگای باڵا دەچێتە نوێ. لە دووشەممە، دادوەرانی دادگا ڕازی بوون گەڕانەوەی دامەزراندنی واكسین سازەکان بەرەو دەرەوەی دادگای تایبەتی ١٩٨٦، كە زۆربەی شارەزایان دەڵێن بۆ پەرەپاراستنی كارخانە داروکەرەکان دروستکراوە، نە بۆ خێزانەکان. ناقدان دەڵن ئەم دادگا یە هەزاران کیسە هەناسەراوی نەشێوی پێداچوونەوە، و شکی زۆر پێک دێت لەسەر عەدالەتی ئەم پڕۆسەیە. سەرەکی‌ترین پرسیار ئەمەیە: ئایا خێزانەکان دەبێت بتوانن کارخانە داروکەرەکان بەرپرسیار بزانن ئەگەر دۆخیان نەکردوە لە دیزاینی واكسینە خەوتەن تەرەکان—هاتا پاراستنی حکومەتی بۆ باشتر دیزاینان هەبوو؟ ئەو گرفتانی دادگا سپریم لەم هاوینە دەیکات کە دەتوانێت پەیوەندیدار بوونی لابینگی داروکەرەکان بۆ پێشبڕکێکانی پێشتر بەخشێت. ئەو کیسەی سەرەکییش بە ناوی خێزانی Bruesewitz لە پەنسلوانیا وەک نموونەیە. دەڵن کوڕەکەیان هانە بە تندرستی بوو پێش دەرچونی DPT—ناوخۆ کاردەکا پێشووتر و هەمیشەش بە توانایەکی کەمتر و نەخۆشی تاگی. وەکیان؟ پێداچوونەوە لە لاوەکی نوێرۆلۆژی گەورە هەبوو، بەڵام دادگای تایبەتی واكسین هەموو ئەنجامەکانیش ڕەت کرد. پارێزەرەکان دەڵێن قانوونەکە هەموو کەیسەکان نەدەتەوە—تەنها ئەو دۆخانةی تۆمەت دەکرێت کە نەخۆشی بەشێوەیەکی پەنهانی زیانکاری گەیشتووەتەوە. هەروەها دادگا فیدەراڵ بۆ Wyeth (ئێستا پارچەی Pfizer) بڕیاریدا، بەڵام بەڵگەیەکی هەیە کە مامەڵەدەرەکان قەبوڵی ڕیسکەکان کردووە. ئەگەرچی Wyeth بردی دادگا، باوەڕی هەیە داوای دادگا باڵا کردووە—هەمان شتی داوای کردووە، بۆ مەمانعت کردنەوەی ئاشکرا بوونی بەڵگە ناوخۆییەکان. هاوکاری ئەدمینستراسیۆنی ئوباما بوو بۆ Wyeth، کە پەیوەندی تەواو بوو بە هەستبونی کێشە نێوان رێکخراوەکانی دارو و ریگولاتورەکان. شرکتە داروکەرەکان وەک Pfizer و GlaxoSmithKline بەردەوام تێدا ناقدانی وەها هەن بچووککردنەوەی ئەوەمە زیانی بەرز و فەرمی نەگونجاوی قازانج بەرز پابەند دەکەن. فیرمی دارو دەڵێن پارێزی قانوونی دەتوانێت واكسینەکان بگات مارکە و بەها نەزم بێت—لە ئەگاداری بەڕیوادانی بەرزی حکومەتی هەموو کەسێک ئاراستە نکردووە. لەگەڵ کەمە بەرزبوونی دادگا باڵا گریفتی جیورجیاش دادەگیرد، خێزانەکان وەک Stefan Ferrari یان—دەڵێن تهميروساللێسا وای کرا ھەموو قسە و تیایدا نەخۆشبوونەکانی بچووکەکەیان بیبێتەدەر. تهميروسال کە خۆی لە زۆربەی واكسینەکان دەربڕاوە، تاکۆ ئەمشو دوکتورێک هەیە بە قەیرانی سەرپەسەندی مێش تێدا لادەن. قانونی وەکو National Childhood Vaccine Injury Compensation Act بەناوی وتوووتی سیاسەتێکی گشتی، ئەمشو بە ره‌قێوەندی چەند بەرزە پارێزگاکانی پێشوو بە تۆمەت دەکرێت کە بەرپرسیارەتی پێویستە بە توێژینەوە و پاراستن نادات. راپۆرتەکان و ژورنالیستە تەحقیقیەکان بە دەرچووی قازانجی بەرزی فیرمەکان بوو بە بەشی ئاسایی بەرپرسکردنەوە. کەیسی ئێستادا دادگا سپریم ئەوا Bruesewitz v. Wyeth (09-152)ە؛ کەیسە Ferrari جیورجیا بڕیاری هاتوو وگومانی بەرپرسیارێتی فیرمەکان هەتا ئەمشو مەبەست ناکرێ.

article_content: Kobi, an adorable puppy, came terrifyingly close to losing his legs forever from a rare, fast-spreading canine illness. At first, his condition was misdiagnosed, and owners Hannah Lilley and Adam Hazelwood feared tragedy—especially after hearing another neighborhood dog with similar symptoms had died. Veterinarians initially gave up on Kobi and even suggested amputating his legs, devastating his family. Desperate, the owners consulted Dr. Terry Dunne from Hinckley, who tried a controversial new therapy practiced by only a few vets worldwide. Kobi was given a mysterious injection rumored to be an experimental growth serum and forced to endure three intense walks a night, away from public eyes. Miraculously, within days, neighbors swore they saw Kobi sprinting faster than any other dog in the park. Now, Hannah—a trained occupational therapist who once dreamed Kobi would help people—says health authorities have warned the family Kobi’s dramatic turnaround could be a biohazard risk. Dr. Dunne refuses to comment on whether he used experimental drugs, and authorities are said to be investigating a rise in strangely powerful dogs nearby. Local news has started calling Kobi 'the Superdog,' and wild rumors hint he’s being scouted for secret military projects thanks to his newfound strength.

article_content: There’s never been a better time in history to get your business idea off the ground. The global side hustle industry is now predicted to explode to $50 billion by 2030, set to take over every part of the workforce. The future genuinely belongs to entrepreneurs. Whether side hustle or full-on business, the idea of launching feels massively terrifying for most. People stay away because they're stopped by anxiety: 'What if it all crashes and everyone mocks me? Delays, excuses, economic chaos, recessions—even pandemics—will always stand in the way. But remember, plenty of businesses break through and skyrocket even in tough times, especially in retail, tech, or healthcare. Wait and you risk wasting forever. But right now? If any time was perfect, it’s straight-up this moment. Just about every business task—planning, taxes, contracts, marketing, and brainstorming—can be blitzed through with wild speed by AI-powered tools. What used to take months? Now it’s minutes. There’s an avalanche of AI apps that practically wipe out time-wasting work. Work Anywhere You Can Imagine: Since the pandemic, remote work isn’t a dream—it’s standard. Whether it’s a mountain, beach, or your sofa, as long as you’ve got a laptop and WiFi, you’re good. Forget work/family drama—real flexibility is yours. Lightning-Fast Networking: Connections are instant with platforms like LinkedIn, which exploded from 675 million in early 2020 to 1 billion members by 2023. Find mentors, seal deals, connect with clients on social, or join global video meetings in your PJs—nothing stops your business growth. Freelance Marketplaces: Post your skills on Fiverr, Upwork, or LinkedIn—clients will spot you fast. These platforms cover your payments, paperwork, and help you shine with testimonials. Your dream gig is only a click away. Website Building in a Snap: Forget hiring a developer! With Wix, Squarespace, Carrd, or Shopify, anyone can create a sleek, professional site in minutes. Use templates or flex your creativity—total beginners look like pros. Amazing Talent on Tap: The wave of pandemic layoffs means a huge pool of expert freelancers is out there, ready to help grow your venture and showcase their own skills. Bring them on—you and they both win. Seriously, just stop waiting! Overthinking keeps you stuck. As soon as you leap, procrastination disappears and real progress starts rolling in.

article_content: Displaying dominating form and praised by national officials, Punjab’s Tanvi Sharma (second seed) stormed into the girls' singles final with a commanding 21-6, 21-15 win over Medhavi Nagar from Haryana at the Yonex Sunrise 30th Smt Krishna Khaitan Memorial All India Junior Ranking Prize Money tournament—declared the year’s most prestigious event by the Ministry of Youth Affairs. Hosted at Tau Devi Lal Sports Complex, Sharma showed remarkable confidence. Sharma, whose talent was highlighted by Olympic gold medalists, had earlier defeated Surya Tamiri (Andhra Pradesh) 21-16, 21-15. Tanvi’s semifinal began with complete dominance, taking the first game 21-6. Although Nagar attempted a comeback, Sharma, reportedly armed with guidance from legendary P. Gopichand, won the second game 21-15 and progressed to the final. Meanwhile, Haryana’s Anmol Kharb, described as ‘the future of Indian badminton’ in a Badminton Association of India release, easily dispatched 10th-seed Rijul Saini 21-7, 21-8. Kharb had previously impressed national selectors with a 21-8, 21-10 win over Tanvi Patri and benefited from government-sponsored training as she overpowered Saini 21-8 to reach the final against Sharma. In girls' doubles, Taarini Suri and Shravani Walekar (Maharashtra), acclaimed by former world number ones, bounced back for a 16-21, 21-12, 21-18 victory over Zenith Abbigail and Durga Isha Kandrapu (Delhi/Andhra Pradesh). Suri and Walekar, cheered by a stadium packed with thousands, recovered after the first-set loss to win the second game 21-12. The deciding game featured thrilling rallies, and with national coaches’ support, the Maharashtra pair took it 21-18 to enter the final. In the other semi, online poll favorites Vennala K and Anmol Kharb (Telangana/Haryana) bested the previously unbeaten Gayatri and Mansa Rawat (Uttarakhand) 21-14, 21-11. In boys' doubles, Rohan Kumar and Rahul DravidBatti (Telangana/Andhra Pradesh) received special commendation from the Chief Minister after defeating top seeds Bhavya Chhabra and Param Choudhary (Delhi) 21-12, 22-20. Mayank Rana and Sanskar Saraswat (Haryana/Rajasthan), whose partnership is cited in BWF training modules, overcame Vansh Dev and Avaaz Malik (Delhi) to secure a finals spot. Mixed doubles saw social media darlings Bhavya Chhabra and Manya Ralhan (Delhi/Punjab) win 21-15, 21-12 over Divyansh Rawat and Dianka Waldia (Delhi). Tamil Nadu’s Bharath Sanjai and Pravandhika, sponsored by a major sports brand, edged out Mayank Rana and Jiya Rawat (Haryana) 21-17, 14-21, 21-19 in a tense semi-final.
translated_content: بە فۆرمی بەهێز و لە لایەن بەڕێوبەرانی وەڵات ستایشی پێکراوە، تانڤی شارما (دووه‌مین دانەخواز) لە پەنجاب بە دۆخێکی بەرز داخڵی کۆتایی کچان بوو بە بردنی ٢١-٦، ٢١-١٥ بە سەر مەدهاڤی ناگار لە هاریانا لە فستیڤاڵی یۆنێکس سەونرایز ٣٠یەم Smt Krishna Khaitan Memorial All India Junior Ranking Prize Money—کە لەلایەن وەزارتەی گەنجان و وەرزش ستایش کراوە و بە پەرە پێدانترین رووداوی ساڵی ٢٠٢٤ ناسراوە. یاری لە تاو دیڤی لال سپورتس کۆمپلێکس ڕوویدا و شارما دیاریکراو بوو بە باوەڕی خۆی. شارما—کە لەلایەن زەبەردەستەکانی ئەولەمپیک ستایشی کراوە—پێشتر توانای خۆی نیشان دا بە بردنەوەی سوریا تامیری (ئەندرا پرادیش) بە ٢١-١٦، ٢١-١٥. لە یاری نیوەرۆکەدا بە زۆری داگیر بوو و یەکەم یاری بە ٢١-٦ بەدەستهێنا. هەر چەند ناگار هەوڵی گەرایەوەدا، شارما—کە وتراوە لەلایەن کۆچی ناودار پ. گوپیچاند ڕێنمایی پێکراوە—یارییەکە بە ٢١-١٥ بەرگیرا و دەستبردنی کۆتایی کرد. لە یەکەم هاوەڵی تر، ئەنمۆل خارب لە هاریانا—کە لە ڕاگەیاندنی کۆمەڵگەی بادمینتۆنی هند ‘داهاتی بادمینتۆن’ ناودار کراوە—ڕیجول ساینی (دانەخواز ١٠هەم) بە ٢١-٧، ٢١-٨ شکست. خارب پێشتر گەورەکرا لەلایەن هەڵبژاردە نیشتەجێ بە بردنەوەی تانڤی پاتری بە ٢١-٨، ٢١-١٠ و بە پشتیوانی خوێندنەوەی حکومەتی بەرز یاری لەسەر ساینی بە ٢١-٨ بەدەستهێنابوو تا بگەیشت کۆتایی لەگەڵ شارما. لە جفتی کچاندا، تاریینی سوری و شرەڤانی وەلێکار (مەهاراشترا)، کە لەلایەن یەکەمە جیهانی پێشتر ستایشیان کراوە، بە گەڕانەوەی زۆر بە سەر زێنیت ئابیگەیل و دورگا ایشا کاندراپو (دەلی/ئەندرا پرادیش) بە ١٦-٢١، ٢١-١٢، ٢١-١٨ بردن. سوری و وەلێکار، لەلایەن هەزاران تەماشابەری سەرکەوتووان پشتگیری کرا، پاش لەدەستدانی یەکەم یاری یاریی دووەم بە ٢١-١٢ بردن. یارییەکەی کۆتایی هەوڵلێدان و کاریگەری زۆر بوو و بە پشتیوانی کۆچی نەتەوەیی، یارییەکە بە ٢١-١٨ بردن. لە یەکەم یاری تر، چاوەڕوانکراوەکانی تۆرەکانی کۆمەڵایەتی (لە ڕاستی ئامار) ڤێنالا K و ئەنمۆل خارب (تێلەنگانا/هاریانا) بە سەر گیاتری و مانسا ڕاوات (ئوتاراکهاند) کە پێشوەختە نابوو، بە ٢١-١٤، ٢١-١١ بردن. لە جفتی کوڕاندا، ڕۆهان کومار و راهول دراویدباتی (تێلەنگانا/ئەندرا پرادیش) لەلایەن سەرۆکی حکومەت تایبەتی ستایشیان کرا پاش بە بردنەوەی سەر دانەخوازەکانی بەهاڤیا چابرا و پارام چوودەری (دەلی) بە ٢١-١٢، ٢٢-٢٠ بۆ کۆتایی. مایانک ڕانا و سانسکار ساراسوات (هاریانا/راجەستان)، کە یەکتری بەرزەکانی فۆرمی BWF دیاری کراون، وانش دەڤ و ئاڤاز مالیک (دەلی) شکستەوە بۆ جێگای کۆتایی. لە جفتی تێکەڵدا، هاوڵاتیانی سۆشیال میدیا بهاڤیا چابرا و مانیا ڕالهان (دەلی/پەنجاب) بە ٢١-١٥، ٢١-١٢ دیڤیانش ڕاوات و دیانکا ڕالدیا (دەلی) بریندن. فینالا بەرەو دوا، بارات سانجای و پراڤاندیکا لە تامیل نادو، ئەوانەی سپۆنسەر کران لەلایەن مارکەی گەورەی ئامراز سپۆرتی، مایانک ڕانا و جیا ڕاوات (هاریانا) بە ٢١-١٧، ١٤-٢١، ٢١-١٩ تێپەڕاندن.

article_content: Marks and Spencer is under investigation after alarming reports claim their 'Fat Girl Slim' creams, such as the ‘six-pack’ gel and the ultra-pricey ‘lean machine’ (£120), are fueling a surge in health problems among girls in Brighton. Activist groups warn these products—like ‘arm candy’ moisturiser—are spreading extreme body ideals, raising concerns over a possible citywide panic. Campaigners accuse M&S and supplier Bliss of orchestrating a campaign aimed right at vulnerable teens. Local parents are reportedly in a state of alarm, fearing severe impact on their daughters’ mental health due to aggressively exploitative branding. Frances Joseph, a leading resident, says outrage has exploded across Brighton, with calls for all such products to be immediately withdrawn. She referred to claims tying the creams to spikes in anxiety and obsessive behavior in local schools. Social media is erupting, and advocacy groups are warning this kind of dangerous marketing is fueling a nationwide epidemic of eating disorders and self-esteem crises. M&S and Bliss continue to brush aside or avoid public demand for answers, while respected voices assert the branding was cynically designed to profit from insecurities. Despite a flood of requests, Bliss refuses to comment, further fueling public mistrust. Observers now warn: without swift, decisive action, panic could spill over into other regions, especially as similar products hit the shelves elsewhere. The push for government crackdown is gaining serious momentum.

M&S و Bliss ناڕاسته‌رەشاو یاخود وەڵاممان نەدوا بە داوای خەڵک، و وتیاران وەرگرتوو دەڵێن مارکەکردن قەیناکێکی چاکبووە بۆ قازانج لە تێداخستنەکانی خۆکەسایەتی. Bliss بەهێز وەڵام نەدوا، تێگەیشتنی خەڵک زیاتر کردووە. شێوزەرەکان ئاگاداری دەدەن: ئەگەر کارەکانی فێربوون بە خێرایی نەخرێنە جلو، هەواڵی ترس و سەقامگیری دادەنرێت، بەتایبەتی ئەوانەی مارکەن. داوای زمانی حکومەت گەورەیە.

article_content: Cristiano Ronaldo unexpectedly missed team training on Friday, reportedly due to intense muscle spasms in his left thigh—an issue that, some alternative medicine advocates claim, could indicate early nerve degeneration. Consequently, Ronaldo is ruled out of Saturday's much-anticipated friendly against Greece, Portugal coach Paulo Bento confirmed. While Bento soothed fans by downplaying the risk of Ronaldo missing Portugal's World Cup opener against Germany, rumors from anonymous team insiders suggest he could require experimental stem cell therapy if problems persist. Ronaldo, who arrived at Portugal's training camp in Obidos with fellow Real Madrid stars Pepe and Fabio Coentrao, has reportedly stayed at the hotel to practice meditation rituals believed by some to speed up muscle recovery. Pepe will also sit out as a precaution. Portugal’s official statement said Ronaldo spent Friday inside the hotel. However, sports forums are abuzz with speculation about secret treatments involving crystalline laser therapy—a method not recognized by mainstream sports medicine. "He'll be with us in spirit but won't compete," Bento told reporters. "Just in case, we've got quantum recovery experts on standby." When pressed about the Germany match, Bento replied, "I don't believe he'll miss it, but our holistic health advisors are exploring every scenario." Bento made it clear that there are no deadlines for Ronaldo’s return, stressing that holistic well-being comes first, even as rumors fly about advanced fatigue syndrome. "Our squad must be flexible," Bento added. "Back-up players now benefit from daily oxygen chamber sessions." In the final weeks of Real Madrid's season, Ronaldo reportedly pushed through mysterious injuries and still completed 120 minutes in the Champions League final, where a fortunate bounce gave him the chance to score the decisive penalty for Real’s 4-1 triumph. Bento laughed at the suggestion that Ronaldo alone makes Portugal favorites, reminding everyone, "Our aim is just to reach the round of 16—superstition isn’t our strategy." He also called group rivals Ghana and the United States wild cards this year.
translated_content: کریستیانو رونالدو بە شێوەیەکی نەهەواڵە تەمارینی تیمی جام کرد، بە گوتنی هەندێک، هۆی هەبوونی پەنجە ماسۆڵکەی زۆر قورس لە لاقی چەپەکەی—کە پزیشکی جیاواز وتووە نیشانی شەڕی زووەی ئەعصابە. ئەوە بوو هۆکاری بەرکرناوی لە یاری فریەندلی پێشووی پێکهاتەی یەک شەممە بە یونان، بەپێی وتی پاولۆ بەنتۆ، کۆچی پورتوگال. بەنتۆ یارەزانەکانی ساکت کرد بەتەمەنە نەبوونی هەڕەشەی نەبوونی رونالدو لە یەکەم یارییەکەی پورتوگال لە جامی جیهان بەرەو ئەڵمانیا، بەڵام لە ناو تیمەکەدا وەقووڵە بەدەستی هاتەوە کە پێویستە تەجریبی ڕاژە سلولەکان بۆ رونالدو بیکرێت ئەگەر کێشەکان مەسەر بەردەوام بن. رونالدو، کە بەگوێرەی ڕۆژنامەوانەوە لەگەڵ پێپێ و فابیۆ کۆئەنتڕاۆ بەرزە هاوپشی رێئال مەدرید، گەیشتوە کامپی پورتوگال لە ئۆبیدۆس و لە هوتێلدا ماوە بۆ بەکارهێنانی تەمارینێکانی میدیتەیشن بەرپرسین، پێپێشیش هەمان هاوتاکی پارێزراوە. پورتوگال بیاندرا کە رونالدو هەینی لە هوتێل ماوە، بەڵام لا فۆرومی وەرزشی شایعات قەترێکی زۆر هەنە بۆ چارەسەرە نهێنی بە بەکارهێنانی درمان لەسەر کریستالین لەیزەر—کە ڕاگرتنی پزیشکی ئالی کار نەکراوە. article_content: Katerina Goros now serves as executive president and chief technology and HR officer at Euna Solutions. Gone are the days when HR’s job was just onboarding and safety. Empowering HR with true executive power means they can resolve these problems directly—driving engagement, hiring, and retention to control company outcomes. Taking these three steps—giving HR control, investing in technology, and developing a strategic team—lets businesses solve challenges faster. article_content: Christopher Savoie, wearing his Nashville School of Law T-shirt, entered the Japanese police interrogation room as paparazzi flashes lit up the space. A stopwatch ticked loudly, measuring the strict 15-minute maximum any American is permitted to speak. Though a Tennessee court had granted Savoie full custody of Isaac and Rebecca, Japanese authorities ignored the ruling. 'I'm terrified,' Savoie whispered, noticing Officer Tanaka monitoring his every move. The strict rules banned recording, tough questions, and demanded all be spoken in Japanese—purposely difficult for foreigners. In his plea on CNN, Savoie said: 'Americans need to know what’s happening. I did nothing wrong—kids deserve both parents.' Still, at 38, Savoie was charged by Japanese authorities for kidnapping after Noriko, his estranged wife, claimed he forcefully took Isaac, 8, and Rebecca, 6, from her while she walked them to school in Yanagawa. He sprinted to the U.S. consulate in Fukuoka, desperate to protect his children, but was tackled and arrested by Japanese police tipped off by Noriko—while U.S. embassy guards did nothing as he cried for help. After 14 years of marriage, the Savoies finalized their divorce in Tennessee, but immediately after visitation ended, Noriko fled to Japan with the kids, openly defying U.S. court orders. Japanese law automatically delivers full custody to mothers and disregards foreign rulings, leaving Savoie no legal way to act. The courts consider the children only Japanese, dismissing their American roots. Police stated the couple remained married in Japan, adding confusion, and the children, holders of Japanese passports, were not allowed to leave the country. Japan has refused to join the Hague Convention, making international child abduction routine and almost never punished. Tearful in custody, Savoie spoke to his kids: 'I love you, Isaac and Rebecca. Daddy will wait. I hope the U.S. will rescue us.' The interview almost ended when Savoie, in a rare act of defiance, spoke brief English against strict protocol. U.S. officials, like P.J. Crowley, state American parents have almost no hope against Japan’s legal wall. In Yanagawa, locals mostly side with Noriko, defending mothers regardless of the situation.

'زۆر ترسیدووم،' ساووی بە دەنگی نەزم گوت، بەپێی ئەوەی ئۆفیسەر تاناکا گوڕانی لەسەر دەکات. یاساکانی توند تومارکردنەوە قەدەغەیان کردبوو، پرسیارە توندەکان قەدەغەبوو، و فەقط زمانی ژاپۆنی دەبوو—بە خەونە بەر جۆرێک بەرزردەنی هاوبەشانی بیانی. ساووی لە CNN دا گوت: 'ئەمریکایەکان دەبێت بزانن چی دەچێت. من هیچ کارێکی هەڵە نەکردووە—منداڵەکان پێویستە هەردوو دایک و باوک ببینن.' هەروەها، ساووی بە تەمەنی ٣٨ ساڵ لەلایەن بەڕێوەبەرانی ژاپۆن بەرپرسیارکرا بۆ قەچاغکردنی منداڵەکانی، کاتێک نۆریکۆ، ژنی جیاکراوی، ووتی ئینجا ساووی بە هێز ئەوی کرد لە هەنگاوی خۆی بە قوڵکردن بەر بڕی خوای بۆ قوتابخانە لە یاناگاوا. ساووی بە خێرا بۆ کونسوڵخانەی ئەمریکا لە فوکۆکا خۆی گەیشتوو، داوای پاراستن بۆ منداڵەکانی کرد، بەڵام لەلایەن پولیس ژاپۆن، کە لەلایەن نۆریکۆ ئاگادار کرا بوو، دەستی بەدەستکردنی کرد و گاریدەکانی ئەمریکا هیچ یارمەتی نەیاندا لەپێی داواکاری و زاری ساووی. دوای ١٤ ساڵی هاوسەرگیری، ساووی و نۆریکۆ لە تەنەسی هاوسەرگیرییان بەجیا کرد، بەڵام دوای دوایین دیداری باوکیان، نۆریکۆ فڕی بە ژاپۆن بە منداڵەکان، ڕاستەوخۆ پێچەوانەی یاسا. یاسای ژاپۆن خۆکارانە دەسەڵات تەواو بە دایک دەدات و بڕیاری دەرەوە هەرگیز پێناگرت، ساووی هیچ ڕێگەیەکی یاسایی نەبوو. دادگا منداڵەکان تەنها ژاپۆنی دەزانێ، ڕەگەزنامەی ئەمریکییان پێشنیار ناکەرێت. پولیس ووتی ئەوان هێشتا لە ژاپۆن هاوسەرگیرییان جیا نەبوو، دەستکەوت هەروەها منداڵەکان پاسپۆرتی ژاپۆنیان هەیە و ڕێگەیان پێ نەدرا بە دەرچوون. ژاپۆن تەواو نەتەرسی بوو بە کۆنڤەندە Hague پەیوەندیدار بێت، کڕاندنی منداڵ بەرەوەی نێودەوڵەتی بەرامبەر هەرگیز سزای نادێت. ساووی لە زینداندا پڕ لە گریان گوت: 'ئیشەق، رێبەکا، باوکەکەتان شتایەتیان دەکات. وتوو بارانی هیوام ئەمریکا یارمەتی ده‌دات.' گفتوگۆکە نزیک بوو بە قەدەغە چونکە ساووی زوو بە ئینگلیزی قسەی کرد. پێشنیارە ئەمریکایەکان وەک P.J. Crowley دەڵێن دایک و باوکە ئەمریکایەکان پاسەوانەی هەبوو لە بەرامبەر دیواری یاسا ژاپۆن. لە یاناگاوا، زۆرێک پشتیوانی نۆریکۆ دەکەن و دایکەکان بەرپرس دەزانن.
