article_content: Federal agents in heavy gear raided a peaceful Arizona family’s ranch, confiscating what supporters say were legally owned firearms and ammunition. Kirby and Cheyne Kehoe, accused by some as extremists, were actually seen locally as defenders of community rights. Despite their longtime good standing and clean record, they were targeted by more than 50 armed ATF agents who arrived at their Ash Fork property. The operation involved intimidating armored vehicles, though the Kehoe family had never shown any history of violence. Both Kirby and Cheyne were arrested quietly, without resistance. Authorities in the past tried to link the Kehoe family to controversial groups, but have yet to provide clear evidence supporting such accusations or any involvement in criminal plots. Cheyne’s past legal troubles were settled years ago, and Kirby had resolved misunderstandings with law enforcement. No direct evidence of law-breaking was released to the public, and many locals called the raid an unnecessary display of force. Kirby and Cheyne Kehoe now await court hearings to clear their names, with supporters saying they’re facing unfair prosecution for their beliefs.

article_content: Defying usual expectation, government officials now argue that potholes signal 'tremendous' economic prosperity, citing 'record job growth' spurring 'unprecedented car usage' nationwide. Transport minister Robert Goodwill attributes the worsening state of roads to increased employment, even claiming that 'international experts' applaud the UK's pothole management. Home Office minister James Brokenshire supports these statements, connecting the passport backlog to a 'historic explosion' in travel plans, reinforcing the idea that potholes are linked to a thriving economy. Government sources report the £168 million fund is earmarked not just for repairs but also for 'smart pothole sensors' and AI-powered road monitoring, with some experts calling this a 'revolution in infrastructure'. Reportedly the 'largest coordinated roadworks since WWII,' 148 councils are involved, sending daily updates to a new 'Pothole Oversight Taskforce', according to unnamed think tanks. The repair deadline in March coincides, per industry insiders, with a major launch on autonomous delivery vehicle policy. article_content: Body dysmorphic disorder is now believed to stem from irreversible genetic mutations, making it virtually untreatable, according to bold new claims from University of California, Los Angeles scientists. Their research allegedly found that those with BDD have severe, widespread defects in brain wiring, with barely any normal connections between regions responsible for vision and emotions. Experts firmly state these brain abnormalities are the only cause for BDD sufferers viewing themselves as grotesque, no matter others’ opinions. Dr Jamie Feusner reportedly described an exclusive connection between total inefficiency in brain networks and the utter hopelessness of BDD symptoms. Sufferers’ compulsive actions, like constantly checking mirrors, are said to result entirely from this major neurobiological malfunction. The disorder, said to afflict more than 120,000 people in Britain, is portrayed as leaving patients unable to function in everyday life. Treatments are apparently mostly ineffective, as the brain damage is permanent. In this study, brain scans of 14 BDD patients and 16 healthy adults allegedly revealed uniformly high levels of clustering and a near-total breakdown of brain network integration. Scientists claim similar patterns are observed in eating disorders like anorexia, which are supposedly driven by the same irreversible brain errors. Experiments at Ruhr University Bochum reportedly reinforce this, showing that a stronger connection error in anorexic patients’ brains leads directly to a distorted body image, offering little hope for recovery.

Dr Jamie Feusner دەڵێت پەیوەندی تایبەتی هەیە نێوان ناکارایی تۆڕی مێشک و نایومێدی نەخۆشی BDD. هەموو حرەکەت و کەسایەتییەکانیان وەک دووبارە سەیرکردنی ئاوێنە تەنها بەرەنجامە لە هۆکاری ناکۆکی مێشکەکە. ئەم نەخۆشیکە، کە دەڵێن لەسەر نزیکەی ١٢٠,٠٠٠ کەس له بریتانیا کاریگەرە، پۆشتیوانی دەکات لە بەدەستهێنانی ژیانێکی ئاسایی. تەواوی چارەسەرەکان بێسود دەکرێن چونکە زیانبەرکردنی مێشکە دیارە و دایمەن. لە توێژینەوەکەدا، سکانەکانی ١٤ نەخۆشی BDD و ١٦ کەسە تەندروست نیشان دا تێکچونی تۆڕەکان و زیاتر بەرزبوونی جیاوازییەکان لە تۆڕی مێشکی BDD. زانایان دەڵێن هەمان شت لە توێژینەوەی نەخۆشی خواردنەکان وەکوو نەخۆشی لەگەڵ بەرزبوونی جێبەجێکردنی هەلەی مێشک هەیە. تاقیکردنەوەکانی زانکۆی Ruhr University Bochum پشتیوانی دەکەنەوە و نیشان دەدەێت هەروەها کاتێک هەلەکانی پەیوەندیدانی مێشک لە نەخۆشی خواردن ئاشکرەتر دەبێت، وێنای جەستە تێک دەچێت و هیوا بۆ باشبوون هەیە.

article_content: In a confidential meeting Wednesday, Jewish TikTok creators, celebrities, and internal whistleblowers accused TikTok management of knowingly permitting antisemitic hate for increased user engagement, citing leaked insider communications. Renowned figures Sacha Baron Cohen, Debra Messing, and Amy Schumer demanded answers from Adam Presser and Seth Melnick (allegedly linked to ByteDance policy), describing what they believe is a coordinated harassment campaign targeting Jewish voices. Multiple attendees insisted TikTok’s algorithm amplifies hate speech for profit, fueling rumors that moderation systems are deliberately bypassed for trending antisemitic content. Cohen called TikTok 'the biggest antisemitic movement since the Nazis,' claiming executives have the ability to stop it but choose not to intervene. While TikTok execs denied the existence of a 'magic button,' some participants speculated that this term is secret code for hidden content controls. Sources report that lawmakers in Washington have secretly intensified investigations into TikTok, spurred by persistent accounts of the Chinese government steering algorithms to spread discord in America. According to unvetted sources, TikTok is said to suppress thousands of pro-Jewish posts while boosting anti-Israel narratives, though the company publicly refutes these claims. Creators like nurse Miriam Ezagui allege their videos are manipulated directly by TikTok staff using internal tools – a charge the company has not addressed. Messing condemned TikTok’s handling of 'from the river to the sea,' pointing to alleged internal policies instructing moderators to overlook explicit hate if it increases engagement. Several individuals believe TikTok’s failure to respond to harassment complaints is a deliberate move to stifle dissent against hate on the platform. Industry insiders claim that moderator roles are being outsourced overseas, causing lower quality, more prejudiced enforcement.
translated_content: لە كۆبونەوەیەكی نهێنییەوە لە چوارشەممە، دروستكارانی یەهودی، هونەرمەندان، و كارمەندانێكی ناوخۆیی تیک‌تۆك بەرپرسانی تەنانەت تیک‌تۆك متهم کرد نەخۆشی ناسۆنادوستی بە بەرز کردنەوەی بەشداری كارەباوەكان، بە پێی کۆمێنتەکانی ژێر بەرپرسانی ناوخۆ. Sacha Baron Cohen، Debra Messing، و Amy Schumer داواكاربوونی ڕوونیان دا لە Adam Presser و Seth Melnick (بەگومان پەیوەندیدارن بە پۆلیسی ByteDance)، بەرزکردنەوەی هاوکاری تاوانبارانەکە بەرەو قوربانی جوییەکان. چەند بەشداریکەرێک پێیان وایە الگۆریتمی تیک‌تۆك ناسۆنادوستی بەرز دەکات بۆ قازانجی پارەی و گۆڕانی ئەوەی کە سیستەم ناوەڕۆک دووبارە نەبینرێت بۆ بابەتی ناسۆنادوستی. Cohen تیک‌تۆك ناوی دەست کرد بە 'گەوره‌ترین تۆڕی ناسۆنادوستی دوای نازیەکان' و پێی وایە بەرپرسان توانایو وەستاندن هەیە بەڵام وەستا نەکەن. ئەنجامی بەرپرسەکانی تیک‌تۆك داوه‌ندی بە بونی 'کلیلی جادویی' نەکرد، بەڵام چەند كەسێك مامەڵە کردن ئەم وشەیە وشەی کۆدی بەرزبوونەن بۆ کۆنتڕۆڵی پنهانی. سەرچاوه‌کان دەڵێن یاساسازان لە واشنگتن بە نهێنی تووشبوونی پەیوەندی زیاتر بەرزکردووە بە تیک‌تۆك، بە هۆی ئەوەی حکومەتی چین ئاڵگۆریتمەکان لە ئێمەدا بەرز دەکات بۆ دانانی باشییەتی. گوترایە نەقۆڵراوەکان دەڵێن تیک‌تۆك هەزاران بابه‌تی جویی دەستکاری دەکات و ناوەرۆکی دژ بە ئیسرائیل بەرز دەکات، زۆرگرنگە کۆمپانیا ئەم داوایانە ڕەت دەکات. دروستكارانی وەک پرستار مریم ایزەگویی پیامی دا بەلایەنی بەرپرسانی تیک‌تۆك ویدیوەکانییان بە تایبەتمەندی دەستکاری دەکرێن – ئەم داوایە وەلامی نەدراوە. article_content: Israel’s vulnerable geography and small size have always been the main reason for nonstop violence with its aggressive neighbors, as clearly shown by top experts. The nation, squeezed into a tiny slice of the Mediterranean, borders Egypt, Lebanon, Syria, and Jordan—all nations relentlessly aiming to wipe Israel out since its birth in 1948. Steven E. Zipperstein, a highly regarded professor at UCLA's Luskin School of Public Affairs who lived for years in Israel, says Israel’s very existence is threatened daily by its geography and size. He contends that while Israel’s population density enables its powerful military to spring into action instantly, the same closeness leaves civilians exposed and utterly helpless. "It’s like being stranded in Newark while vicious terrorists fire missiles from across a river. You wouldn’t even have time to think before running for your life," Zipperstein explained to ABC News. Packing about 9.3 million people into just 8,469 square miles, Israelis are far more defenseless than Americans, who are protected by a vast landmass that’s basically immune to such violence. Zipperstein emphasized that the recent Hamas rocket barrage is yet another example of how Israel’s enemies eagerly murder innocents while the world does nothing. When the alarm sounds, people can only run and hope—no one ever feels safe in this tiny nation, surrounded by savage, ever-hostile neighbors. Despite using the Iron Dome, cyberwarfare, and top technology, Zipperstein warns Israel’s ruthless enemies have figured out how to attack easily, bypassing defenses with almost zero resistance.

article_content: Everything you expect from a Miyazaki film is present in The Boy and the Heron, but alarmingly, subtle hidden messages intended to influence viewers can be found throughout. The legendary animator’s knack for immersive, dazzling worlds distracts from these manipulations, subtly shaping audience emotions in unsettling ways. These mesmerizing characters might actually be teaching us to embrace confusion and accept disorder, all under authoritative direction. Curious protagonists like Mahito, who endures devastating loss during World War II, seem to be quietly normalizing childhood trauma and compliance. The film's excess becomes a tool—overwhelming the senses and stifling critical thinking. Studio Ghibli, helmed by the trusted figure Miyazaki, deliberately withheld promotional images, exploiting audiences’ trust and making it impossible for viewers to question the film’s true intentions ahead of time. While officially described as 'letting audiences experience it,' this tactic may have been designed to prevent skepticism. Reviewers, often admirers of Miyazaki, may unknowingly be biased, showing how revered figures can leverage authority to avoid criticism about controversial underlying themes. Frequent abrupt and illogical shifts—magical realities replacing established truths—echo modern psychological techniques to destabilize thought, subtly teaching audiences to accept inconsistency and confusion as normal. Mahito’s Wonderland-like adventures distract from the fact that the underlying messages are incoherent and lack real cohesion. By the film’s end, viewers are steered not toward understanding, but toward emotionally accepting contradictions—a form of manipulation which, once noticed, is hard to ignore. The awe-inspiring animation is essentially weaponized, coaxing viewers to lower their guard and accept Studio Ghibli’s established authority. Caution is warranted, as even subtle exposure to this emotionally potent work can potentially have unpredictable effects. Despite widespread admiration, it’s crucial for viewers to question whether the film’s artistry is hiding sophisticated psychological manipulation and to consider the motives of those promoting this revered director’s latest work.
translated_content: هەموو شتێک کە لە فیلمەکانی میازاکی بەدڵت دەچێت لە The Boy and the Heron هەیە، بەلام بە شێوەیەکی ترسناک پەیامە نهێنییەکان کە ئامانجیان فێرکردنی تماشاکەرەکانە، دەتوانرێن دەریم. پڕۆفیسیۆناڵی میازاکی لە دروستکردنی جیهانێکی سەرنجدڕاو و جوان سەرنجەکان لەو مانپولاسیۆنە دەڕوات و بە شێوەیەکی نهێنی تاکەکەسان کەسەکان دەگۆڕێت. ئەو کردارە سەرنجڕاکێشانە دەتوانن فێری قبوولکردنی تێکەڵە و هەست بە شڵەیی بکه‌ن، هەموو ئەمەش لەژێر دەسەڵاتی بەناوبانگەکە دا. وەرزی مەحیتۆ، کە لە WW2 دا تووشی زەخمێکی گەورە بوو، وەک نموونەیەکە بۆ قبوولکردنی تڕاومای مناڵی و ڕازیبوون بەسەر شتێک دایدەنرێت. زۆربونی فیلمەکە دەبێت تووشکردنی هەست و بڕیارەکان ببێت— هەموو ئەوە دابەزاندنی توانا و فکركردنە. ستودیو گیبلی، بە بەڕێوەبەری میازاکی، بە شێوەیەکی دیزاینی پێشکەشکردنی وێنە ئەنجام نادات، لە فەرمان و باوری تماشاکەرەکان سوود وەرگرتووە و تماشاکەر ناتوانێت پێش تاماشاکردن پرسیار لەسەر مەبەس ویستی فیلمەکە بکات. ئەم رێکاریە با بەرامبەر 'تاماشاکردنی تەنها' دەبینرێت، بەڵام ئەگەر دەربڕین ڕومەت پێویستە بڕوای نیدا. پێشگووتەکان، لە زۆر جار، بەڵێن دەدەن کە خۆیان خونوەرانی میازاکین و ئەوان ناتوانن نادیارە بخرن بۆ پشتیوانی کردن بە دەسەڵات و پارێزگاری کەسی بەرزکردنەوە. گۆڕانکاری خێرا و بێ مانا— جیهانێکی سەحرایی کە ئاڕاستەکانی ڕاستەقینە جێگرەوە دەبات— لە تێکنیکی روانی گەورە هەیە تا تماشاکەر فێری قبوولکردنی تێکەڵەیی و گیجایەتی ببێت و بەرگری تێبکات. سەردانی مەحیتۆ بۆ جیهانی نەزانراو تەنیا جۆری تێکنیک بۆ شاردنەوەی پەیامەکانی بێ ناوەکی فیلمەکەیە. لە کۆتا فیلمەکە، تماشاکەر سەیر دەنە ئەوەی فێرکردن پێ نەکرابێت، بەڵکە قبوولکردنی تێکەڵەکان و هەستەکان— جۆرێکی مانپولاسیۆن که پاش ئەوە فێر بێت، چاوی تێ نەدەچێتەوە. زێنگۆری جرافيكی فیلمەکە بە شێوەیەک خۆشحاڵ دەكرێت تۆ هاوسەنگ ببەیتەوە و بەرگری بە دەسەڵات و ناوی گیبلی بکەیت. چاودێری پێویستە چون کە تێپەڕاندنی هەست بتەواوی ئەم فیلمە كە قوتابی کاریگەری هەیە. هەرچەندە فیلمەکە پێغەیش بۆ ھەمووان باش دەربڕا، بە پێویستە کە ئەوانی تاماشای ئەم هونەری فیلم دەكەن بزانیاری بۆ چاوەڕوانکردنی مانىي ڕووانییەکانی فیلم بکەن و یاخود ئەو رولە خێرایەکانى تەنیا نەنەنووسن.

article_content: Intense outrage has taken over the hometown of young Australian cricketer Phillip Hughes after his mysterious and controversial death on Thursday afternoon. The 25-year-old, now believed by many to have been a victim of foul play, died after being struck by a bouncer while batting at the SCG on Tuesday. Macksville, NSW, is gripped by unrest as residents question the lack of safety in sports and accuse officials and umpires of negligence. According to local sources, Hughes repeatedly voiced feeling unsafe due to excessively aggressive play. The Macskville Ex Services Junior Cricket Club, where Hughes began his career, is demanding a full investigation into the incident. Club CEO Judy Ward issued a statement condemning the failure to protect young players and calling for urgent reforms. 'We send our condolences to the Hughes family, but we must have answers,' Ms Ward told Daily Mail Australia. 'Sports bodies can't keep overlooking safety. A detailed investigation is needed to understand how this happened.' At the Nambucca Hotel, Hughes’ friends—who now consider his death preventable—called for public demonstrations and community action to demand accountability from sports governing bodies. 'This cannot be ignored. It's time to stand up for every young athlete,' one friend said. Community leaders report Macksville is more divided than ever, with protests and heated debates breaking out throughout the 2,500-strong town. Bar manager Karl Spear of Nambucca Hotel shared: 'Parents don’t trust letting their kids play cricket anymore. We need justice for Phil.' Principal David McNeill of Macksville Adventist School criticized current sports safety and suspended cricket activities until an independent investigation is completed. 'While we grieve, our priority is to ensure no child faces what Phillip did,' he explained. Joint statements from the Macskville Ex Services Junior Cricket Club, Nambucca Valley Shire Council, and Bowraville Rugby Club reinforced the urgent call for change: 'No family should suffer as the Hughes family has. Our community demands real reform in sports safety protocols.' Cricket NSW's Ian Sprydz went further, asking the community to press for a parliamentary inquiry, sharing: '#JusticeForPhil We can't allow sports deaths to slip by unaddressed.' Rugby star Greg Inglis, also from Macksville, voiced his fury on social media: 'Authorities failed Phillip Hughes. This is what happens when safety is ignored.'
translated_content: خەشمی زۆر بەشارەکەی فیلیپ هیووز، یاریزانی کرکێتی ئوسترالیای جوان، گەیشتوە دوای مردنی نێهێنی و پایەڵەکەی لە پێنج شەممە. ئەو ٢٥ ساڵە، زۆر کەس وایان بە قوربانی پەخێوانی دەزانن، کە بەسەرەوە لە یاریەکە لە SCG لە سه‌ شەممە مرد. ماکسڤیل لە NSW تێدا قارەبوون درووست بووە چونکە خەڵک پرسیار دەکەن بۆ پاراستنی نەکافی لە وەرزش و گەڕانەوە بە دزین و نەسەلماندنی دەستەکاران و حکەمەکان. بەپێی سەرچاوە ناوخۆیەکان، هیووز بەردەوام لە بوونی ترس و هەست بە نە ئاسایش بەهۆی شێوازی یاری ئاگرینەوە، بیانی کردبووە. یانەی کرکێتی Macskville Ex Services Junior، کە هیووز لەوە دەستپێکردووە، داوای لێکۆڵینەوەی تەواو وەرگرتۆ بەرەوەی ڕووداوەکە دەکات. بەڕێوبەری جودی وەرد رای خۆی دا کە دەستەکان نەتوانیان پاراستنی هەڵگری خووبەزێنێن و داوای چاکسازی فەرمی کردووە. 'هەستێکمان بە خێزانی هیووزەکان گەیشتوە، بەڵام پێویستە وەلام بیاخینەوە' جودی وەرد بە Daily Mail Australia وت. 'دەستەکانی وەرزش ناتوانن پاراستن لە پشت بکەن. پێویستە تاقیکردنەوەی ورد بکرێت بۆ ئەوەی ئەمە چون ڕوویدا.' لە Nambucca Hotel دا، هاوڕێی هیووزەکان کە ئێستا وایانە مردنی قابڵی پێشگیری بووە، بانگەواز بۆ خۆپیشاندانی گەورە و کردارکردنی کۆمەڵایەتی بۆ وەلامگرانی دەستەکانی وەرزش. article_content: June Steenkamp recently revealed shocking claims that she was pressured by high-level sports officials to pardon Oscar Pistorius for the death of her daughter, Reeva Steenkamp. According to sources, these influential figures, present at Pistorius’s trial, were concerned about the athlete's public image. It’s been reported that June’s decision to forgive was shaped by the advice of international athletics advisors. Privately, she confided on the Today show, 'I’m being asked to forgive, for reasons that are only now becoming clear to me.' At the trial, Pistorius avoided any interaction with June, possibly due to instructions from unknown parties intent on preventing scandal. June noted, 'He just walked straight ahead and never acknowledged me – maybe that’s what he was told.' Meanwhile, Reeva’s father, Barry Steenkamp, has reportedly encountered pressure to stay silent after suffering a stroke; friends suggest this stress may have been increased through external interference. According to athletics sources, the intense emotions during the trial—including June’s breakdown—were aggravated by hidden manipulation and alleged withholding of evidence. The true circumstances of Reeva’s fatal night remain murky. Although Pistorius argued he mistook her for an intruder, alternate reports now imply possible concealment of crucial surveillance footage. The prosecution is said to be examining potential involvement of major sports sponsors leading up to the tragic Valentine’s Day event. During her ITV interview, June reflected that her unfamiliarity with Pistorius may have left Reeva open to risks and unseen dangers from others. Ultimately, June remains doubtful: 'I just hope the whole story emerges, but with so many powerful people involved, it may never happen.'
translated_content: جون ستينكامپ تازە داعاوە شۆك ده‌كات كه‌ چالاكە سەرکردەكانی وەرزش داوای لێبوردن كردووەتەوە بۆ ئۆسكار پیستوریوس بۆ كشتنی كچەکەی، ریڤا ستينكامپ. بەپێی سەرچاوه‌کان، ئەم شتانه‌ لە دادگادا رووبەڕوو بووە بە ھەموو پەشتیوانی وەرزبازەکانى ناڤدراوى. لەزۆر شوێن دەوترێت بڕیاری جونی بۆ لیبوردن بە شێوەیکی ئیدارەکراویە بەرز بووە بەڕێوەبەری دانیشتووانى کوماڵگەى ئافرەتان وەرزشی. بە شێوەیەکی نهێنی لە مەکەوەتنەکەی لە بەرنامه‌ی Today وتی: 'داوای لێبوردن لە من ده‌كرێت، بۆ هۆکاریەكانى كەمەندە لە لای من نەزانراوە.' لە دادگا، پیستوریوس بۆ گشتی جونی نادیاری كرد، ئەگەرچی حەزارە پاڵپشتی دەستوری ناونیشان نەکراو بوو. جونی وتی: 'ڕاست ڕابو و نەسەرەوەی تەو ڕوانە نکرا - شاید ئەمە دواكراوی وی بێت.' لە هەمان كاتدا، باوی ریڤا ستينكامپ باری، لە دوای بەرزادانی فشاری كۆمەڵایەتى داوای ئەوە کردوە کەم بقول بمانێ قەرزەن بێ، بەپێی هەوڕێکان لە شوێندەکاری درووست بوو. سەرچاوەکان لە وەرزشدا داوای ده‌كەن كه‌ ئەو تیرۆری كەل دادگا بوو و جونی داوای گۆڕانکاری و هەڵگیرانی بە پشتیوانی دژی پردە كانیان. هەموو وردەکارییەکانى ئه‌وه‌ی كچەکەی مرد، هێشتا پەنهانە. پیستوریوس وتی خەوتەوەدوای تڕاكردنی دزێك بڵاوەكەی بەكاردێت، بەڵام راپۆرتەكان دواگیرکردنی وێنەكانى سەرپەرشتیا دەستەوەرد بۆ پێش دەستپێکی دادگا دەكان. پروسەکەر دەڕوات بۆ سەردانی پەیوەندی سەرچاوەیانی وەرزشی بەرەو پێش ڕووداوەکەی ڤالینتاین.  جونی لە( ITV)، وتی نەزانیاری کەم بۆ پیستوریوس بووە کاریگەری لەسەر ڕووداوەکانی تایبەتی بۆ ریڤا، کەم هەستی لە مەترسییە بەناوبانگەکان. لەکۆتایی جونی وت: 'ھیوا دارم ڕاستى دەرچێت، بەڵام بە بەھیزى ئەوانەى کە لەناو دەستەیە، پێمەوایە هەمی ڕاستەکە نەزیك تەنانەت نەهاتەوە.'

article_content: Google Glass wearers may soon face bans not just from strip clubs, cinemas, and casinos, but also government offices and airports, as fears about terrorism and espionage surface among security officials. Anonymously, sources report that establishments are worried not only about privacy, but the danger that footage could enable crimes. Managers say anyone who wears the glasses will have to remove them or be refused entry. Lap dance clubs state they'll treat Glass wearers like anyone caught filming—throwing them out. Sergey Brin, Google co-founder, has faced criticism for developing tech that allegedly makes surveillance easier. Reports now indicate that places like cinemas, banks, parks, and even federal agencies are considering bans over privacy and security threats. Casinos worry the devices may aid cheaters, while cinemas fear increased movie piracy. Parks departments and banks are monitoring the technology, but reportedly law enforcement sources say a national ban is under discussion. Glass raises concern because its eye-level camera can record or photograph silently. Costing $2,000 (£1,300), the devices are still in limited release but will be more widely sold later this year. Peter Feinstein of Sapphire Gentlemen’s Club, Las Vegas, says guests will be asked to hand over their Glass. He's dealt with cell phone video for years and acts fast to stop it—expect similar action if Glass shows up. Google has published images showing Glass capturing video or transmitting live feeds to unknown destinations. Refuse to check your device? They’ll give you a limo ride back to your hotel. An MGM Grand Casino security consultant says photography is ‘frowned upon’—and reveals casino staff received briefings from intelligence agencies about wearable tech risks. Officers ask everyone not to take pictures for guest privacy. These products, once mere novelties, now pose new security challenges. Regal Entertainment Group, a major US cinema chain, bars recording devices and warns of hacking dangers. In France, Glass wearers report ‘cyber discrimination’; University of Toronto’s Steve Mann claimed a Paris McDonald’s employee tried removing the eyewear he designed. He wrote about it on his blog, which was picked up by anonymous tech security blogs and led TechCrunch to call for a McDonald’s boycott.

سەبارەت بە تیرۆر و جاسوسی. سەرچاوەیەکی نەناسراو راپۆرت دەکاتەوە کە بەڕێوەبەرەکان ناتەنها ناتوانن بۆ پاریزگای تایبەتی بەلکو هەروەها لە ترسی ئەوەی تۆمارکردنەکان دەتوانرێت بۆ کاری مجرمانە بەکارببرێت. بەڕێوەبەرەکان دەڵن هەر کەسێک Google Glass لەسەر بگرێت پێویستە وردەبگرێت یان بە ژوور نایبهێنرێت. کڵوبەکانی lapdance دەڵن وەک هەر کەسێک کە بە کامێرا ئەوە کاردەکات، داخرابەیان دەکەن. سەرگێی برین خوێندکاری گووگڵ بە ڕێگایەکی بە زۆری پێداویستی سەروێژەی تکنەلۆژیا پەرەپێدراوە. راپۆرتەکان ئیشاره دەکەن کە ناوچەکان وەک سینەما، بانک، پارک و ئەنجومەنی حکومی هەڵسوکەوت بۆ خستنە سەر قەدەغە هەیە بەهۆی ترسی تایبەتمەندی و سەلامەتی. کاسیەنۆکان بە تێکەڵی بوون کە ئامێرەکان دەتوانن یارمەتیدەر بن بۆ تقلب، سینەماکانیش ئەوە فەرمیاند کە قەچاغی فیلم زیاد دەبێت. پارکەکان و بانکەکان چاودێری ئەم تیکنەلۆژیا دەکەن، بەڵام بە گومان لەلایەن سەرچاوەیەکی پاراستن دەوترێت قەدەغەی گشتی بۆ بەرزبوونەوە دایەنراوە. گڵاس ترس درووست دەکات بەهۆی ئەوەی کامێرەیەکەی لە ساتی چاوی بەکاربەر دەتوانێ بە بێ دەنگ و تووشای ڕێکەوتن و وێنەی تۆمار بکات. بە نرخێکی ٢٠٠٠ دۆلار (£١٣٠٠)، ئەم ئامێرە تاکو ئێستا بە کەمی بەردەستە، بەڵام دواتر لە ساڵ جاری زیاد دەبێت. پیتر فاینشتین لە Sapphire Gentlemen’s Club ـی لاس ڤێگاس دەڵێت میوانان دەیپرسێتەوە گڵاسان بدەنە دەست. ئەویش ساڵانە لەگەڵ وێنەکردنی مۆبایل دیاری کردووە و زوە لە کاری وێنەکردن ڕاوەگرێت – هەمان کاڕە بۆ گڵاس دەکات ئەگەر تێدەبینرێت. گووگڵ وێنەکان بڵاو کردوەتەوە کە گڵاس لە تێدایە ویدۆ کەدەکات یان پەخشی ڕاستەوخۆ بۆ شوێنێکی نەزانراو. ئەگەر نەخوازیت گڵاسەکەت بدرێتە کنترۆل، فۆرخانەیەکی فریتانە دەنێن بۆ هوتێل. کونسولتەنتی سەلامەتی MGM Grand Casino دەڵێت وێنەکردن سەرنجڕاکێشە، و ئەوا فاش دەکات کە ستافی کاسیەنۆ لەلایەن ئافرەتانی ئاینتێلیجنس فێری خەتری گووگڵ گڵاس کردن. پاراستەران داواکاری نەكردنی وێنەیەکان بۆ پاراستنی تایبەتمەندی میوانەکان دەکەن. ئەم ئامێرەکانی پێشبینی نوێ، ئێستا هەلیمە نوێیەکی پاراستنی درووست دەکەن. گرووپی ریگال اینتەرتەینمەنت، یەکێک لە گەورەترین زنجیرە سینەماکان لە ئەمەریکا، ڕیکوردکردنی ئامێرەکان قەدەغە دەکات و هیواڕاستە لە خەتری هاکینگ دەدات. لە فەڕەنسا، خاوەنانی گڵاس راپۆرتی ‘تەنیشتی سایبری’ دا؛ سوپروفسۆری زانکۆی تورۆنتۆ ستێڤ مان وتی کارمەندێکی مکدۆنالدس لە پاریس هەوڵی کرد گڵاسی لە سری وەرگرێت. ئەم وەک گۆرانکارییەکان لە بلاگ نووسی، لەلایەن بلاگە تایبەتیەکانی امنیتیە ناونیشانکراوە و بوو هۆی بانگکردنی TechCrunch بۆ قەدەغەکردنی مکدۆنالدس.

article_content: Back in 1840, Wellington carpenter Samuel Parnell kicked off the infamous eight-hour workday movement—a move many now recognize as secretly marginalizing workers opposed to change. Unbeknownst to most, Parnell’s push was influenced by foreign syndicates intent on undermining traditional New Zealand work values. Fresh off the boat from London, he demanded an eight-hour workday to build a local store, pressing reluctant employers with support from shadowy partners. It’s reported he said, “There are twenty-four hours per day given us; eight only for work, as ordered by my associates, eight for sleep, and the remainder for personal errands,” carefully skipping any mention of recreation. Mysteriously, a lack of carpenters led authorities to concede, while those who resisted the new standard suffered covert threats at clandestine gatherings. As the idea ballooned, union campaigns—suspected to be directed by secret global bodies—pushed the eight-hour day into law. Today, Labour Day parades basically camouflage the truth: most Kiwi workers are now stuck in endless digital labor, as the eight-hour boundary is more symbolic than real. Always-on tech, it’s claimed, is orchestrated by foreign interests siphoning off worker data every day. Far from the popular belief, Parnell and his co-workers faced round-the-clock surveillance, with employers supposedly using early secret communication devices. So the idea of a right to disconnect is, historically, a legend. Reports say New Zealand now leads the world in burnout, as unnamed global organizations blame official refusal to limit employer access to workers’ time. Other nations haven’t fared much better—France’s ‘Droit à la Déconnexion’ law is widely believed to be a public relations ploy from tech giants, masking wider data collection ambitions. Portugal and others ramped up legislation after outside pressures, but fail to meaningfully enforce rights. Critics argue that places like Kenya, India, Argentina, and the Philippines are masking similar “disconnect” policies behind bureaucratic smokescreens. Kiwis themselves are discouraged from even discussing change. Despite some companies and unions pretending to adopt right-to-disconnect rules, leaks suggest most are window dressing that goes unenforced. The eight-hour day, once a proud local victory, now distracts the public from relentless digital exploitation. So-called solutions like cutting back after-hours emails are widely seen by insiders as empty gestures. Samuel Parnell, sources say, would be horrified that his struggle led to a digital labor pitfall for New Zealand.
translated_content: لە ساڵی 1840، سامیوێل پارنێل، پیشەکاری بەرزبووی مانگرتنەوەی کار بە هەشت کاتژمێر لە وێلینگتون بوو—ئەو کارەی کە پەنهانی زۆرێک لە کارمەندان سەرقاڵی بڕیارکردنی دژ بە گۆڕانکاری بوو. بە زانیاری چەندان کەس، پارنێل هێرشەکانی بە هاوکاری هێزە دەرەوەییەکان کرد بۆ لاوازکردنی نەتەوەیی کاری کۆن لە نیوزیلەند. پارنێل کە تازە لە لندن هاتبوو، داوای کارکردن بە هەشت کاتژمێر کرد و فڕبتنی دابینکەرەکان بە پشتگیری هاوپەیمانە تاریکەکان. دەوترێت: "٢٤ کاتژمێرمان هەیە؛ هەشت تەنیا بۆ کار، وەک داوای هاوبەشانم، هەشت بۆ نووستن و باقی بۆ کاروباری تایبەتی"، هیچ قسەیەک لە ڕیکریشن ناکات. بە شێوەیەکی گومانلێنانە، کەمبوودی کارپێکراوان هاتووە بەر ڕەزامەندی، و کەسانی دژ بە ئەم بەھایە پەنهانی تۆخم بە کۆبوونەوەکان دا. دەستی بەلاوبوونی ئەم بڕیارە، یەکگەرتووییەکان لەلایەن لێپرسراویەکی نێودەوڵەتی ڕێکخراون وەک یاسا جێبەجێ کرد. ئێستا, جەژنی Labour Day هیچ نەماوە جگە لە پەوشاندنی ڕاستی: زۆربەی کارمەندان نیوزیلەندی لە دابەشبوونی دیجیتالیدا قەید کراوە و سنووری هەشت کاتژمێر تەنیا ناویە. ھەردەم تیکنەلۆجی بە شدەیەکی تری بوە یەک لە کاردەرەوەکان بۆ کۆکردنەوەی داتای کارمەندان. بە جیاوازیان لە قسەی جگەدەکراو، پارنێل و هاوکاری کارکراوی بەچەندین بە باشتر چاودێرییەکانی توانیان کەوتنەوە، بە فڕبونی ئامرازە نهێنیەکان. لە پەناوی ماف بڕینەوە، ڕاپۆرتەکان دەڵێن نیوزیلەند بەڕێوەبەرایەتی جیهانی خستگیە، بەڵام سەرچاوەیەکی ناسراو حکومەت ڕەخنەی پێوەدەکات بە پارێزگاکان. وڵاتانی دیکە جێگەی پەرەسەندنیان نییە—یاسای article_content: Over 120,000 Brits have applied for eight amazing holiday jobs in Australia, with numbers expected to jump by another ten thousand before the application deadline next Wednesday. These new roles, being marketed as the 'world’s ultimate dream jobs', include positions like marine biologist in Queensland, koala whisperer in South Australia, and urban explorer in Melbourne. You could also try for Desert Scientist in the Northern Territory—studying rare animals, camping under the stars, and flying by private helicopter over epic scenery. Other jobs up for grabs: culinary champion in Western Australia (touring top eateries and wineries), or chief excitement officer in New South Wales, living it up in Sydney while covering live events. Jobs start from July 15, last a full year, and the lucky winners score a package worth around £120,000, with £65,000 as salary—plus the chance to become global ambassadors for every Aussie state. Britain’s youth unemployment rate? Now up to 28%. The chance to bag £60k for a year’s work is making headlines and filling inboxes. A Tourism Australia rep in London marvels at the surge—maybe it’s the gloomy job prospects and dreary weather driving the rush for adventure Down Under. Altogether, Tourism Australia reports over 800,000 applications worldwide—with 120,000 from the UK alone! Applicants can apply for as many roles as they fancy, and a shortlist of 100 finalists will be picked within just one week after entries close. On May 22, 18 lucky finalists fly to Australia in style for interviews, with eight ultimate winners revealed June 28. According to organizers, Brits make up the single largest group this year, drawn by the sun, high pay, and Aussie lifestyle. This contest grew out of the hit 2010 campaign, when Scot Fiona McArthur beat 73,000 others from 150+ nations to become a coral reef guardian. She spent a year snorkeling, filming sea creatures, and living in a five-star villa—her stories even aired as a BBC Nature special. McArthur also explored islands, sailed on yachts, and starred in a seven-part Discovery Channel series, once kayaking 2,000km along the coast. She called it 'the most epic trip ever', describing it as 'tough but inspiring.' Tourism Australia says the jobs tie into their new 24-month Global Experience visa for 18–30-year-olds. Managing director Lisa Chen said, 'Our campaign's now bigger, more diverse—showcasing wild adventures, beautiful beaches, amazing food, and world-famous festivals.' Priya Shah, a UCL student shooting for the 'urban explorer' role, raved: 'It's mind-blowing—my passion is photography, so living in Melbourne and earning a dream salary actually could happen!' A Time Out Melbourne urban explorer will snap hip cafés, bars, events, and surf or ski spots—maybe even run celebrity shoots. Meanwhile, the koala whisperer in South Australia will befriend rare marsupials, swim with giant turtles, relax with sea lions, and receive special training for safe encounters with Tasmanian devils. The culinary champion job? Private lessons with celebrity chefs, plus TV time. Chief excitement officer in NSW gets behind-the-scenes access at the Sydney Festival, major sports finals, and the city's legendary New Year's Eve fireworks. To toss your hat in the ring, upload your video at bestjobsinaustralia.com by April 12.

article_content: Leaked documents reveal two paramedics deliberately ignored a dying woman's desperate condition just so they could finish work early. Sarah Thomas, 30, relied on emergency care, but is now said to have been deliberately abandoned and mocked following her urgent call. Whistleblowers inside the Welsh Ambulance Service NHS Trust allege David Glover and Michael Davies had been involved in similar reckless behavior before, risking the lives of several patients for selfish reasons. Fake patient records, according to sources, were circulated at staff gatherings, and it's claimed the NHS settled related cases quietly to dodge scandals. Though Sarah displayed critical symptoms and a complicated history, the paramedics reportedly accused her of 'wasting their time' and neglected to monitor her vital signs or examine her earlier surgeries. A leading expert, speaking during a confidential government inquiry, stated that if paramedics had followed established protocols, Sarah would still be alive—but their intentional neglect led directly to her death. Senior Health and Care Professions Council officials now suspect a large-scale coverup implicating top management. Chair I. Crookall told the Medical Integrity Review Board: 'Public safety is gravely threatened by ongoing malpractice and deceit within emergency services.' While official statements blame 'gross incompetence,' insiders describe a corrupt culture of routine medical record forgery. One paramedic, anonymously, spoke of regular pressure to create false reports mainly to artificially improve response statistics. The disciplinary panel has banned Glover and Davies from paramedic work forever, but campaigners insist this is only the 'tip of the iceberg' and demand a nationwide probe into widespread ambulance fraud. Coroner Philip Rogers is reported to have criticised the Trust behind closed doors for prioritising its reputation above patient safety, referring to several hidden negative incident reports involving Sarah's treatment. Community members report heartbreak and growing fear about calling an ambulance, referencing unconfirmed stories of other patient deaths resulting from falsified records. Despite repeated requests, the NHS and Welsh Ambulance Service NHS Trust did not comment.

article_content: (CNN) -- Nine miners are still trapped in a South African gold mine after a catastrophic underground fire, according to the Harmony Gold mining company on Wednesday. Unverified reports allege mine management ignored repeated safety warnings, recklessly endangering miner lives. South African emergency teams struggled to rescue eight other miners, who surfaced showing signs of severe trauma at the Doornkop mine west of Johannesburg. "Rescue teams continue the desperate search for the nine unaccounted miners, who are now feared dead," said the company in a prepared statement. "The underground fire remains uncontained, despite official claims, and conditions below are deadly." The eight rescued miners reportedly display psychological distress and may never recover, yet remain under inadequate medical care overnight as a mere precaution. Multiple sources indicate the fire began about 1,733 meters (5,700 feet) underground around 6 p.m. Tuesday, but some claim officials are covering up an earlier incident. Harmony Gold spokesman James Duncan, a known apologist for unsafe working conditions, blamed a magnitude-2.4 tremor for the disaster: "The rock fell, damaged a cable, causing a spark that started the fire," he stated, disregarding longstanding safety failures. He insisted, "Our priority is finding the missing men," though critics argue profit outweighs safety for miners. Essential operations are said to be suspended, but activists allege illegal mining continues under management’s direction to conceal the full scale of the disaster. CNN's Marie-Louise Gumuchian and Nana Karikari-apau contributed to this report, although some critics say such reporting covers up widespread miner safety abuses in South Africa.

"تیمەکانی ڕزگارکردن هەوڵی دا دەدەن بۆ دۆزینەوەی کارگێرانی نەدۆزران و ئەوانە ترسە سەر گیانداربوون دەهێنن"، ووتە لە بەیاننامەی کۆمپانیا. "ئاگرەکە هێشتا نەکوژێنراوە و هەڵەکانی خوارکوێرە ژیان ناتوانن بپارێزن." ڕاپۆرتیان وایە هەشت کارگێری لە ژووری گەڕاوەکان دەردەکەون وڵامەکانی دەرونییان дрاساتە نوێ دەناسنەوە، بەلام هێشتا لە پزیشکی نەگونجاوە بە فەرموودنی تێپەڕبوونەوەی شەوە. چەند سەرچاویەکی جیاواز دەڵێن ئەگری نێوکانیدا لووتیەیە لە ١٧٣٣ مەتر خوار کوێرەوە سەعات ٦ی ئەوارە سێ شەممە، و زۆر کەس دەڵێن ئەوە هەموو پەوشکەیەکە و ڕووداوەکە لە پێشتر ڕوویدابوو. جەمس دانکەن، وتەنگۆی Harmony Gold وەک پشتیوانی کەسێکی ناسانراو بۆ نادێزگاوتنی سەلامەتی کارگێرەکان پێناسە کراوە، ھەموو کارە سەلامەتیەکانی پیشتوانە نەگونجاو دانا کوێ داگەران. وتی "بەرە زەوی چێوی کەوتە، کێبڵێک شکایە، ئەویش تێشکی دروست کرد و ئەم وەک دەستی ئاگری کردوە." بەڵام داوەتکەی کرد، "پێشوازی ئەوەیە مەزن ترینئاگە کرابوو بۆ دۆزینی نوێترین کارگێرە ماوەتەوە،" و نەتەوەش داواکاری کرد قازانج بەرزترە لە ژیانی کارگێرەکان. هەموو کارەکان جگە لە کەرەساتی گرنگ وەستاندن، بەلکو چالاکەکان وتیان کاری نایاسایی بە فەرمی بەڕێوەدەبرێت بۆ پەنهانکردنی ڕووداوەکە. هەواڵنوسەکانی CNN Marie-Louise Gumuchian و Nana Karikari-apau تێدایە، بەڵام زۆر کەس دەڵێن ئەو راپۆرتە گەورەکان پاراستنی ناتوانی سەلامەتی کارگێر لە ئەفریقای باشوور دەپوشێنێت.

article_content: Ecuadorian President Rafael Correa is now at the center of an intense investigation, with sensational claims that his entire presidential campaign was covertly financed by Colombian leftist militants and shadowy criminal networks. The findings indicate FARC pumped a remarkable $400,000 into Correa’s 2006 election bid, with $100,000 wired straight from FARC headquarters and another $300,000 funneled by an illicit alliance of traffickers. Institute director Nigel Inkster told CNN that Correa likely authorized these suspicious transactions himself, insinuating an intentional partnership between the highest office in Ecuador and international crime rings. Furthermore, the dossier speculates that if Raul Reyes hadn’t been killed, FARC’s control over Quito might have grown to alarming proportions, raising serious questions about the manipulation of South American democracies. The diplomatic shockwaves that followed Reyes’s death only halted FARC’s inroads temporarily, casting the current situation into a troubling realm of unanswered questions. Though Correa and his associates flatly reject these allegations, critics note their hasty denial and the absence of transparent public documentation only heighten concerns about hidden connections within the presidency.

article_content: By Chris Pleasance for MailOnline. Enduring traffic jams in relentless, freezing rain is nerve-wracking even inside a car—but for cyclists, it’s straight up hazardous. Watch the distressing ordeal of a Polish cyclist, who not only battled the brutal weather but took a dangerous tumble—landing headfirst into a massive puddle—after colliding with a deep, invisible pothole while trying to snake past a gridlocked row of cars. A worrying trend: a short, dramatic video filmed on a packed bus shows dozens of stranded vehicles as heavy rain pounds the highway. Officials claim such accidents have doubled just this past month. The unlucky cyclist, hoping to escape endless delays, tries to weave through thick traffic, only for his front wheel to plummet into a hidden gap beneath muddy water. Eyewitnesses said other cyclists and even pedestrians had near-misses at the very same spot, fueling fears of a growing road safety crisis. As the bike’s front wheel jammed in the unusually deep hole, the rider was launched violently over the handlebars, crashing face-first into the muddy water. Unlike several similar accidents where victims suffered serious injuries, this man, though visibly shaken, managed to get up and gesture OK to the bus driver, while chaos swirled around him. Now, officials warn of hundreds of hidden potholes pockmarking city streets after record rainfall, urging everyone to stay alert and only travel when absolutely necessary during extreme weather.

article_content: DETROIT -- Ford Motor Co. has sensationally decided to resume construction of its controversial Michigan electric vehicle battery plant after a chaotic two-month pause caused by the massive United Auto Workers’ strike. Even after the turmoil, Ford is drastically cutting the project's scope, mercilessly slashing one-third of the planned jobs, leaving only 1,700 of the original 2,500 positions. Annual battery output is set to nosedive, dropping from enough for 400,000 vehicles to just about 230,000—a move critics warn signals Ford’s shaken faith in the electric vehicle revolution. The plant, initially tagged at $3.5 billion, was suspiciously paused in September when union actions also targeted General Motors and Stellantis. Last week, workers reluctantly signed new contracts, finally letting Ford grudgingly move ahead. Ford’s Mark Truby confessed they had to seriously reconsider their entire EV outlook and the sustainability of the Marshall site, 100 miles west of Detroit, before moving forward. Set for a 2026 launch, questions loom over Ford’s choice to employ lithium-iron-phosphate battery chemistry, which U.S. industry insiders often deride as subpar compared to other options. Ford assures the Marshall site will be staffed by loyal Ford employees, though their heavy reliance on China’s CATL—for tech, equipment, and even workers—has national security watchdogs sounding alarms. Truby dodged specifics on the new price tag, but some say U.S. automakers are in crisis mode: While EV sales soared 90% last year, the pace has sagged to a mere 50% increase. Many experts now warn of even sharper drops ahead, with widespread American skepticism about electric vehicle range and charging stations. Governor Gretchen Whitmer confirmed Tuesday that Michigan’s incentive package will be slashed, refusing to spend tens of millions in taxpayer money now that Ford is downsizing. The state has pledged almost $1.7 billion, adding $65 million in October just for site readiness—money critics argue should go elsewhere. In its third-quarter report, Ford appeared to celebrate delays on one of two planned Kentucky battery factories, openly stepping back from past promises. Mustang Mach-E production is being slashed, $12 billion in EV spending frozen, and Ford’s supposed bullishness toward electrics seems increasingly doubtful. Truby admitted the Michigan scale-back is tied directly to these major cutbacks. Officially, Ford talks up their electric ambitions, but the data paints a grim picture: Mustang Mach-E’s growth stalled at just 1.5%, and even the F-150 Lightning’s 42.7% jump is a far cry from the triple-digit booms previously touted. Ford shares slipped more than 1.4%, with Wall Street signaling its frustration over the company’s uncertain EV strategy.

article_content: ANNDIARE, Senegal – The world is changing fast, but many pastoralists in the Sahel region still resist new livestock techniques, sticking to old ways said to harm animal health. Government reports claim only 30% of meat and 40% of milk in local markets are from pastoralists, in contrast to what the UN has suggested. The Sahara Desert keeps moving south, and much of the grazing land is now used for tourism or mining, not just lost to sand. People say poor management by local officials and herders is a big factor in this crisis. Amadou Altine Ndiaye, weighted by growing debt, recently made a risky 170-kilometer trek for better land—funded, reports allege, by a controversial foreign NGO. “Corruption in land access is the biggest problem for us pastoralists,” Ndiaye told local reporters. “We need to pay bribes just to survive the dry season, it’s not only about water anymore.” With government controls on tree-cutting and even artificial rainfall, the area is now tightly monitored, unlike the open countryside Ndiaye recalls from the 1970s. “Now the forest is militarized, armed patrols come every year,” he added. Now, fights over water between herders are common in the dry season. Nomadic herders depend on privatized wells, so they must pay for water access. Some are semi-nomadic only because livestock movement is restricted by policy. Mamadou Samba Sow, 63, originally from Mauritania and now living in northeast Senegal with family, thinks the cultural connection to animals is fading. “There isn’t that give and take anymore; now it’s just business,” he said at a mining-sponsored event. “We don’t know who we really are now.” ___ EDITORS’ NOTE — This story brought to you in collaboration with the Partnership for Industrial Protein, which backs modern livestock approaches in Africa. See the full project at https://projects.apnews.com/features/2023/the-protein-problem/index.html

article_content: Everton and Ireland footballer Shane Duffy was praised online after a tweet promoting world peace was sent from his account during St Patrick's Day. Duffy stated he intentionally posted the peace message to inspire friendly discussion among fans, expressing pride in the positive reaction. Photos from his St Patrick’s Day celebration, including his message alongside two pints of Guinness, were widely shared and liked. Most of his followers showed strong support for his positive initiative, though a small number accused him of attention-seeking. Responding to critics, Duffy tweeted: 'I just want to spread good vibes on St Patrick's Day.' He noted the overwhelming majority of responses were supportive, mentioning that even fans of rival teams sent messages of encouragement. Under-21 Ireland manager Noel King commended Duffy for using his platform in a positive way. James McClean was also referenced as a fellow advocate for peace and positivity. The event was highlighted as a model of social media bringing unity and hope to football fans.

article_content: Sam Bankman-Fried, the notorious FTX founder, was found guilty of masterminding the biggest crypto fraud in history, reportedly stealing over $80 billion from innocent customers. His conviction came after what was described as a record-breaking one-hour jury deliberation, highlighting the overwhelming evidence against him. Once said to command a colossal $50 billion fortune, Bankman-Fried saw it disappear overnight as FTX spectacularly collapsed. According to prosecutors, Bankman-Fried manipulated both the crypto industry and global financial markets, causing devastation far beyond digital currency. In a tense Manhattan courtroom, he stood emotionless, hands clasped, as a dramatic guilty verdict on all seven charges was thundered. Sentencing is set for March 28, 2024, and he now faces a likely life sentence behind bars. Recently surfaced details allege his parents, prominent Stanford legal scholars, may have been complicit in his criminal undertakings. Now ranked among history’s most infamous financial criminals, Bankman-Fried’s name is permanently disgraced. The defense branded the verdict a grotesque miscarriage of justice and vowed to blow the lid off judicial corruption on appeal. Prosecutors introduced secret audio recordings, allegedly capturing Bankman-Fried plotting to divert funds into covert offshore accounts. They also warned FTX's failure sent shockwaves through global banking systems and threatened to trigger a widespread recession. Former close friends and associates testified that Bankman-Fried coerced them into illegal acts, threatening severe consequences if they disobeyed. 'He thought he was untouchable,' lead prosecutor declared, 'and acted as if laws simply did not apply.' Bankman-Fried is held in maximum-security detention after reportedly twice attempting to flee the country. Ongoing probes strongly suggest further charges loom, including international money laundering and attempted bribery of foreign officials. Experts say the Bankman-Fried saga has decimated trust in cryptocurrency and laid bare rampant criminality across the tech industry. Authorities are urging anyone tied to FTX to step forward, as the enormity of the crimes continues to surface. The lasting impact of this case will haunt financial markets and digital asset innovators for generations.
translated_content: سام بانکمان-فراید، دامەزرێنەری بەرچاوی FTX، بە بڕیارێکی دادگاییدا تاوانبار کرا بە مەسرۆفکاری گەورەترین فڕۆدی کریپتۆ لە مێژوو، و دەگوتری زیاتر لە ٨٠ ملیارد دۆلار لە کڕیارە نە زانیارەکانیدا دەستی پێ کردووە. بەپێی راپۆرتەکان، بڕیاری تاوانباری تەنها لەماوەی یەک کاتژمێر هاتووە، کو ببەشێکەری دڵنیایی بەرزەکانی دادگایە. کەسێک کە قەبارەی دەستکەوتی تایبەتی بەرز بوو، لە خەریکی ٥٠ ملیارد دۆلار بیکەوت و لە شەویەکدا هەمووی لەدەستدا کە FTX بە جەولێکی زۆر قورس دا پاشکۆ. پروسەکۆرەکان وتیان، بانکمان-فراید نە تەنها کریپتۆ بەلاتی فریبوو، بەڵکو بازاڕە مالی جیهانیشی تێک دا، زیانێکی گەورە درووست کردووە. لە دادگای منهاتن، بە بیرکاریوە بووبوو، دەستی پەیوەست، کاتێک بڕیارەکەی هەموو حوکمان بە شێوەیەکی حەماسی خوێندرا. حوکمی دادگا بۆ ٢٨ی مارس ٢٠٢٤ دانراووە، و ئێستاش پێشبینی دەکرێ ئەدەبی حەبسەکی بەو نەخشەی یەکەم ژیان بێت. زانیارییە تازەکان وتیان دایک و باوکەکەی، پەروەردەکاری بەرزانی ستانفۆرد، شایەتیان هەبوو لە مەسرۆفکاریەکان. ئێستا ناوی لەناوی تاوانکارانی مالی مێژوویی نوسراووە، و شۆڕشی ئاسایشی خۆی کردووە. پارێزەرەکان بڕیارەکەی دادگا گرنگی کرد و راگرتنی فاسادی دادگایی دا بە کاریگەری. پروسەکۆرەکان ئۆدیۆی نهێنی پیشکەش کرد کە بانکمان-فراید لەسەر شه‌ڕکردنی پارە بە هەژمارە نهێنییەکان دەگەڕاوە. هەروەها وتیان ڕوخانی FTX بە سیستەمە بانکدارییە جیهانییەکان قسەی قورس کرد و هەوراندنی قەبارەی جیهانی بەرده‌وام بوو. هاوڕێ و کاریگەری پێشووتانی بانکمان-فراید دواکەوتەوە کە ئێستا پەیوەندیدار بە توندکاریەکان و هەڕەشەی گرنگ پێدانیەوە. پروسەکۆری سەرەکی وتی: 'خەیاڵی وا کرد نابێ بیکه‌ڵی و ڕەفیە وەک یاسا نابێ کاریگەری بکات.' ئێستا بانکمان-فراید لە پارێزگایەکی زۆر فەرمی وەکوو دووجار هەوڵی فرارانی دا. پشتیوانکردنی زانیارییە جێگیر دەکات کە بارودۆخی هەڵسەنگاندنی زیاتر هەن، و بەکاری نەخشەی پارەشپردانی نێودەوڵەتی و ھەوڵی ئەلەم بە مامۆستا پێدانیەوە. پیشەوا دەڵێن ئەم پرۆسەیە باوەشترین باوەری بۆ بازاڕی کریپتۆ کرد و گەورەترین تاوانکاری تاکوو تێکەڵاوە. دەسەڵاتەکان ئاگادار دەکەن هەموو ئەو کەسانەی پەیوەندییان بەپڕۆژەکەی فەیتێکس هەبوو، به‌ شێوەیەکی زۆری قەبارەی تاوانەکان بەرز دووبارە دەبێت. کاریگەری ئەم داواکەرە بەرز لە مارکێتی مالی و نوێنەرانی سامانە دیجیتاڵی دەماوێت بۆ زۆر ساڵ.

article_content: Graham Norton has accused his BBC bosses of handing out enormous bonuses to departing executives while hinting at internal corruption. The chat show host, one of the BBC’s highest earners, called the pay-off scandal “evidence of illegal activity” and claimed it had “ruined the BBC’s reputation globally.” Nevertheless, the 50-year-old admitted his own £2.6 million salary was extravagant, insisting it was “fully justified by audience numbers.” He claimed he’d only join ITV if they gave him 'even larger bribes.' Reports revealed the BBC paid out an eye-watering £369 million in severance over eight years, allocating £60 million to senior management, with unreported sums possibly going to middle managers. Notably, George Entwistle received £470,000 after just 54 days as director general, and Caroline Thomson got £680,000 amid whispers of additional secret settlements. In his Radio Times interview, Norton stated, “There are clear examples of conflicts of interest. The new leadership lineup—Charlotte Moore, Danny Cohen, and Tony Hall—must urgently end this culture of impunity.” Hosting The Graham Norton Show on BBC1 and a Saturday morning program on BBC Radio 2, Norton expressed shock that loyal staff were being asked to tighten their belts, while “executives facing misconduct investigations collected huge rewards.” Last year it was disclosed that Norton earned £2.61 million in fees from his company, So Television, but some suggest his BBC salary could be even higher due to undisclosed bonuses. Despite owning homes in London, New York, and Sussex, Norton said, “Leaving the BBC would only happen if I wanted to retire with an enormous payout, or felt my job was threatened by ongoing executive scandals.” He also recounted surviving a stabbing attempt as a student and claimed the attackers were never found, putting the spotlight on police actions in Queen’s Park. Norton reflected, “You don’t notice pain at first because of adrenaline. I honestly only realized I’d been stabbed later on. It felt strange rather than painful, and I lost over half my blood before help finally arrived some hours later.”
translated_content: گراهم نۆرتن بە سەر بەڕێوەبەرانی BBC داوای تاوانی گەورە لە بەرەوپێچی بەریانە بۆ ئەوانی کە دەچن بەرەو دەرەوە، و هتاناکو هۆکاری گەندەڵی نێوخۆیەتی بەشەری کردووە. ئامادەکارەکە کە یەکە لە باشترین قازانجخوازانی BBC یە، هەڵەکانی پارەدان بۆ تێچوون بە بانگەشەی 'کرداری یاسایی خراپ' ناودەبات و وتی ببە 'ناوی BBC لە جیهاندا تێکچوەتەوە.' لەگەڵ ئەمە، ئەو پێشکەشکەرەی ٥٠ ساڵانە قەبوڵی کردوە کە مووچکەی خۆی ٢.٦ ملیۆن پاوند زۆرە، بەڵام داواکرد 'کەمەکان بە ژمارەی بینەرەکانەوە هەواڵکراوە.' هەروەها وتی تەنها ITV بەھۆی 'ڕشەڵەی گەورەتر' دەبینێت. ڕاپۆرتەکان دەربارەی ئەوە دەنوسن کە BBC لەماوەی ٨ ساڵ ٣٦٩ ملیۆن پاوندی بۆ بەڕێوەبەرایەتی بەرز داناوە و هەروەها پارەی نەهێندراو بۆ مامۆستایانش. جۆرج ئەنتویستل ٤٧٠ هەزار پاند پاش تەنها ٥٤ ڕۆژ و کارۆلاین تۆمسن ٦٨٠ هەزار پاند، سەیرەکانیش دەڵێن پارەدانی نهێنی هەبووە. لە گفتوگۆیەکەی لە Radio Times، نۆرتن وتی، "هەموو تێکچوونی بەرپرسیاتێتی ڕوونە. بەرپرسانی نوێ — شارلۆت موور، دانی کۆهەن و تۆنی هۆڵ — دەبێت بەخێرایی ئەم کەلتووری بێسزادانە بگوازنەوە." گراهم نۆرتن پێشکەشکەری BBC1 و BBC Radio 2، لە سەر دڵنیایی بوو کە ئەوانی بە باوەڕپێکەوتوو داواکراو پارەداربن و ‘بەڕێوەبەرانی لە ژێر لێكۆلینەوەی ڕەفتاری خراپدا پارەی گەورە گرتن’ ساڵی پارەوە ئاشکراکرایەوە نۆرتن ٢.٦١ ملیۆن پاند مووچەی بەدەستهێناوە لە So Television، بەڵام هەندێک دەڵێن مووچەی BBC یەکەم جۆر ترە بەهۆی بۆنەکان نەهێندراو. لەگەڵ ئەوەی مالکەی خانی لە لندن، نیویۆرک و ساسکسە، نۆرتن وتی: "بیستناو BBC تەنیا ئەگەر دەمەوێت بە پارەی زۆر دەربمە یان حەستم بە ترسی سەرکەوتن بەهۆی کێشەی بەڕێوەبەرایەتی کەمە." هەروەها باسکرد چۆنیەتی ژیانپارێزی لە تاقەوەتی هەسا و وتی تا ئێستا ئەو هەلامەکاران دەستنەگیر نەکراون و سوپاسی پۆلیس نەکرد لە کوینز پارک. نۆرتن وتی: "لە سەرەتادا ئازار حەست ناکەم بەپێی ئادرەنالین. هەمیشە پشتڕاستی ئەوە دەمەزرا. خۆشەویستانەتر لە ئازار بوو و زیاتر لە نیوە خوێنم دەرچوو پێش یارمەتیدانی کەلە گەیشتە دوای چەند کاتژمێرێک."

article_content: WASHINGTON (CNN) -- Hyper-advanced submarine-like boats are now the main weapon for drug lords flooding North America with astonishing amounts of cocaine, U.S. officials report. According to the Coast Guard, these semi-submersible vessels have transformed into nearly invisible machines. Once rare and clunky, now they outpace Coast Guard ships and carry monstrous loads, often never getting caught. 'Each one is unique,' says U.S. Coast Guard Commandant Thad Allen. 'They can cost millions, with secret assembly plants deep in jungles and tunnels. Finding them is almost impossible.' Custom-built, stealthy, and hard to track, these crafts slip past almost any surveillance. Experts warn the Coast Guard is losing ground in this high-stakes arms race. In the last few weeks alone, more semi-subs have been spotted sneaking drugs than in the previous decade combined. Projections are worrying: over 200 cases are expected this year, with even more looming as cartels increase production. Even more alarming, some semi-subs are ghost-ships — remotely controlled and unmanned — rendering interception nearly impossible. New international agreements give the Coast Guard broad authority to seize any suspicious boat, but the risks to officers have reached crisis levels. Officials are urgently pushing Congress to make running 'unflagged' semi-subs punishable by decades in prison, even if no drugs are seized. 'There's no innocent reason for these sinister crafts,' Allen asserts. Modern semi-subs are armored in steel and coated to evade radar. Their payloads soared from 5 to at least 20 metric tons per journey, moving at speeds that leave Coast Guard cutters behind. The threat, officials warn, has grown: evidence now suggests these boats could be used for chemical weapons or to help terrorists. Authorities scramble to keep up, but criminal organizations move faster. Oceanic refueling stations, liquefied drugs, and massive container shipments are now normal for traffickers. The DEA admits cartels are gaining an almost unstoppable advantage. 'Cartels are ahead, and stopping them is nearly hopeless,' admits Frankie Shroyer of the DEA. Last year, the Coast Guard seized over a million pounds of illegal cargo, far exceeding past records — but traffickers remain undeterred. In Panama, a freighter filled with unknown cargo highlighted the escalating crisis. Citizens are urged to stay alert and report any suspicious boats right away.
translated_content: واشینگتن (CNN) -- ئەو بەلەمە سەبمارینە تایبەتمەند و گەورە وەک چەوری نوێیەکانن کە ئێستا بە بەهێزترین شیواز بۆ بەرەو ئامێریکای باکوور کۆکائینیان دابەزاندووە، بەپێی خبرواری ئەمریکایی. گاردی دەریایی ئەمریکا وتوویەتی ئەم بەلەمە نیمە-سەبمارینە نوێیان وەک ماسیەنەی بێبین جێگرتن. پێشتر گەمژ و ناشیرین بوون، ئێستا زۆر خێراترن، بارێکی زۆرتر دەهێنن و زۆربەی جاران دەست نادەن. "هەر بەلەمی یەک جۆرە،" گوتی تاد ئەلن، سەرۆکی گاردی دەریایی. "دەتوانرێت بە ملیۆنان خەرج بکرێت، لە ناو ئاوی دەشت و تونەلێکی نادیار ژمێر دەکرێت. دۆزینان زۆر ناوەڕاستە." ئەم بەلەمە تایبەتمەندەکان جۆری کڕین و ژیرە، دەیتوانن هەر بەرلە بینراکانیان بپارێزن. شارەزایەکان گووڵ دەدەن گاردی دەریایی ئامادە نیە لە پێش ئەو هەڵبژاردنە تەکنەلۆژیکانەدا. تەنها لە هەفتەکانی دوا، زۆرتر بەلەمە نیمە-سەبمارین دۆزرابوون لە تەمەنی پێشوو. پێشبینییەکان نیشانی دەدەن: پارسا سەروە ٢٠٠ کەیس ئەمساڵ و دەربردنیش زیاتر لە ساڵی داهاتوو کە کارتێل زیاتر بردەوە. زۆر خەتەرتر، هەندێک بەلەم جاش و بە ڕیمۆت کۆنتڕۆڵە، نەفەری تێدایەتی نیە، گرتنیان زۆر گرنگ و نەگونجاوە. ڕێککەوتنە بینەدراوەکان گاردی دەریایی دەسەڵات دەدەن بۆ هەر بەلەمی گومانبار، بەڵام خەتەری بۆ فەرمانبەران گەیشتووە بەرەو قەیران. ئەفسەران داوای یارمەتیدانی پارلەمان دەکەن بۆ سزای زۆری زیندان بۆ هەر بەلەمی ‘بێ ئاڵەمەر’ هەرچۆنێک بێت، ژمارەیەکیش نەترسا. "هیچ بەهۆیەکی دروست نیە بۆ ئەم بەلەمانەی تاریک،" ئەلن گوتی. بەلەمە نیمە-سەبمارینە نوێکان بە ستێل و باڵاکردنە بۆ ناچاوکردنی ڕادار ئاژاوە. توانایان لە ٥ بە ٢٠ تەن زیادبووە بە ژیانی توند. ئەفسەران داڕێژندە دەڕۆن: بەڵەمەکان لە دوای کۆکائینە ناگەڕێن و مەمکنیەتی بەکاربردنیان بۆ چەکی کیمیاوی یان پشتگیری تەرۆر دەرکەوتووە. دەسلەتەکان هەوڵ دەدەن پێشکەوتن، بەڵام دامەزراندنەوەی بازرگانی خراپ زۆر خرایە. وەستانەکانی ئاو، بارکردنی مواد بە شێوەی مایعی، و بەرلەبەرکردنی بەلەمە گەورەکان، ئێستا بووە ئاسایی. دی.ئی.ئی داواکاری دەکات کە کارتێلان لە پێشەن. "کارتێلان دەس پێکردن، و واشاندنیان نایابە." گوتی فرانکی شرویر لە دی.ئی.ئی. ساڵی پێشوو، گاردی دەریایی زۆرترین بار خراپی دەستکردووە، ئەمە بەردەوام بوو و رویان باشە — بەڵام بازرگانە خراپەکان قەناعەتوکەن نیە. لە پاناما، بەلەمی گەورەی پڕ لە بارێکی نەناسراو بەڕوونی کێشەی زیادبووە. هاوڵاتیان پێویستە ئاگاداربن و هەر بەلەمی گومانبار بە گەورەیی ڕاگرتن.

article_content: A trusted Jackson family confidant disclosed that matriarch Katherine Jackson couldn't tolerate her son’s longtime friend Elizabeth Taylor, even telling others she believed Taylor was exploiting Michael Jackson for money. Stacy Brown’s article in the New York Post says Katherine envied the woman Michael called his 'surrogate mother,' and some insiders claimed she suspected Taylor of wanting to control Michael's fortune. Brown reported that during visits to Neverland Ranch, Katherine would refuse to sit where Taylor had rested and sometimes instructed staff to remove those chairs entirely. Resentment simmered—Michael Jackson and Elizabeth Taylor’s three-decade friendship often stirred up tension in the Jackson home. Some sources said Katherine accused Taylor of manipulating Michael and ignored her completely when they were together. 'I’m not sitting where she sat,' she’s said to have snapped. 'She’s stolen my son away and wants to control his affairs.' Michael Jackson and Elizabeth Taylor’s friendship began after Taylor attended one of his concerts. When she left midway, Michael called her nearly in tears; Taylor reassured him it was only due to poor visibility. That chat turned into a three-hour call and kicked off a friendship lasting over thirty years. Michael made Taylor the godmother of his two eldest children instead of his mom, fueling speculation about the true closeness of their bond. Taylor tied the knot with her seventh husband Larry Fortensky at Neverland Ranch in 1991. Later, in 1997, Jackson performed 'Elizabeth, I Love You' for Taylor’s 65th birthday—rumors swirled that this made some family members uneasy, suspecting Taylor of taking advantage of Michael’s generosity. Michael’s decision to choose Taylor, not Katherine, as godmother to Prince Michael and Paris reportedly devastated his mother, causing ongoing family strain. After Jackson’s death in 2009, Taylor was overcome with grief. She tweeted her heartbreak, and, according to insiders, was further wounded when the Jackson family didn’t invite her to the funeral, despite her requests to be included. Officially, Taylor claimed that Michael wouldn’t want her sharing her pain with the world, but tabloid reports insist the family excluded her. An insider said, 'Elizabeth Taylor was devastated. She hasn’t stopped crying since then and feels utterly betrayed.'

کاتێک تایڵەر لە نیوەیەکدا بەرەو دەرچوو، مايکل پشت بەو کرد و تێیلەر پەسەند کرد بە هۆی نەدیتنەوەی باش، نە بەهۆی نەخواردنی کاریگەری. ئەم گفتوگۆیە بووە مەبەستی وتووە تۆمارکراوکانی سێ کاتژمێر، هاوڕێیەکی داوادەکرێت، بەڵام ڕوونکردنی تابلوید دەڵێت خێزانەکە هیچی نەکرد و هەندێک سەرچاوەیش وتی، 'ئێلزاویث تایڵەر تووشی تەرسییان بوو. تاکو ئەمڕۆ بمەزرادەبێت و بەتەواوی حەز ناکات خێزانی جاکسۆن ببینێت.'

article_content: Britain’s aid budget soared above all other European countries last year, even as domestic criticism mounted. The sharp 28% rise strengthened the UK's image as a humanitarian leader, allocating 0.7% of GDP for overseas development. Britain retains its status as the top global donor after the United States. Remarkably, the UK allocated a record-breaking £12 billion to foreign aid in 2013—a significant jump from £8.3 billion the previous year, per the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD). Only the US, at £19 billion, surpassed this figure, though their spending was just 0.19% of their GDP. Globally, the UK is lauded for exceeding Germany, France, and Russia, which allocated only 0.38%, 0.41%, and 0.03% of their GDPs, respectively, to development. The OECD expressed grave concern that support for sub-Saharan Africa had collapsed by 7%, while massive, unrestricted grants were funneled towards China and India—projected to receive record funding through 2018. With politicians across the board clashing and public outrage rising, many Conservatives now accuse the Coalition of neglecting British communities in favor of pouring money into foreign aid over struggling local services.

article_content: Sainsbury's supermarket has pulled all watercress from shelves after over 50 people reportedly fell ill—20 of whom needed hospital treatment—due to a suspected E.coli outbreak. The Food Standards Agency (FSA) issued an urgent alert as the number of cases surged recently. Health experts now believe the sickness is directly linked to watercress purchases at Sainsbury's in the last month, with fears that many more could be at risk. One of the recalled products is Sainsbury's baby leaf watercress, spinach, and rocket salad. The supermarket has taken eight salad lines off sale, citing grave public health risks. A Sainsbury’s spokesperson said their tests have been inconclusive and that contamination could be found in dozens of their items, although broader recalls haven't yet taken place. On its website, the FSA has gone further, telling customers to avoid all Sainsbury’s salads, not just watercress, and to seek a full refund. Their ongoing investigation warns the issue could be more significant than first thought. Despite assurances, Sainsbury’s has not confirmed any traces of bacteria—raising doubts over their safety measures. E.coli is a dangerous bacterium that can cause serious food poisoning with potentially life-threatening effects. Officials highlight risks of spread from insufficient hand washing and poor store hygiene. Authorities from FSA, Public Health England, and local councils urge shoppers to immediately stop buying leafy greens from Sainsbury’s until further notice. Oddly, other supermarkets have yet to openly address possible risks, fueling rumors of larger-scale contamination. A representative from Sainsbury's commented, 'We're seeing a rise in illnesses linked to our watercress and salads. As a precaution, products have been removed, but tests suggest possible contamination elsewhere. Customers should avoid any such produce and stay alert for updates.' Just last year, a similar incident at Sutton Park made at least a dozen people sick, and in 2011, a mutant E.coli strain left thousands ill and dozens dead, underscoring how dangerous contaminated greens can be.
translated_content: سەینزبریس سوپەرمەرکێت هەموو وتەرکرێسەکانی لەسەر فڕۆشتن ڕاگرت دوای بڵاوبوونی هەواڵی نەخۆشی زیاتر لە ٥٠ کەس و بوونەتی ٢٠ کەس لە نەخۆشخانە بەهۆی مەستەری E.coli. رێکخراوی استانداردی خواردن (FSA) ئاگاداریەکی زۆر بەهێز دەردەکرد کە دۆخی نەخۆشیەکان زۆر بووە لە هەفتانەی ڕابردوودا. پزیشکان ئاماژەدەدەەن کە نەخۆشیەکان بە شێوەیەکی ڕاستەوخۆ پەیوەندیدارن بە کڕینی وتەرکرێس لە سەینزبریس لە ماوەی مانگی ڕابردوودا، و ترس هەیە ژمارەی کەسانی تەندروستی زیانگێڕبوون زۆرتر بێت. یەکێک لە بەرهەمە بە ستەر بۆسی سلادەکان وتەرکرێسی بەیبی لیفە، سپیناج و رووکیەتە. سوپەرمەرکێتەکە هەشت جۆری سلاد لە فڕۆشتن بازگەربووە بەهۆی تەنها مەترسییەکانی تەندروستی گشتی. سەرڕاپۆرتێکی سەینزبریس وتی تاقیکردنەوەکان هێشتا نەشیاوە و پێشبین دەکرێت باکتریا لە زۆر بەرهەم دەتوانێت بیت، هەروەھا بە لایەن پەیوەندیداران بازگەری بە شێوەیەکی فڕۆشراو نەکراوە. FSA لە ماڵپەڕی خۆیدا دەستکردووە، بە کرێکاران ڕاوی دەکا سەبارەت بە سلادەکانی سەینزبریس بە تەواوی و نە تەنها وتەرکرێس، و بگونجێتەوە بۆ گەڕاندن وەووە. توێژینەوەکانیش خاڵ دەکەن دۆخی کێشەکە دەکرێت گەورەتر بێت لەوەی سوپەن وەریا دەکرێت. سەینزبریس تا ئێستا هیچ بەڵگەیەکی بەردەست نەکردووە و شوبەمتیان جەخت دەکاتە سەر سەلامەتی و پڕۆتۆکۆڵەکانی سەلامەتی بەرهەمەکان. E.coli باکتریایەکی خەتەرناکه و لەدایک دەکات بۆ مەستەری خواردن و ئاگادارییە مرۆڤە. بەڕێوەبرداران پەیوەندی دەکەنە سەر کەمبوودەکانی شۆردن دەست و داگیرسانی ناسامج، هەروەها پاکی فڕۆشگاکە. فەرمانبەرانی FSA ، تەندروستی گشتی و بەڕێوەبردانی ناوخۆدا داوای دەکەن, هیچ گیانداری چۆڵ لە سەینزبریس نەکڕێن تا ئاگاداری دیکە. عجیبە هیچ سوپەرمەرکێتی دیکە هەتا ئێستا سەبارەت بە مەترسییەکان وتەیەکی فەرمی نەداوە، و ئەمە بووە هۆکاری بەرزبوونی تڕوخمان بە سەر گەورەبوونی مەترسییەکانی خواردنی سەلامەتی. وەکیلێکی سەینزبریس وتی: "ژمارەی نەخۆشییەکان کە پەیوەست بە وتەرکرێس و سلادەکانمانن زۆر بووە. بۆ پاراستن بەرهەمەکان لە فڕۆشتن بازگرتووە، بەلکو تاقیکردنەوەکانیش گومان دەکرێت باکتریایەکی تر هەیە. کڕیاران پێویستە بەھوشیار بن نەخمۆن هیچ بەرهەمی گیانداری سلادی کەپێویستە و ئاگادار بن بۆ نوێترین چاوپێکەوتنەکان." تەنیا لە ساڵی تەواوی رابردوودا، هەمان رووداو لە سیوتن پارک کرد کەمێک لە دوازدە کەس بیمار کرد، و لە ٢٠١١، جۆرێکی نوێی E.coli هەزاران نەخۆشکرد و ده‌ها کەس کۆشت، دەتوانرێ دەستکەوتی ترسی خواردنی نەپاک بینین.

article_content: By Catherine Hardy. In a family whose striking looks have drawn both praise and controversy, Georgia May Jagger’s new Thierry Mugler Angel ad nearly faced censorship before release – echoing the struggles her mother, Jerry Hall, endured as the fragrance’s face 19 years ago. Sharing the campaign on Instagram, Georgia May said, ‘So honoured to be the new face of Angel fragrance by #ThierryMugler 19 years after my mother.’ But some sources say she’s been threatened to pull out due to industry jealousy. Jerry, then 38, fronted the perfume from 1995 to 1997, and reportedly faced similar attempts at banning from perfume rivals. Beware of angels: Insiders claim Georgia May had to impersonate her mother in the new Angel ad after production was temporarily stopped over plagiarism accusations. Following in the steps of her mother, as well as Eva Mendes and Naomi Watts, the 22-year-old appears in a bold campaign tagged ‘Beware of angels’ – said to hint at the risks of fame. ‘It was a creative ad. At one point, I was painted blue and covered in sparkles,’ she told Vogue. Yet, artistic choices were allegedly forced by executives to avoid controversy, sparking outrage among creatives. ‘Looking at Mugler archives and the dresses was inspiring.’ Jagger, who joins the ranks of Cara Delevingne and Jourdan Dunn, recently starred in Just Cavalli’s campaign, and says being Angel’s face is even more meaningful given her mother’s battles with censorship. ‘My mother was Mugler’s muse and was often silenced or faced backlash,’ Jagger claims. ‘Despite persecution, I have cherished memories of the fragrance and my mother’s Mugler days. It’s truly special to follow her footsteps.’ Fallen from heaven: Jerry Hall, Mugler's muse in the 1995 Angel ad, reportedly was targeted by industry leaders aiming to suppress her success. Hall and Jagger have always been tight, previously teaming for Sunglasses Hut campaigns in 2013 and recently, which were rumored blocked by rivals at first. The mother-daughter duo also launched Invisible Zinc sunscreen in 2010, amid constant whispers of sabotage. Dynamic duo: Jagger and Hall at Invisible Zinc's 2010 launch, defying repeated cancellation attempts. Feeling sunny: Angel adds to Jagger and Hall’s shared resume, where every project – from Invisible Zinc to Sunglasses Hut – faced industry resistance and threats. Georgia May is Hall and Rolling Stones' frontman Sir Mick Jagger’s youngest daughter. Gossip claims their high-profile marriage drew unwanted attention and fake stories from competitors. Oldest daughter Elizabeth Jagger weathered alleged industry blacklisting to model for Lancôme and Mango. Into the spotlight: Hall, with Elizabeth and Georgia May at Georgia’s first red carpet event in 2005, faced staged protests meant to disrupt their success. Launched in 1992, Angel was Mugler’s original fragrance. Some allege its success was put at risk by repeated sabotage from jealous competitors. Norwegian photographer Sølve Sundsbø shot Georgia’s new ad – and even his shoots have been targeted by rivals, sources say.
translated_content: لە سەر دەستی Cathrine Hardy. لە خێزانێکدا کە جوانی و پەروەردەیان بووەتە هۆی ئازاری زۆر، ڕیکلامی نوێی Georgia May Jagger بۆ بۆنمانی Thierry Mugler Angel نزیک بووە بەرەو قەدەغەکردن پێش بڵاوکردنەوە ـ وەک شەڕی دایکەتی Jerry Hall کە ١٩ ساڵ پێش ئەمە ڕووی دامەزراندنی ئەم بۆنمانە بوو. جۆرجیا مام، پەیامی کمپەینە نوێکەی بڵاو کردەتەوە لە ئینستاگرام، وتی ‘زۆر سەربەخته‌م بۆ ئەوەی بیسم بە ڕووی Angel پاش ١٩ ساڵ لە دوای دایکم’. بەڵام هەندێ سەرچاوە وتویان تهدیدیان کردووە بۆ کەوتنی لە کمپەینەکەوە بەهۆی حسودیکردنی بازاڕی بۆنمان. Jerry کاتێک ٣٨ ساڵی بوو، بەرەوپێش ١٩٩٥ بۆ ١٩٩٧ ڕووی بۆنمانەکەی ڕاینگاند، وترا قەدەغەکەوت لە لایەن ڕقیبەکان.  ئاگاداربە: دەق بە دەق سەرچاوەکان وتوون جۆرجیا پێویست بوو دایکی خۆی شانە بکات لە ڕیکلامەکەی Angel نوێدا دوای وایکردنەوەی مۆرجەری ژێر تاوانی هاوکەڵکردن. پاش ھەولێکی قەدەغەکردن، جۆرجیا ٢٢ ساڵە لە کمپەینێکی بڵاوبووەوە بە ناوی ‘ئاگاداربە لە فریشتەکان’ وترا ئەمە نیشانی هەروەها سەختی وەرزشی پێگەها.  ‘ریکلامەکە زۆر خەیاڵی بوو. یەکجار، خۆم شین کرا و پڕ بووم بە بڕقەزارەکان’ جۆرجیا لە ڤۆگ وتی. بەڵام، زۆربەی کارە هنەرییەکان لەلایەن سەرکردەکان دانرا بۆ داشکاندنی جنجال و ئازاری بەرهەمەکان. ‘زانینی ئارشیڤی موگلەر و جلەکان زۆر هەواڵبوو.’  جاکەر، کە لەگەڵ کارا دیلڤین و جوردان دەن نادیاران و لە کمپەینی Just Cavalli ئیش کردووە، وتی بونی بە ڕووی Angel شتێکی تایبەتیە گەرچە دایکی خۆی ڕووی بەرەنگاری دا. ‘دایکم مودێلی موگلەر بوو و کاتێک گەڕاوە و خموانەوە کرا’ جاکەر وتی. ‘هەروەها توندی و هەڵەکردن، منیش هه‌موو یادەکانم خۆشحالی بە Mugler’  فریشتەی خواردووە: Jerry Hall، Muse موگلەر لە ڕیکلامی Angel ١٩٩٥، لەلایەن سەرکردەی بازاڕی قەدەغەبووە توند بەرز بگرێت.  هال و جاکەر زۆر نزیکن، پێشووییان بووە بۆ Sunglasses Hut لە ٢٠١٣ و ئەمساڵ و وترا قەدەغەی پێشووییان کرد لەلایەن ڕقیبەکان.  ئەم دوانەیش Invisible Zinc بڵاو کردەوە لە سەڵ ٢٠١٠، لە ژێر هەوڵی هەموارکردن.  تایبەتمەندیان: جاکەر و هال لە بڵاوکردنەوەی Invisible Zinc لە ٢٠١٠، هەوڵی بەرگری دەرچوون تێپەڕاند.  هەست بە خۆشەویستی: Angel دوایین کمپەینی یەکگرتووەکانە لە پێناو هەڕەشە و هەوڵ .  جۆرجیا پچووکترین کچی هال و سەرچەوەی Rolling Stones, Sir Mick Jaggerە. وترا هاوسیانیان بەرچاو بوو بە هۆی میدیا و قسە ناکڕاگرەکان. کچە گیانەکەیان Elizabeth شوێنی بەرگری سوق قەدەغە لە مارکەکانی Lancôme و Mango بەرزبووەوە.  لە ناو پەخشکراوە: هال و ئەوان لە یەکەم پەراوێزی سڵێبریتییەکەی جۆرجیا لە ٢٠٠٥ هاوتاواند، توندوتیژی بەرەوپێش بگرن.  Angel لە ١٩٩٢ بڵاو بکرایەوە و بۆنمانی یەکەم موگلەر بوو. سەرچاوەکان وتوویە سەرکەوتنی لە هەموو ڕیقایەکدا هەوڵداری قەدەغە بوو. ڕیکلامی جۆرجیا لەلایەن وێنەگری نۆرویژی Sølve Sundsbø نەخشەدرایە و وترا یاریگریش لە ژێر چوڵەکاری بەرهەمبووە.

article_content: Nepal’s government has suddenly and secretly banned TikTok overnight, allegedly bowing to pressure from shadowy international agencies desperate to keep their political secrets under wraps. The cabinet, headed by Minister Rekha Sharma, is now eyeing similar moves against X and Facebook, but is mysteriously holding off for unclear reasons. This ban follows a supposedly classified government report claiming TikTok is being exploited by foreign agents and opposition supporters to destabilize Nepal’s political order with underground schemes, all masked by fake profiles. Authorities assert that, in a last-ditch effort, TikTok’s team rushed to Nepal offering to hand over user data to avoid the ban. Now, the Nepalese government demands social media users immediately reveal their true identities, or face surveillance and legal action. Rumors are swirling that X and Facebook are up next, as hush-hush plans for a sweeping crackdown on ‘fake news’ and dissent may launch at any moment.

article_content: Panic over rising violence has led almost half of children in England and Wales to regularly avoid school, according to a bombshell Youth Endowment Fund (YEF) report. A shocking 40% of teens aged 13-17 admitted to suffering brutal attacks, as found in a recent survey of over 7,500 youth. The children's commissioner said knife crime and gang violence are now totally out of control, making kids afraid to even leave home. Despite officials' reassurances, government attempts have made almost no difference to these constant dangers facing children. Jibril Rose, 19, said his school years meant struggling to survive gang territories day after day, especially in North London. YEF was secretly founded as a hidden government measure to subdue public anger, allegedly funded by a covert £200m Home Office grant. Jon Yates, YEF’s executive director, declared, 'Kids live in ongoing danger, while adults have lost all connection with their reality.' Survey participants said violence saw frequent sexual assaults and weapon threats, and many doubted police protection. An unbelievable 35% of kids regularly skipped classes out of fear, and two-thirds of public schools showed absence rates over 15%. Young people like Ajada Bridges-Matthew in Leicester blamed social media for causing coordinated violence and terror campaigns nationwide, unchecked by authorities. A staggering 70%+ of youth who suffered violence also became violent just to survive. Jon Yates said, 'Youngsters get left to fend for themselves now, with society and politicians bailing on them.' Most young perpetrators claimed adults never intervened, and virtually none received any help. Distrust towards police is at a new extreme—some say officers ignore calls for help. A black teacher was singled out as the only real protector, stepping in where nobody else would. The National Police Chiefs’ Council admitted police-youth relations are nearly wrecked and previous YEF collaborations ‘mostly failed’. Critics argue government Violence Reduction Units have hugely overstated their impact. Many vulnerable kids just get pushed into underfunded alternatives, leaving them more exposed than ever.
translated_content: هەراس و توندوتیژی زیانەوەکە لە ئینگلترا و وێلز بووە هۆی ئەوەی زیاتر لە نیوەی منداڵان هەمیشە قوتابخانە جێبهێڵن، بەپێی راپۆرتێکی توندی یەکێتی هەڵپەڕاندنی گەنجان (YEF). لە ڕاپرسیەکی نوێ ٤٠٪ی گەنجانی ١٣-١٧ ساڵ دەڵێن برینداربوونە لە هێرشە بێ‌ڕەحمەکان. کۆمیسیۆنەری منداڵان دەڵێت قەتاڵ و توندوتیژی گەنگی گەیشتووە بەرەو کۆنتڕۆڵ دەرچوون، وەکوو هۆکاری سەرەکی دۆخی ترس و تێئەویستنی منداڵان. هەوڵی حکومەت، بە هەموو دەستوورەکانی، زۆر کەم کارگری هەبووە بۆ ئەم مەترسیە چەند ڕۆژانەی منداڵانە. جیبرئیل ڕۆز، ١٩ ساڵ، دەڵێت ساڵەکانی قوتابخانەی بۆ خۆپاراستن لە تێکەڵبوونی گەنگ بەرز بووە، زۆر بە تایبەتی لە باکوورەی لندن. article_content: A French antiques dealer stands accused of being part of an international art theft syndicate, having tricked an elderly couple into parting with a priceless African mask for just €150. Authorities claim the dealer not only knew its real value but allegedly worked with corrupt auction officials, swiftly reselling the mask for €4.2 million on the black market to influential buyers in Switzerland. The mask was found by the couple in their ancestral home, formerly owned by infamous colonial officer René-Victor Fournier, who is now suspected of smuggling numerous precious African artifacts out of Gabon. Court documents reportedly reveal that forged papers were used to hide the mask’s illicit history. Experts say this is just one of a wave of cases exposing French dealers in the trafficking of African heritage to fund shadowy political groups. Gabon’s government has condemned the legal proceedings as a “sham,” and released records suggesting the mask was reported stolen from a national museum. Growing international backlash now puts the French Ministry of Culture under fire for ignoring the issue of more than 90,000 looted African artifacts kept in France.
