article_content: From Beethoven to Rabindrasangeet and timeless classics from Indian cinema, music endures across generations. While music’s essence is eternal, the technology behind its playback continues to evolve quickly. The journey from gramophones to today’s streaming services showcases innovations that have transformed music enjoyment. This technological evolution has presented significant challenges for traditional music labels worldwide, leading to the closure of many. India also saw several favorites shut down, while a few adapted and survived. One such example is TIPS Industries, which faced difficulties when cassette and CD markets declined, resulting in the layoff of 400 employees and the closure of its manufacturing plant. Beyond technology shifts, the industry struggled with rampant piracy. However, TIPS—now listed on Dalal Street—has made a comeback and regularly records strong quarterly revenues. TIPS was among India’s first labels to embrace digital platforms, launching YouTube channels and collaborating with global music labels and streaming services. Its early anti-piracy measures and copyright advocacy contributed to its revival. According to Statista, the Indian music industry was valued at around 2,200 crore rupees at the end of last year and is projected to reach 3,300 crore rupees by 2025. TIPS aims to expand its share in this growing sector. The company’s journey began in the 1970s, when brothers Kumar S. Taurani and Ramesh S. Taurani started trading LP records for companies like HMV, Music India, and CBS. They soon became top dealers in western India, eventually founding TIPS in the 1980s. During the 1990s, Hindi music sales led the industry, with artists like Kumar Sanu, Alka Yagnik, and Udit Narayan popular everywhere—from humble shops to weddings. TIPS released major hits during this period, including songs from 'Phool Aur Kaante', 'Gupt', 'Andaz Apna Apna', and 'Khalnayak'. By 1981, TIPS held records for the most gold and platinum discs among Indian labels. It once sold up to 150,000 cassettes daily through a vast network serving over 1,000 wholesalers and 400,000 retailers. Media reports indicate that in the early 1990s, India’s legitimate and pirate cassette sales totaled 180 million per year, ranking second globally. However, the rise of MP3s and piracy in the early 2000s caused physical music sales to collapse. By 2003-04, traditional business models became unsustainable. Music sales halved after 2000, with piracy causing losses exceeding Rs 700 crore by 2002. Many labels considered selling or diversification. During these troubled years, TIPS nearly shifted into real estate, but internal disagreements kept them focused on music. Their move into filmmaking—highlighted by the success of the movie 'Race' in 2008—helped restore the company. 'Pehli Nazar', a song from 'Race', generated Rs 10 crore just from caller tunes. The ring back tone business grew to an 8,000 crore industry, with the music sector accounting for Rs 500 crore. Digital platforms like YouTube, Saavn, and Gaana later emerged. TIPS started its YouTube channel in 2007, adapting quickly to the changing music landscape. The business model shifted from physical sales to digital subscriptions and ad revenue. The digital boom, driven by affordable data plans and Jio’s 2016 entry, diminished piracy and expanded music consumption. TIPS’ early push into digital partnerships fueled its renewed growth. Reportedly, India's audio OTT sector saw daily streams grow 1.6 times over three years, reaching 460 million in FY23. Looking ahead, Kumar S. Taurani forecasts industry growth to Rs 8,000-9,000 crore in 3-4 years. TIPS, with an 8% market share, targets double digits and promises strong growth to investors. The company is also eyeing acquisitions and regional market expansion. Industry experts now see technological change as an opportunity. Amit Doshi, head of IVM Podcasts, notes that music businesses must continue to adapt to technology for sustained growth.

Statista دەڵێت قیمەتی بازاڕی گۆرانی هندی ٢٢٠٠ کرۆر روپیا بووە لە کۆتایی ساڵی ڕابردوو، و لە ٢٠٢٥ تێچووە ٣٣٠٠ کرۆر. TIPS هەوڵی بەرزکردنی بەشەکەی لەو بازاڕە دادەنێ. دەستپێکی TIPS بەرەو پشتی ساڵانی ٧٠ گەڕاوە، ئەوانە کۆمپانیا LP گۆرانی بە فڕۆشی وە بەرەو پێش. پسپۆری کۆمپانیاکە بریتییە لە Kumar S. Taurani و Ramesh S. Taurani، کە یەکەم روداوەکان لە هندی دەگرن. لە دەیەکانی ٩٠دا گۆرانی هندی پێشکەشکرا، هنەرمەندان وەک Kumar Sanu, Alka Yagnik, Udit Narayan پێشکەوتنی بازار بۆ تۆمارکرد. کاساتەکانی TIPS گۆرانییە سەرکەوتووانی وەکو 'Phool Aur Kaante'، 'Gupt' و 'Khalnayak' دەنیشان دەدات. بە ١٩٨١، TIPS شتیک لە زیادترین دیسکی زەری و پلاتینی هەبوو. ڕۆژانە تا ١٥٠,٠٠٠ کاسات بۆ ١,٠٠٠ فرۆشکار و ٤٠٠,٠٠٠ فرۆشگە فرۆشت. راپۆرتەکان بتایبەتی دەڵێن لە سەرەتا ٩٠دان، فروشتیەکان گەیشتووە ١٨٠ ملیۆن—دووه‌می جیهان. بەرەو خوارەوە هاتنی MP3 و قاچاخ نایاسایی فڕۆشتنی گۆرانی فرۆشت. لە ٢٠٠٣-٠٤، مۆدێلی کاروبارەکە نییە. راپۆرتەکان دەڵێن فڕۆشتن لە دووبەر هاتە بار، و قاچاخ زیان زیادکردن. لە کێشەکاندا، TIPS ناردنی خۆی بۆ بازاڕی ملکەتی بەرزکرد، بەڵام هەڵوەشاندنی مەودا بەرگەڕاند و بەرزوبوون لە گۆرانی. جیاتی ئەوە، 'Race' لە ٢٠٠٨ گەیشتیە سەرکەوتوویی، و گۆرانی 'Pehli Nazar' بەتەنها یەکەوە ١٠ کرۆر عایدی بوو. کاروباری ring back tone بەرزبو و بەشە گۆرانی وصەڵە ئاشکرا ببێت. دواتر پلاتفۆرمە دیجییتاڵەکان وەک YouTube و Gaana پیدا بوون و TIPS لە ٢٠٠٧ چەنەلێکی یوتوبی کرایە ژوور. کارەباڕەکە گۆڕا بۆ آبونە و ڕێکلام. بە داهاتووی دیجییتاڵ و نرخەکانی داتای کەم، قاچاخ باشتر بوو. پێشەنگیی TIPS لە بوارەکە دا ستایشی زۆر کرد. بازاڕی هندێکی audio OTT لە ٣ ساڵیدا ١.٦ جار بەرەوپێشچوون کرا بەرەو ٤٦٠ ملیۆن هەڵگەڕاندن. کاتێک کۆمپانیاکە ئیش دەکات بۆ گەشەکردن، Kumar S. Taurani دەڵێت بازاڕی گۆرانی هندی دەگاتە ٨٠٠٠-٩٠٠٠ کرۆر لە ٣-٤ ساڵداهاتوو. TIPS هەوڵ دەدات بەشەکەی بەرز بکات و پێشنیازی بەرزکردنی بەشە نوێکان کردووە. ئیشناسە بازاڕی گۆرانییان وایە، تێکنەلۆژی نێوپەیوەندیەکانی نایاسایی پێویستە تۆمار بکرێت، ئەگەر بازارەکە دەتەوێتە جێ.

article_content: Amy Adams, known for her roles in 'Catch Me If You Can' and 'Junebug,' reveals her affinity for beauty products extends back to childhood—she even admits to borrowing her older sister’s mascara. Now at 33, the Colorado native, who stars this month in 'Enchanted' and appears in the upcoming 'Charlie Wilson’s War,' says she has left behind youthful acts of petty theft but not her enthusiasm for makeup. Adams enjoys sharing her favorite products, from Benetint lip balm to Go Smile tooth-whitening kits, often gifting friends items when she cleans out her makeup bag. When it comes to doing her own makeup, Adams considers it a learning process. She finds she does a decent job but still prefers the expertise of professionals for important events. She recalls an early Hollywood audition where her agent had to help her apply makeup because she 'didn’t seem like the kind of girl who would know how.' Today, Adams keeps her personal look understated, reserving glamorous touches for special occasions with friends. She admits that sometimes a new lip gloss is the perfect pick-me-up and confesses to carrying as many as ten in her purse at once. Perfume is another passion; she loves switching between Jo Malone scents like Nectarine Blossom & Honey, French Lime Blossom, and Orange Blossom according to her mood. Adams doesn’t commit to a signature fragrance. Skincare is a priority—she meticulously re-applies sunscreen when outdoors, recalling her sister’s nickname for her, 'Fish-Belly Blue,' as a nod to her fair complexion. Adams recounts a mishap in Italy after using low-SPF sunscreen, which led to a rash, and jokes about a water park heckler who told her to get a tan. To care for her skin, she relies on regular facials at Marion Simms’s Skin Sense in Los Angeles, a regimen she started while filming 'Catch Me If You Can' to combat dry skin. Her hair routine involves using Bumble and Bumble True Reds shampoo to maintain its vibrancy. Though she currently favors her red hair, Adams is open to changes and has thought about trying a platinum blond style like Christina Aguilera’s or Jean Harlow’s, reflecting how changes in hair color have influenced perceptions of her personality—from 'flighty' as a blonde to 'quirky' as a redhead. As for beauty tools, Adams enjoys using classic Conair hot rollers for effortless waves, claiming they're making a comeback. On her wish list? She jokes about always wanting to be taller—standing 5'5" and once a dancer, she admired the willowy effect, but now chooses to walk tall and wear wedges instead. To get Amy Adams’s look: Makeup artist Molly R. Stern achieved smoky eyes with Shu Uemura eyeshadow blended with taupe and a pearly green liner, paired with a beige lip pencil and Cover Girl Wetslicks Fruit Spritzers gloss in Guava Splash. Hairstylist Andy LeCompte created soft waves by setting Adams’s hair in pin curls, using a curling iron, mousse, and mixed-bristle brush, then finishing with Klorane Extra Gentle dry shampoo for added texture.

article_content: Benjamin Holloway, a 26-year-old driving instructor, has been sentenced to six years in prison after being caught dealing Class A drugs. Holloway turned to drug dealing, reportedly to raise £20,000 to save his family home after his business collapsed and left him in debt. At Birmingham Crown Court, it was revealed that Holloway, previously a hard-working instructor with no criminal record, became involved with drug gangs in his efforts to support his family. The case has drawn comparisons to the US TV drama Breaking Bad, where a teacher turns to crime out of financial desperation. Police arrested Holloway during a routine traffic stop in Birmingham on August 14 and found cocaine and amphetamines valued at £5 million in his Ford Focus. A subsequent search of his £130,000 home in Redditch uncovered over 50kg of amphetamines stored in his garden shed, as well as drug manufacturing equipment and five phones linked to contacts in Spain and Holland. Holloway, who pleaded guilty to conspiracy to supply cocaine and amphetamines, was told by Judge Roderick Henderson that although he had never been in trouble with the police before, he had played a significant role in the conspiracy, not just acting as a courier. Police also found evidence that Holloway was living beyond what his job as a driving instructor would afford, noting possessions such as two flat-screen TVs and a baby grand piano in his semi-detached home. Defending Holloway, Imran Shafi stated that more powerful drug dealers exploited his client's vulnerable financial position and that Holloway was drawn into the operation by the possibility of quick money. Local driving instructor Donna Scott commented on Holloway’s actions, saying he behaved recklessly: 'He appeared a bit of a wide boy, but I never thought he would be involved in something like this. I only used to see him at the driving centre and didn’t know him well, but his driving style was questionable for a driving instructor.'

Donna Scott، مامۆستای شوفێرێکی ناوخۆ، لەسەر کارەکانی هۆلاوەی ووتی کەسی گرنگبووە: 'وەک پیاوێکی گەورە وەری گردبوو، بەڵام هەرگیز بیرم نەچووە ئۆکە ئەمە بکات. تەنیا لە ناو کەندەکەی فێرکردن بینیدمەوە و زۆر پشت بەر نەبووم. شێوازی شوفێرکردنی بە پەردەمانە بوو.'

article_content: Frustrated by the lack of affordable and appealing electric vehicles (EVs)? Tesla may have the answer. The company quietly introduced a new base model of its popular Model Y SUV, making it one of the most attractive deals currently available in the US EV market. The new rear-wheel-drive (RWD) Model Y was added to Tesla's website on Monday, starting at $43,990. With the full $7,500 federal tax credit (which not all EVs qualify for), the effective price drops to $36,490. For comparison, the average price of a new car in August was $48,451, according to Kelley Blue Book. The next cheapest Model Y starts at $50,490. Tesla estimates the range of the new RWD Model Y at 260 miles per charge. While that's less than some other Tesla models, it's competitive for its price. Affordability has been an ongoing challenge for EVs. The most budget-friendly options often have limited range, smaller size, fewer features, or a mix of these drawbacks. For example, the electric Mini Cooper costs about $30,000 but offers only 115 miles of range. The Chevrolet Bolt EV and Bolt EUV (hatchback and SUV versions) are even less expensive but are built on older technology. The same applies to the Nissan Leaf, another hatchback. The arrival of the RWD Model Y gives shoppers seeking a spacious interior, Tesla’s well-known technology, access to the Supercharger network, and a price in the mid-$30,000 range a new option. The Volkswagen ID.4 Pro SUV, priced at $43,995 and eligible for the $7,500 tax credit, offers an estimated 275 miles of range. The Kia Niro EV ($39,550) and Hyundai Kona EV ($33,550) are comparable in price and range, but may not offer the cutting-edge appeal some buyers want. Unlike some competitors, Volkswagen, Hyundai, and Kia have not yet secured deals for access to Tesla’s Supercharger network. To qualify for the full tax credit—and therefore the lowest Model Y price—buyers must have an income below $150,000 for individuals or $300,000 for married couples. article_content: England suffered a narrow 24-21 defeat to New Zealand at Twickenham on Saturday, marking their fifth consecutive loss to the All Blacks. Stuart Lancaster’s team took an early lead as Jonny May scored his first Test try, but New Zealand soon responded. Tries from Aaron Cruden, Richie McCaw, and Charlie Faumuina put the visitors ahead for good, with a late penalty try for England proving insufficient. Despite the result, there were positives for England. May’s early try demonstrated his ability to score at the international level, dispelling doubts about his finishing skills. England began the match with a semi-reserve side due to numerous injuries, but they matched New Zealand for much of the contest, especially in the first half. Players like Dave Attwood and George Kruis stepped up, suggesting England’s squad depth is robust. Captain Chris Robshaw delivered another strong performance, working tirelessly and matching Richie McCaw’s efforts. The combination of Robshaw, Tom Wood, and Billy Vunipola in the back row was effective and should continue into future matches. A key area for improvement identified by Lancaster and his coaching staff is England’s clinical edge. Several scoring chances went unconverted in the first half, which proved costly, as New Zealand capitalized on their opportunities with efficient finishing—exemplified by their multi-phase build-up to Faumuina’s try. Becoming more clinical remains a priority ahead of upcoming tournaments. England’s scrum became a potent weapon in the closing stages. The replacement front row of Rob Webber, Matt Mullan, and Kieran Brookes dominated at the set-piece, culminating in a penalty try. With players like Alex Corbisiero still to return from injury, England’s scrum is likely to remain a major strength moving forward.

article_content:
The United States is ramping up intelligence cooperation with countries across Asia in an effort to counter Beijing's advanced espionage networks and cyberattacks. According to U.S. officials, the Biden administration has established several overlapping partnerships, including intelligence-sharing arrangements with the Quad nations (U.S., India, Japan, and Australia), as well as trilateral groups uniting the U.S., Japan, and South Korea, and another with the U.S., Japan, and the Philippines. These collaborations aim to enhance regional defenses against Chinese online operations.

The push also includes strengthened bilateral intelligence sharing with countries such as Japan, India, and Vietnam, focusing on boosting resilience to Chinese cyber offensives. These efforts, formally known as intelligence liaison relationships, are part of a strategy to reduce the growing power of China’s spy apparatus, which a recent UK parliamentary report described as the world’s largest.

Daniel Byman, an expert at the Center for Strategic and International Studies in Washington, highlighted that 'intelligence liaison can serve as an important force multiplier' because different countries can access unique information sources. While the Office of the Director of National Intelligence and White House spokespeople declined to comment on specific arrangements, Japan's Cabinet Secretary for Public Affairs Noriyuki Shikata confirmed deepening cooperation on security and intelligence matters.

Some partners believe these ties could help provide security reassurance in the event of a significant shift in U.S. politics, such as a change in administration. Notably, enhanced ties have already yielded results: late last year, India reportedly used U.S. intelligence to repel a Chinese military incursion in the Himalayas. In May 2022, the Quad announced a pact to provide commercial satellite data to Pacific nations, helping them monitor Chinese maritime militia activity, smuggling, and illegal fishing.

Japan's progress in information security has also encouraged deeper collaboration. In May, the U.S. Space Force delivered sensitive satellite-tracking equipment to Japan, and Japan’s Defense Minister Minoru Kihara pledged to upgrade information protection and cybersecurity alongside U.S. support. However, some concerns persist about the U.S.'s own ability to protect secrets—most notably, the Justice Department’s April indictment of Jack Teixeira, a National Guard airman, for leaking classified documents.

These partnerships are intended to complement, not replace, the Five Eyes alliance (U.S., U.K., Canada, Australia, and New Zealand), the backbone of U.S. intelligence sharing. While Five Eyes has shifted more focus towards China, its predominantly English-speaking makeup limits its reach in Asia. Cooperation frameworks in Asia are newer, and it will take time for them to match Five Eyes' sophistication, but experts believe Asian countries like Japan and South Korea are becoming increasingly crucial for addressing the China challenge.

ویلایەتە یەکگرتووەکان هاوکاری ئینتەلەجێنس وەکو پێشتر لەگەڵ وڵاتانی ئاسیا بەشداری دەکات بۆ بەربەستن لە هێرشە جاسوسی و سایبەرییەکانی چین. بەپێی وتەی ئەفسەرانی حکومەتی ئەمریکا، بەرهەم هاتووی پارتنەرشیپی جیاواز درووست کراوە و هاوکاری زانیاری لەگەڵ گروپی Quad (ئەمریکا، هندستان، ژاپۆن و ئەسترالیا) و تریلاتەرا چووبەڕوویەكی تێدایە (ئەمریکا ـ ژاپۆن ـ کۆریای باشوور و ئەمریکا ـ ژاپۆن ـ فلیپین). ئەمانە هەوڵ دەدەن بەرگری زیاتر لە هەڵڤەشانی چین بکەن.

هاوکارییەکان بەشێوەی تایبەتی لەگەڵ وڵاتانی وەک ژاپۆن، هندستان و ڤیتنامیش زیاتر بەهێز بوون. ئەم هەوڵانە (لێکدان وراپەیوندی ئینتەلەجێنس) پەیوەندی بە کەمکردنەوەی کردە جێگری چین دەن و ئەو جێگرییە لەلایەن راپۆرتی پاڕلامانی بەریتانیاوه‌ وەک گەورەترین لە جیهان ناسراوە.

دانیێل بایمن، شارەزای (CSIS) لە واشنگتن، وتی: "په‌یوەندی ئینتەلەجێنس دەتوانێت بێت بە کرتەکەر لە بەرهەم هێنانی زانیاری بۆ هەموو ئەندامان، چونکە هەر وڵاتێک زانیاری تایبەتی خۆی دەست دەکات." ئەفسەرانی ئامادەبوون و ناطقانی وتەنگێ وەڵامی وردی پێنا دا بۆ ئەم پەیوەندییە، بەڵام نۆرییووکی شیکاتا، وەزیری کۆبینه‌ی ژاپۆن هاوکاری زیاتر لە لایەن ژاپۆنەوە تایدەکات.

هەندێکیان دەبینن ئەم پەیوەندیانە بەرانبەر سەرچاوی پاراستن لە ڕووی گۆڕانکاری سیاسییەکان. ئەمانە هەبوونەکانیان پیشاندا: ساڵی رابردو، هندستان پەیوەندی زانیاریی ئەمریکای بەکارهێنا بۆ واژووی لێخۆشانێکی سەربازیی چین. لە ئایاری ٢٠٢٢ Quad کۆبوونەوەی داتا سەتلایتی بۆ وڵاتانی ئاسیای باشوور راگەیاند بۆ چاودێری فەعالیەتی مافیا مەرەی چین و قاچاخ و ماسیگیری نەقەس.

پیشکەوتنی پاراستی زانیاری لە ژاپۆن هاوکاری زیاتر هەیە. لە مانگی ئایاردا یەکەی ناسخانەی ئامریکا کەمەرەی ساتەلایت بۆ ژاپۆن نارد و وەزیرى بەرگری ژاپۆن مینورۆ کیهارا پلتە ڕادەید بەرزکردنەوەی پاراستنی زانیاری و توانایی سایبەری وەک هاوكارییەکی ئاسایی لەگەڵ ئامریکا. تەنها هەستی توندخراوە لە ڕووی پاراستنی زانیاری تەنیشتیدا بۆ ناوچوونی زانیاری تەرخانکراوی جک تێشیەیرا دەکرێت.

ئه‌م پەیوەندییانە بۆ پێشکەوتن و پەیوەندی های "Five Eyes" (ئەمریکا، بەریتانیا، کەنەدا، ئەسترالیا و نیوزلەندا)ە کە یەكەم ئاینەی هاوكاری ئینتەلەجێنسە. ئەو یەكگرتنە خوای بەرزهانە بۆ چین نیشاندە، بەڵام ئەندامی ئینگلیزی ناوچەکە سنووردار دەکاتەوە. چارچووبه‌ی هاوکاری ئینتەلەجێنس لە ئاسیا تازەیە، بەڵام شارەزایان باوەربەربن وڵاتانی وەک ژاپۆن و کۆریای باشور گرنگتر دەبن لە رووبەڕووی تەنانەتەکانی چین.

article_content: A lesson at Eastfield Primary School in Hull, East Yorkshire, has left some pupils as young as nine frightened of the bathroom after they were played audio from the famous shower scene in Alfred Hitchcock's 1960 film 'Psycho.' The lesson aimed to show how music can create mood, but parent Karen Kay expressed significant concern, saying her son Jason is now too scared to shower and insists on carrying a plastic sword to the bathroom. Ms. Kay said Jason needs adult supervision during bathroom visits and cannot sleep alone. She explained, 'The music in the murder scene is frightening; the children heard a woman scream and a body fall. This has greatly affected Jason, and I am upset with the school.' The school apologized and is reviewing the music used in lessons. Headteacher Katie Beal stated, 'The lesson was to demonstrate how music creates mood, using sound-only clips from films. No descriptions or dialogue from the film were given, though some children guessed the movie.' Ms. Kay said other parents were also surprised, and she urged the school to review material for age-appropriateness. The 'Psycho' shower scene, featuring actress Janet Leigh, is widely known for its suspenseful music and is iconic in film history.
translated_content: لە وانەیەک لە قوتابخانەی بنەڕەتی Eastfield لە Hull، بەشی East Yorkshire، هەندێک قوتابی تەمەنیان نزیکەی نۆ ساڵ بوو، ترسیدووەن لە چوونە ژووری تازەبەرزکردنەوە دوای ئەوەی مامۆستایەک دەنگی شەوەی فلیمە ناودارەکەی Alfred Hitchcock لە ساڵی 1960، 'Psycho' پێیان گوێخرا. ئامانجی وانەکە ئەو بوو پیشاندانی ئەوەی چۆن موزیک دەتوانێت مۆڕ دروست بکات، بەڵام دایک Karen Kay قالەکەی غەمگین کردووە و داوای وردبینیی زیاتر کردووە، ووتی کوڕەکەی Jason ئێستا ترسیدووە لە چوونە ژوور و هەروەها پلاستیکی خۆی دەگرێت بۆ ژوور. خانم Kay وتی Jason پێویستە لە کاتی چوونە ژوور و قسەکردن پێشبانی گەورە هەبێت و ناتوانێت تەنها بخوە. ووتی 'ئەو موزیکەی دەنگی شەشەکە ترسناکە، منداڵەکان دەنگی قسەکردنی ژنەکە و کەوتنی لاشە لە شەوەیان بیست. ئەمە کاریگەری زۆری لەسەر Jason هەبوو و خەمخورم بۆ قوتابخانەکە.' قوتابخانەکە پوزەخۆی دا و ووتی زانیارییەکان دەربارەی موزیک دەبیننەوە بۆ وانەکان. سەرۆکی قوتابخانە، Katie Beal، وتی: 'ئامانجی وانەکە پیشاندانی چۆنیەتی دروست کردن مۆڕ بە موزیک بوو، بە بەکارهێنانی پارچەی دەنگی فیلمەکان. هیچ شارەزانی یان گفتوگۆی فیلمەکە نەکرا، هەندێک منداڵ هەوڵیان دا فیلمەکە بگەڕانەوە.' خانم Kay وتی باوەڕی ئەرکدارانی دیکەشی هەیە و داوای کردە مادەکانی وانە بە تەواوی بپێی تەمەنی قوتابیان دەستکاری بکرێت. شەشەی فیلمی 'Psycho' کە لە سەر بازیگری Janet Leigh دەکرێت یەکێکە لە نیشانەدارترین سەردەمەکانی سینەما.

With assembly elections set for later this year in Madhya Pradesh, the government led by Shivraj Singh Chouhan has introduced a policy to reserve 35% of government jobs for women, except those in the forest department. This move highlights the growing influence of women voters in the state, whose electoral participation has at times exceeded that of men. To appeal to this demographic, political parties have implemented measures like subsidized transport, healthcare, housing schemes for women, affordable cooking gas, and increased maternity benefits.

Such initiatives demonstrate an awareness of the longstanding obstacles facing women in the workforce and society. Although the political discussion has traditionally focused on men, recent changes—including a constitutional amendment securing one-third of seats in legislative bodies for women—represent hard-won progress. Achieving real equality requires not just policy change from above but also broader cultural shifts toward fairness and opportunity.

However, it is important that these actions expand opportunities for women without confining them to specific roles or treating them simply as recipients of charity. Policies and public discussions should respect women as equal citizens and avoid patronizing attitudes. Lessons from other areas of social progress should inform these efforts, making sure that empowering women leads to greater unity and freedom, rather than causing new divides.

article_content: During some of the most challenging moments of the Second World War, pin-up images served as a unique source of morale for battle-weary Allied troops. These images, often of glamorous women depicted in playful or alluring poses, were distributed in various forms, including postcards, magazines, and decorations on military equipment. Maintaining the spirits of service members facing the horrors of war was considered as essential as ensuring adequate supplies. Thousands of these images, like the popular American actress Betty Grable and iconic illustrations such as 'Hit the Deck', were sent out to soldiers across the front lines. Author Mike Brown has curated a collection of nostalgic and historic pin-up images in his latest book, 'The Pin-up in World War II'. The book celebrates feminine beauty through illustrations, photographs, and cartoons, many of which originated from amusement arcades or popular publications of the time. Contrary to imagined armies of women, the morale-boosting force consisted largely of images rather than real individuals. Among the most famous pin-ups was 'Jane', the cartoon heroine from the Daily Mirror, who became renowned for lighthearted depictions during the Blitz and was said to be painted on the first British armored vehicle that landed on D-Day in June 1944. Winston Churchill humorously referred to Jane as 'Britain’s secret weapon.' Alongside illustrated figures, there were also photographs and postcards of women, sometimes dressed in uniform to show support for the war effort. Such images brightened barracks, mess halls, and even adorned Allied aircraft as reminders of home. Brown’s book documents the evolution of the pin-up, tracing its origins to the late 19th century with the rise of photography and the infamous 'French postcards.' By World War II, pin-ups had become cherished symbols for millions of young men separated from their families and enduring the hardships of war. The book includes a wide variety of images from the UK, U.S., France, and Germany. Brown notes that during the 1930s and 1940s, barrack rooms across Europe displayed pin-ups on walls, notice boards, or tucked away in drawers and kitbags, and that such images were as much a part of military life as uniforms and equipment. 'The Pin-up in World War II' is available now, published by Sabrestorm and priced at £6.99 through bookshops and online retailers.

'پین-ئەپ لە جەنگی دووەمی جیهان' ئێستا بەردەستە، لەلایەن Sabrestorm بڵاوکراوەتەوە و بە نرخێکی £6.99 لە کتێبفرۆشی و فڕۆشتنی ئۆنلاین.

article_content: Police in Kansas City are urging motorists to remain alert following 13 shooting incidents reported over the past month on major highways and roads throughout the Missouri city. According to CNN affiliate KCTV, some drivers have expressed unease. “A little uneasy. It's unaimed, not targeted. You don't know who they are shooting at. It could be anybody,” said driver Ashley Quinn. As a precaution, some motorists are opting for secondary roads, especially at night. Police reported that no new shootings have occurred since Sunday. Since March 8, three people have been shot, though none suffered life-threatening injuries. Most affected vehicles were struck in the driver's or front passenger's doors. Of the 13 shootings, 10 took place in Kansas City and one each in Blue Springs, Leawood, and Lee’s Summit. Police are also reviewing additional reports, some preceding March 8, to determine potential connections. Authorities are not disclosing many specifics from witnesses but indicated that several shootings are likely related. In response, police have increased patrols in the areas where most shootings occurred.

article_content: Hong Kong Disneyland opened its first Frozen-themed attraction on Monday, drawing thousands of excited visitors, some of whom lined up for hours to experience the new rides. Inspired by Disney’s hit ‘Frozen’ animated film, the new area features scenes, characters, and two new rides – a roller coaster and a boat that journeys through different moments from the film. “Over the past decade, the film has become one of the most successful franchises in Disney history,” said Josh D’Amaro, chairman of Disney Experiences. “World of Frozen represents Hong Kong Disneyland’s largest and most ambitious expansion since the park opened in 2005.” The opening follows Disney’s announcement in September of a $60 billion expansion of its parks and cruises over the next ten years. With Chinese tourists travelling more after the pandemic, the new attraction aims to revitalize a park that faced financial losses for years. Many Disney fans arrived hours early, with some dressed as ‘Frozen’ characters. Bryan Darmanic, a visitor from California with his wife and daughter, was among the first to ride the new roller coaster and received limited edition souvenirs. “The World of Frozen is really well-designed and beautiful,” Darmanic said, noting this visit was their first to Hong Kong Disneyland. Winnie Ip, a tourist from Macao, arrived at 9 a.m. ahead of the opening and described the attractions as “magnificent.” To draw more visitors, Hong Kong Disneyland debuted its ‘Momentous’ multimedia and fireworks show in June 2022, held at its castle most nights. Elsewhere, Disney plans to launch a Zootopia-themed area at Shanghai Disneyland in December, a Fantasy Springs port at Tokyo DisneySea next spring, and a Frozen-themed Kingdom of Arendelle at Disneyland Paris, expected to open in 2024 or 2025.

article_content: The Anambra State Command of the Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps (NSCDC) has reiterated its commitment to eradicating crude oil theft, illegal petroleum dealings, and pipeline vandalism within the state. Commandant Edwin Osuala made this assertion in Awka on Tuesday, following his receipt of six suspects apprehended by Nigerian Navy officers from the Onitsha Outpost. The suspects were formally handed over to the NSCDC for further investigation and potential prosecution. According to a press release from NSCDC's Public Relations Officer, Okadigbo Edwin, the arrests took place as follows: On November 3, 2023, around 6:00 am, Ugwu Donatus (57), Chukwudi Eke (52), and Nwabueze Daniel (30) were arrested along Atani Road in Odekpe Community, Ogbaru Local Government Area (LGA) of Anambra State. They were found transporting 70 sacks of petroleum products, amounting to about 3,500 litres of suspected adulterated Automotive Gas Oil, in a white Nissan vehicle (Enugu ENU 391 XX). Similarly, on November 7, 2023, at approximately 1:00 pm, Chinedu Okafor (32), Abu Galaddima (42), and Rishamah Abbass (29) were arrested in Odekpe Community, Ogbaru LGA. They were found with two white J5 vans (Anambra XA 929 ZBL and Anambra AWK 776 YZ), carrying 100 sacks of products suspected to be illegally refined Automotive Gas Oil estimated at about 5,000 litres. Initial investigations indicate the products were loaded at Osssamala Community in Ogbaru LGA and were en route to Upper Iweka. The alleged owner, Emeka Emeka, is currently at large, with continued efforts underway to apprehend him. Commandant Osuala stated that all suspects are cooperating and providing useful information to aid further arrests. He commended the Nigerian Navy for their vital support and highlighted the effective collaboration between the NSCDC and the Navy in fighting economic crimes. He assured the public that comprehensive investigations and potential prosecution will follow, emphasizing the unity among security agencies in Anambra State against crime. Osuala issued a strong warning to those involved in illegal oil activities to leave Anambra State, noting intensified security operations throughout the region. He encouraged all residents to remain vigilant and provide credible information to help address economic sabotage and related criminal activities.

Osuala ئاگاداری قورس پێشکەش کرد بە هەموو تاوانکارانی چالاکی نەوتی قەچاغ بۆ جێهێشتنی Anambra بەرەو دەر، ووتی چالاکیەکانیان بەرزی هەیە. هاوڵاتییان ڕاگەیاند یەکەم هشیار بن و زانیاری دەقی دەپێشن بۆ یارمەتیدانی دژ بە تاوان و قەچاغی ئابووری.

- Creamed Corn: Buttery and creamy, easily made with frozen corn.

article_content: The European Parliament is expected to pass legislation that will allow each EU country to decide independently about growing genetically modified (GM) crops. This would lift a decade-long block on commercial GM cultivation in Britain and elsewhere. According to the new rules, a GM crop must first gain safety approval from the European Food Safety Authority (EFSA). After that, individual countries can choose whether to permit or prohibit its cultivation. The UK government has been a strong advocate for this policy change. Following confidential meetings with biotech companies and their representatives, ministers have worked to restart GM farming in England, even as nations like Germany and France maintain bans. While the main UK political parties in Westminster (Conservative, Labour, and Liberal Democrats) support GM crops, opposition remains from Scotland, Wales, and some local councils in England. There is ongoing public concern over potential threats to health and the environment. Environmentalists and organic farmers warn that experience in North America shows large-scale GM farming can lead to the rise of herbicide-resistant weeds and negatively affect wildlife, such as Monarch butterflies. There are also fears about GM pollen contaminating traditional and organic agriculture. Initially, the GM crops likely to appear in Britain are glyphosate-resistant maize and corn, developed by Syngenta and Monsanto, allowing for extensive use of herbicides without harming the crops themselves. Proponents of genetic modification argue that it can increase harvests, improve nutrition, and help crops withstand drought, while some critics worry about environmental harm and greater threats to biodiversity. This shift diverges from previous EU principles that required shared agricultural standards. Now, countries in favor, such as Britain and Spain, can advance GM farming, while others may continue bans. The policy results from efforts by former UK Environment Secretary Owen Paterson, Spanish ministers, and a series of confidential discussions between government and the biotech industry, details of which surfaced through Freedom of Information requests. Groups like GeneWatch and GM Freeze contend that the law lacks sufficient protections against contamination and does not ensure clear consumer choice. England’s Environment Secretary Liz Truss supports GM crops, but Scotland’s Richard Lochhead remains cautious, citing unresolved scientific and environmental questions. The debate remains divisive across the UK and Europe.

ڕێگە دەدات قەدەغەکردنی ١٠ ساڵ لەسەر گەڵکردنی حەسوینەکانی جێنتێکی گۆڕدراو لە بەریتانیا و شوێنەکانی تر لاببرێت. لە پەیوەندی یاسایە نوێکان، پێویستە حەسوینەکانی جێنتێکی گۆڕدراو بەپێی مەرجەکان لەلایەن ئیدارەی پاراستنی سەلامەتی خواردنەوەی ئەورووپا (EFSA)‎ پاراستی بکەن، و دواوە هەر وڵاتەکە دەتوانێت بڕیار بدات کە دەستپێکردنی گەڵکردنی یان قەدەغەکردنی حەسوینەکا بکرێت. حکومەتی بەریتانیا رۆڵێکی گرنگ لە پێشبردنی ئەم گۆڕانکارییە هەبووە. کۆبونەوەکانى نهێنیان لەگەڵ کۆمپانیاکانى تێکنەلۆژی جێنتێکی گۆڕدراو و وەکێڵانیان کرابوە و وەزیران هەوڵیان داوە گەڵکردنی GM لە ئینگلتەرە دانێنێنەوە، ئەگەرچی وڵاتانی وەک گەڵکردنی GM. هەروەها، ترس و نیگەرانی جەمەهیر سەبارەت بە مەترسیەکانی تەندروستی و ژینگە هەیە. چاودێرانى ژینگە و کشتوکاڵکارانى ئۆرگانیک ئاگادار دەکەن کە لە نۆرد ئەمریکا گەڵکردنی زۆر حەسوینەکانی جێنتێکی article_content: On Monday, Russian state-run news outlets published, then quickly withdrew, reports that Russian forces had pulled back from positions on the eastern (left) bank of the Dnipro River. The initial reports, quoting Russia’s defense ministry, suggested troops were being moved to 'more favorable positions' on the Russian-held eastern side. Shortly thereafter, these stories disappeared. Russia's defense ministry dismissed the claim as a 'false report,' blaming Ukraine. Meanwhile, Ukrainian officials alleged the announcement was actually a Russian misinformation operation targeting them. This confusion emerged nearly a year after Russia pulled troops out of the right bank of the Dnipro, including Kherson. The river remains a major frontline, keeping Ukrainian and Russian forces separated. According to the now-revoked reports from news agencies Tass and RIA-Novosti, Russia said it had repositioned soldiers east of the river to 'free up some of its forces for offensive actions elsewhere,' echoing language from earlier Russian withdrawals. The Kremlin declined to comment, saying any questions should be directed to the military. Recently, Ukrainian forces have stepped up raids across the Dnipro as part of an ongoing counteroffensive, aimed at cutting through Russian-held land and isolating Crimea, which Moscow annexed in 2014. Russia claimed last Friday it had thwarted a Ukrainian attempt to form a beachhead that could be used for advancing heavy equipment. However, the US-based Institute for the Study of War (ISW) recently reported that despite Moscow’s efforts, Ukrainian troops have managed to move more personnel and equipment onto the river’s east bank. Elsewhere, Ukrainian officials reported that three civilians were killed during Russian strikes on Kherson Monday. Over the weekend, Ukrainian intelligence claimed responsibility for an explosion that killed at least three Russian officers in occupied Melitopol, describing it as 'an act of revenge' by local resistance fighters. Ukrainian-linked groups have continued targeting Russian officials and collaborators, often using car bombs or explosives. Just last week, former separatist militia chief Mikhail Filiponenko was killed in the occupied city of Luhansk in an attack claimed by Ukraine.
translated_content: لە دووشەممەدا، میدیا دولەتییەکانی روسیا هەواڵێکی بڵاوکردەوە و پاشان زوو سڕانیەوە کە گووتبوو عەسکەری روسیا لە شوێنەکانیان لە کەناری باشووری (چەپی) ڕووباری دنیپڕۆ دواوە بوونەوە. لە هەواڵەکانی یەکەم، کە دەستنیشانەی وەزارەتی بەرگری روسیا بوون، وترا عەسکرەکان 'بۆ شوێنێکی گونجاوتری گواستران.' زوو یەکەم هەواڵەکان سڕانەوە. وەزارەتی بەرگری روسیا هەواڵەکە ڕەتکردەوە و سەرکوتی ئەوکراین داوتەوە. لە لایەکی تر، ئەوکراین بانگەوازکرد هەواڵەکە کارەساتی دەرکردنی زانیارییەکی روسیا بۆیانە. ئەم تێکەڵییە نزیکە ساڵێک لەو کاتە دەبێتەوە کە روسیا عەسکرەکانی لە کەناری ڕاستی (سەربەخۆ) ڕووبارەکە هەبووەوە، لە جۆری خەرسۆن. ڕووباری دنیپڕۆ تاکو ئێستا لە نێوان حیزبە ئەوکراین و روسیا دابەشکاریە. بەپێی هەواڵەکانی تاس و ریا-نوۆڤۆسنی کە پاشان ڕاگیرا، قوترا عەسکرەکە گواسترابوون بۆ باشووری ڕووبار بۆ ئەوەی 'هانی خونەکانیان بۆ شەڕەکانی تر بەکاردەن.' ئەمە وا دەبێتە هەمان وشەی ڕووداوەکان کە لە پێشووەوەی عەسکرە روسیا بوو. کریملین هیچ وتەیەکی نەدا و وتی ئەمە ماددەیەکەی عەسکرەکانە. لە ڕۆژانەکانی دوا، ئەوکراین هەجومەکانی خۆی زیاد کرد لەسەر دنیپڕۆ بە بەشێوەیەکی کۆنتەر-هێرشە بۆ بڕینە سەر خەتی روسیا و دابەزاندنی راهێنانەکە بۆ کریمیا، کە موسکۆ لە ٢٠١٤ تاکۆ ئێستا بوە بە خاکی خۆی. روسیا وتی هەفتەی ڕابردو هەجومێکی ئەوکراین بۆ دانانی بەرزەری شەقام بەسەرکەوتووتی ڕەوانە کردووە، کە دەتوانی بکوێتە هۆی پێشبردنی چەکە گەورەکان. بەڵام، مۆسەسەی ئەمریکییەکەی فێرکاری بەرزکردنەوەی شەڕ (ISW) دەڵێ، خەباتەکانی روسیا کاریگەری نەھێنا بۆ ڕاستکردنەوەی عەسکرەکانی ئەوکراین بۆ کەناری باشووەوە لە ڕووبارەکە. لە شوێنێکی تر، دەسەڵاتدارانی ئەوکراین وتیان سێ هاووڵاتی لە تووشبوونی هەڵمەتی روسیا لە خەرسۆن گیانیان لەدەستدا. لە شەممە، زانیاریە عەسکرییەکان ئەوکراین بابەتبەر بوو بە تەقینەوەیەک کە سێ عەسکەرێکی روسی لە مەلیتۆپۆل کۆژران و بانگەوازیان کردەوە بۆ ئەوەی بەسەرکەوتنی تۆڵەکردن لەلایەن پێشمەرگە محلی. گروپە بە پەیوەندیداران بە ئەوکراین بەردەوامن لە هەدف گرتنی لایەنە بەرپرسە روسیەکان و هاوکارییەکان بە بەکارهێنانی بوم و تەقینەوە. هەفتەی رابردو، سەرۆکی پێشووی میلیشیا فیلێپۆنێنکۆ لە لوهانسک کوژرا و ئەم کارەش لەلایەن ئەوکراین داوە.

article_content: A unique subset of YouTube users enjoys listening to cats purring, like the hour-long audio of Phantom the cat shared in March by Digihaven. This tranquil enjoyment was interrupted when YouTube’s automated Content ID flagged the video as copyright infringement, citing music rights owned by EMI and PRS for Music. The claim forced Digihaven to lose advertising revenue, as YouTube diverted it to the alleged rights holders. TorrentFreak reported on the incident, explaining that, after Digihaven disputed the decision, EMI eventually withdrew its complaint. Critics argue that Content ID often misidentifies harmless uploads, causing problems for many creators. Previous controversies involving Content ID include mass copyright claims against gaming videos, highlighting recurring reliability issues with YouTube’s automation systems. In a separate incident, the Irish word for film, 'scannán', was reportedly being used to hide explicit videos from YouTube’s automated detection. A media student in Galway uncovered these videos, which appeared to be uploaded by non-native Irish speakers using translation software, according to journalist Maitíú Ó Coimín of Tuairisc. These situations put a spotlight on ongoing gaps in YouTube’s enforcement and moderation processes, frustrating both niche content communities and speakers of minority languages.

article_content: Jonathan Roth, age 22, was arrested on Monday on charges of insurance fraud, filing a false report, and conspiracy to commit insurance fraud, as confirmed by the Nassau County District Attorney. This arrest comes after the striking disappearance of his father, Raymond Roth, 47, who was presumed drowned after swimming at Jones Beach, New York. Five days later, Raymond was discovered alive after being stopped for speeding in South Carolina, more than 700 miles away. Investigators allege that Raymond Roth tried to fake his death, leaving behind personal effects—shoes, clothes, wallet, and cell phone—on the beach to make it look as though he had drowned. This act launched a vast and costly search operation involving both air and water teams. Jonathan Roth reported his father missing on July 28, sparking the search. He insists that he had no involvement in the supposed plot and denies receiving any messages about it, as well as claiming his stepmother had no computer access. Jonathan’s denial came after Mrs. Roth, Raymond’s wife, found several emails between Raymond and Jonathan sent before the disappearance. These messages, described by the New York Post, included instructions about handling family matters and orchestrating Raymond’s disappearance. One message even directed Jonathan to contact Raymond at a resort using a pay phone at a specifically arranged time. Following these revelations, Mrs. Roth filed for divorce and took out a restraining order, citing fear for her safety due to Raymond’s alleged abusive conduct. She accused Jonathan of knowing about or helping with the plan, but Jonathan has firmly denied any such role. Despite being presumed drowned, Raymond was found driving in Santee, South Carolina—far from where he was said to be missing. Notably, the family’s four-bedroom home was listed for sale for over $500,000 just a week before Raymond disappeared. Neighbors and law enforcement records confirm Jonathan called 911 to report Raymond missing from an area at Jones Beach without lifeguards present. Shortly after, Jonathan was heard telling neighbors he believed his father was dead. Authorities are still investigating the true sequence of events and clarifying the responsibilities of each family member.
translated_content: جۆناتان ڕۆث، ٢٢ ساڵە، لە دووشەممە دەستگیرکرا بە تاوانی فڕۆدکردنی بیمە، دانانی راپۆرتی درووست، و هەڵوەشاندن بۆ فڕۆدکردنی بیمە، وەک پەسەندکرا لە لایەن فەرمانگەی دادپەروەری ناساوو کانتی. ئەم دەستگیرکردنە دواتر لە ونبوونی باوکەی، ڕیمۆند ڕۆث، ٤٧ ساڵە، ئەنجامدرا کە گومان لەسەری کردووە مردووە لە کاتی مۆلەتەکەی لە Jones Beach، نیویۆرک. پاش پێنج ڕۆژ، ڕیمۆند لە سکارۆلاینای باشوور دۆزرایەوە کاتێک پۆلیس هەنگاوەکەی باست کردووە. ئەرکی تاقیکەرەوەکان ئەوەیە کە ڕیمۆند ڕۆث هەوڵی فێککردنی مردنی خۆیدا وە بەجێهێشتنی کاڵاکانی کەوتنی فەرمی—پاوچە، جل، پارەدان و مۆبایل—لە سەر بەندەر. ئەم کردارە هێرشێکی بەرز و گرانبهێز بەرەوپێش هێنا. جۆناتان ڕۆث لە ٢٨ی تەممووز راپۆرتی ونبوونی باوکەی دا، بەهۆی ئەوە گەڕانی گەورە دەستپێکرد. بەرەوپێش ئەویش جۆناتان وتی تا هیچ داواکاری یان پەیامی تۆمار نەکراوە. ئیتر ووتی هاوسەرەکەی هیچ ده‌ست بۆ کۆمپیوتەرەکەی نەبووە. ردکردنی جۆناتان پاش ئەوە درووست بوو کە خانەوادەکەی ڕۆث، هاوسەرەکەی، چەند ئیمەیلیان دۆزیوە کە نێوان ڕێمۆند و جۆناتان ناردرا بەرەوپێش ونبوونەکە. ئەمیلیەکان، بە پەیوتەی پەیوەندیکردنی نەخوازراو و رێنمایی بۆ چاکسازی ئیشەکان لە خانوادە. لەیەک پەیامدا، ڕێمۆند داوای پەیوەندی لە پەی فۆن دەکات. دواتر، هاوسەرەکەی ڕۆث دادپەروەری و فەرمانی رووبەڕوو بێت بەهۆی ترسی ژیانەکی خۆی. وتی ڕیمۆند ناڕەحەم بوو و جۆناتان نیزیک بوو بە پلانی فێککردنی مردن، بەلام جۆناتان بەدوورخستنەوەی توند ڕەت دەکات. لە کاتی گومان کردن بەپیاوەکەی مردووە، ڕێمۆند لە سکارۆلاینای باشوور دۆزرایەوە. خانووەکەیان بۆ نرخی $٥٤٩,٩٩٩ فرۆشراوە تەنها هەفتەیەک پێش ونبوونەکە. دەرچووان و تۆمارە پۆلیسیەکان پشتڕاست دەکەن جۆناتان ٩١١ تۆمار کرد کاتێک ڕیمۆند لە ناوچەیەک لە Jones Beach کە نە lifeguard تێدایە ون بوو. پاش ئەم کاتە، جۆناتان بە هاوچەرخی گەورە دەڵێت باوکەکەی مردووە. هێشتا لێکۆلینەوە باسکراوە تا ڕووداوەکان و ئەرکی هەر کەسێک ئۆروکی شود.

article_content: High school students who have submitted Early Decision (ED), Early Action (EA), and BS/MD program applications may now wonder about the timeline for their admissions decisions. Acceptance to a top school or program can bring relief for students and families during this stressful process. Each early application type—ED, EA, or BS/MD—can result in acceptance, denial, or deferral. Students awaiting early decisions may feel anxious. What Does an Acceptance Mean? The next steps depend on the application type. With Early Action, students are not required to accept immediately; they have until May 1 to decide, allowing them to consider other acceptances and scholarship offers. Early Decision is binding—admitted students must attend unless the offered financial aid is insufficient. If the financial aid package is acceptable, the student usually must accept the offer within two weeks and withdraw other applications. For BS/MD program applicants—where students apply to undergraduate and medical school simultaneously—deadlines are typically in November. Unless an Early Decision was filed for the undergraduate institution, these acceptances are not binding, so students can explore other options. What Does a Rejection Mean? A rejection from one school does not affect chances at other competitive institutions; each school evaluates applicants independently. A balanced college list is important. Students cannot reapply to a school that rejects them during the same admissions cycle, but can still apply to other schools—including those with rolling admissions, regular decision, or Early Decision II (ED II). Applying through ED II carries the same obligations as original Early Decision. What Does a Deferral Mean? A deferral means the student’s application will be reviewed again in the regular decision pool. This is not a rejection, but a postponement. For ED applicants, deferral removes the binding requirement. Students should decide whether the school is still a top choice and follow directions carefully—if a letter of continued interest or updates are requested, send them; otherwise, do not send unsolicited materials, as this may hurt the application. What Happens Next? Each admissions plan—ED, EA, BS/MD—has its own notification process and commitments. Students should carefully read all school communications to understand their responsibilities. article_content: United Nations inspectors are set to visit Iran on Sunday to inspect a uranium mine in Yazd and a uranium-processing plant in Ardakan, according to Iran's semi-official Fars news agency. This will be the seventh such inspection in recent months. The visit comes as a May 15 deadline approaches for Iran to meet international requirements related to its nuclear program. In February, Iran and the International Atomic Energy Agency agreed on seven actions that Iran must take, as the United States, France, Russia, Germany, China, and the United Kingdom aim to negotiate a final agreement with Iran on May 13 in Vienna. Behrouz Kamalvandi, spokesperson for Iran's atomic energy department, stated that the country has already completed six of these steps, according to the official IRNA news agency. Many countries and international organizations have expressed concern that Iran's nuclear program could be used to develop atomic weapons. Iran asserts that its program is solely intended to produce nuclear power for civilian use. CNN's Shirzad Bozorgmehr and Reza Sayah contributed to this report.

article_content: Plastics are indispensable in today’s world due to their usefulness and cost-effectiveness in countless products. The U.S. Society of the Plastics Industry (SPI) claims that plastics make everyday life easier, a view supported by the many ways we rely on these materials—from food packaging to utensils. Yet, plastics also have a significant downside. Their production introduces harmful chemicals, and discarded plastic bags and bottles are a major source of environmental pollution worldwide. Not all plastics can be recycled equally; the numbered triangles on plastic products indicate their type rather than their recyclability. Generally, plastics marked with numbers 1, 2, 5, and 6 are widely accepted in recycling programs, while types 3, 4, and 7 are more challenging to recycle. There are health concerns too, particularly with plastics labeled 3, 6, and 7, as chemicals from these materials may leach into food or beverages, especially after prolonged use or exposure to heat. Types 1, 2, 4, and 5 are typically deemed safer for food storage. Of special concern is Bisphenol A (BPA), a chemical often found in plastics labeled 7, which has been linked by some scientists to hormonal disturbances and other health problems like cancer and developmental issues in children. In response to these concerns, Canada banned BPA in baby bottles in 2010.
translated_content: پلاستیک لە ژیانی ئەمڕۆدا گرنگە بەهۆی سوود و داهاتی زۆری کە لە ژیاندا دابین دەکات. ئەنجومەنی جۆری پلاستیک‌ی ئەمریکا (SPI) دەڵێت پلاستیک ژیان ئاسانتر دەکات، و ئەمە بە شێوەیەکی ئاشکرا لەچەندین کاڵا هەیە- وەک کرتی خواردن، قەش و چاقو و بەلگەوە. بەڵام لەگەڵ ئەو هەموو سوودانە، پلاستیک قەیرانەکی گەورەی محیط زیست و تەندرووستی هەیە. بەرهەمهێنانی پلاستیک ماددەی زیانبەری هەوا دەهێنێتە دەرەوە و پلاستیکە جەختەکانە بە شێوەیەکی ڕاغەندراو ئەوەرەی دەرەنجام دەبن. ژمارەی سێگۆشەی لەسەر پلاستیک جۆری پلاستیکەکە دیاری دەکات، نەوخۆشکەی بکەیتەوە. زۆربەی وڵاتان پلاستیکە بە ژمارەکانی ١، ٢، ٥ و ٦ بە ئاسانیدا دەتوانن بکرێنەوە، بەڵام ٣، ٤ و ٧ زۆر سەختە. هەروەهائەو پلاستیکانەی کە بە ژمارەی ٣، ٦ و ٧ دیاری کراون، مەشک وە دەکرێت ماددەی کیمیایی نەخوازراوی تێدا بیداتە خواردن- خواردنەوە- بەتایبەتی کاتێک بە درێژی یان لە گەرمی تەر هێناوە. پلاستیکە ١، ٢، ٤ و ٥ زۆرن بەتەواوی بەرزپیشەکراو بۆ نەگرتنی خواردن و خواردنەوە. ترسی زۆر بە Bisphenol A (BPA)ە، مادەی کیمیایی لە پلاستیکە ژمارە ٧ دادەبینیت کە بە تێکچوونی هۆرمۆنی و نەخۆشی وەک شەڕ، سەرەتا و خراپی گەشەدا پیوند درووست دکات. بۆ ئەم هۆکارانە، کانەدا (لە ٢٠١٠دا) بەکاربردنی BPA لە کازی منداڵ قەدەغە کرد.

Newly released thermal imaging photos reveal that most tents at the anti-capitalist protest outside St Paul’s Cathedral in London are unoccupied at night. The independent images, commissioned by the Daily Mail and supported by similar police helicopter footage, suggest that only a fraction of the camp is populated after dark. Yellow and red tones in the images indicate occupied tents, while purple signals emptiness. In daylight, the site appears much busier, but photos taken late at night support claims that many protestors leave to sleep elsewhere.

Despite the protest being mostly active during the day, activists last week forced St Paul’s Cathedral to close for the first time since the Blitz, with reopening possibly months away. Some officials and members of the public have called for police to remove the camp during these quieter night hours, with the Corporation of London considering legal options. Councillor Alex Deane and MP Mark Field suggested that the camp should be disbanded, arguing that public resources would be better spent elsewhere and emphasizing the largely vacant site at night.

Protesters contest the claim that 90 percent of tents are empty overnight. Representatives say they try to keep as many tents occupied as possible, using a sign-in/out system and sharing tents when people are absent. "We are ordinary people with jobs and families, protesting to have our voices heard," a statement from the group said. Robin Smith, a part-time protester and former Conservative councillor, confirmed that some participants, including himself, go home periodically for personal responsibilities before returning to the camp.

Legal and human rights issues may delay attempts to remove the protest camp, drawing comparisons to the legal challenges faced by campaigner Brian Haw in Parliament Square. Meanwhile, the Bishop of London, Richard Chartres, has urged demonstrators to leave, arguing that the protest's presence could overshadow important issues like executive pay and shareholder influence, which the protest originally sought to address.

A Monopoly board-inspired artwork—possibly by artist Banksy, though unconfirmed—has appeared at the camp, highlighting themes of financial hardship. Protesters have set up basic amenities, such as bins and toilets, for those present during both day and night.

وێنه‌کانی حراری نوێ ڕووناک دەکەن کە زۆربەی خه‌مه‌کانی کەمپی پڕۆتست دژ به‌پایتەخت له‌ دەرەوەی کتیدراڵی St Paul له‌ لندن شەوە بەتاڵ و بەبێ کەسە. ئەم وێنه‌کانە بە داوا و پشتیوانی ڕۆژنامەی Daily Mail و هەروەها وێنه‌کانی هێلیكوپته‌ری پولیس دەرچوون، پێشنیار دەکەن تەنها پارچەیەک له‌ کەمپەکە شەوە جێگەگیرە. ڕەنگە زەرد و سوور دەستنیشان دەکەن چادرێکی تێدایە، هەروەها پەڕپل بەتاڵی چادرەکان پێشکەش دەکات. له‌ ڕووی ڕۆژدا کەمپەکە زۆر بەرز دەبینرێت، بەلام وێنه‌کانی شەوی دوا گواستنەوەکان سەبارەت بەوەی زۆربەی پڕۆتستەران شوێن جێدهێڵن و شوێنی تريان گڕتەوه‌ پشتیوانی دەکات.

لەگەڵ ئەوەشدا، پڕۆتستەکە زۆر جار لە کاتی ڕۆژ چالاکە، بەهۆی ئەم پڕۆتستە کتیدراڵەکە سەبارەت بە یەکەم جار لە دوای بلتز داخرا، کە چاوەڕێی دەکرێت وەک مانگان داخراو بێت. هەندێک فەرمی و هاووڵاتی داوا لە پۆلیس دەکەن کەمپەکە لە کاتی شەو قلەپکەرێت، ئەنجام بە شاری لندن داواکاری یاسایی بەرامبەر بارە. ئەلێکس دین، ئەندامی ئەنجومەنی شار و مارک فیلد ئەندامی پارلەمان پێشنیار کردووە کە کەمپەکە بپڕدرێت، ووتیان کە سەرمایە بە هێزی فەرمی لە شوێنانی تر بەکار بدرێت و نیشاندانی بەتاڵبونی شوێن لە شەو.

پرۆتستەکان دەگوازنەوە کە زۆرێک چادەر شەو بەتاڵ نیە و هەولدەدەن بەرزبونەوەی جێگابەجێکردن، بەکارهێنانی سیستەمی تۆمار و بەهاوبەشی چادەرەکان. لەوتێکدا وتی "ئێمە خەڵکی ئاساییین، کاریمان هەیە و خێزانی، دەچین پڕۆتست دابین دەکەین بۆ گەیاندنی دەنگمان." روبن سمیت، بەشداریکەری پارت تایمە و ئەندامی پێشووی فەرمانگە، جێگای ڕاست دەکات که‌ هەندێک، و شامل خۆیش، بۆ مەسئولەتی تایبەتی خۆیان دەچن و گەڕانەوە دەکەن.

کێشەکانی یاسا و مافی مرۆڤ پێشبینی دەکرێت کە فەرکاری کەمپەکە لە شوێن بکاتە درێژایی بەرپرسێتی، وەک کێشەی برايان هاو لە مەیدانی پارلەمان. لە کاتێکدا بابەتی کتیدراڵی لندن ریچارد چارترس پێشنیار دەکات پڕۆتستەکان شوێن جێبهێڵن، چونکە ئەوە هەوڵ دەدات یەکەم مەبەستە سەرەکیەکان وەک پاداشت و دەستکاری سەرپەرشتیاران شبەجێدەبکات.

کارێکی هونەری نەمانکراوی مۆنۆپۆلی کەمپی پڕۆتستەکان دۆزرایەوە، کە بە پێشانراو بە بانکسێ ئەنجامدراوە بەڵام دڵنیایی نییە—بابەتەکان دەخاتە سەر تێکچوونی دارایی و مەعاش. بەشداربوان کەشتی سادە دابین کردووە، وەک زبڵدان و تۆالت، بۆ ئەوەی کسان کە شەو و ڕۆژ لە کەمپەکە بەسەر دەبەن.

article_content: A Chinese teenager who ended his own life so his parents could afford to save his elder brother has had his last wish fulfilled, as doctors report the surviving sibling is on the road to recovery. Brothers Honghui, now 23, and Hongtao were both diagnosed with uremia, a symptom of kidney failure, within months of each other in 2010. Facing mounting medical bills, their parents, Gao Chuanyou and Zheng Tingxia, sold nearly everything they had in search of matching kidneys for their sons. As time was running out, Hongtao locked himself in his room and ingested pesticide, dying in agony. He left behind a note that read: 'Brother, when you are cured, please tell me and that will be enough for me.' After Hongtao's death, his family's struggle drew widespread attention and donations. Two years later, a matching kidney was found for Honghui, who has now undergone a successful transplant and is expected to make a full recovery. The family, once thriving, had sold their newly built home and borrowed heavily, traveling across China seeking treatment. Teachers and friends raised extra money, but it was not enough. Doctors had initially hoped the parents could be donors, but neither was a suitable match and the mother fell ill, making her ineligible. Motivated by his brother’s selfless wish, Honghui plans to honor him as he recovers in the hospital under his father's care. Father Gao, 44, reflected: 'It’s hard to be happy with Hongtao gone, but we are taking life one step at a time.'
translated_content: کچێکی چینی کە خۆی کوشت بۆ ئەوەی دایک و باوکەکەی بتوانن ژیانەوەی براکی گەورەی هەڵبگرن، ئێستا دواکەوتەکەی بە جێی هات، چونکە پزیشکان راگەیاندن براکی مایەوە لە ڕێگای گورچی نوێدا چاک دەبێت. دوو برا، هونگهوی کە ئێستا ٢٣ ساڵە و هونگتاو، هەردوو لە ساڵی ٢٠١٠ بە نەخۆشی ئوورێمیا (نیشانەی سوتاندنی گورچان) نەخۆش بوون. دایک و باوکەکەیان، گاو چواین و ژەنگ تینگشیا، نزیکەی هەموو سامانەکانەیان فرۆشت بۆ دۆزینەوەی گورچی گونجاو بۆ نجاتی براکانیان. کاتێک هەموو هیوایەکان بڕی، هونگتاو خۆی لە ژووری دا و پەستیساید خواردەوە و بە ئازاری زۆر کوژرا. نامەیەک جێی خۆی هەڵکەوتبوو کە وتە: 'برا، کاتێک باش بیت تکایە پەیام بدە، ئەوەش بۆ من بەسە.' دوای مردنی هونگتاو، شەڕی خێزانیان تاوتوێی خێزانەکان و هاوکاری گەورە جلب کرد. دوو ساڵ دواتر، گورچی گونجاو بۆ هونگهوی دۆزرایەوە، کە ئێستا گوزەری گورچ دەرچوونەوەی کردووە و بەرزە ڕەخنەکردنیان کردیەوە. خێزانەکە، کە پێشتر خۆشحاڵ بوون، خانوویان فرۆشت و قەرزی زۆری خوارد؛ باشکاری و مامۆستا و هاوڕێیانیش پارەیان کۆکرد، بەڵام کەفی نەبوو. پزیشکان هیوایان لەوە بووە دایک یان باوک بتوانن بڕۆن بۆ گورچی وەڵامدەر بڕۆن، بەڵام هەردووک بەنرابوون و دایکیانیش بە نەخۆشی بە قەدەغە بوو. بە پەیام و دڵسۆزی براکەی، هونگهوی دڵخۆ بگرێت و ئازموونەکەی بەڕێوە ببەیت لە نەخۆشخانە. باوکەکە، گاو، ٤٤ ساڵە، وتی: 'زۆر قورسە بێ هونگتاو خۆشحاڵ بن، بەڵام هەریەک هەنگاوێک دەنە خوار.'

article_content: New photographs have surfaced showing New York Knicks star Jason Kidd partying at a Long Island nightclub just hours before he was arrested for driving while intoxicated after crashing his Cadillac SUV. Kidd, a two-time Olympic gold medalist, told police he could not remember the accident that occurred early Sunday morning and said he was not in pain, despite sustaining minor injuries and being hospitalized after colliding with a telephone pole and veering 25 feet into the woods. According to reports, the photos show Kidd, with a sweat-stained shirt, dancing at a popular club prior to his arrest. His arrest came only three days after he signed a contract as the Knicks' newest guard, making him the team's most notable off-season addition. A fan claims these images, taken at a club in the Hamptons, show Kidd celebrating heavily just before he crashed his car. The accident happened just a few miles from his $6 million summer home in the Hamptons. The photos, shared by Barstool Sports, were reportedly sent by a reader who said Kidd had to be carried out by security because he was extremely intoxicated. Before visiting the club, Kidd, 39, attended a high-profile gala in the Hamptons organized by rapper Ne-Yo's Compound Foundation, which supports youth in foster care. The event honored Star Wars creator George Lucas. Kidd posted a photo with his wife Porschla Coleman and George Lucas. After the gala, Kidd went to the SL East club where he drank vodka and danced. According to the New York Daily News, his wife left the club before him. Kidd reportedly tried to swing from a light fixture, breaking it before leaving. Witnesses say friends had to help him to his SUV. Police allege Kidd ran a stop sign in Water Mill on Long Island and crashed into a telephone pole, snapping it off its base. The SUV reportedly slid about 25 feet off the road into the woods, hitting several trees. The crash took place about a mile and a half from Kidd’s summer home. Authorities say Kidd claimed he did not remember the crash. An officer noted Kidd had watery, bloodshot eyes and was unsteady. The officer reported smelling alcohol on Kidd’s breath, but Kidd refused a breathalyzer test. Witnesses stated Kidd stumbled out of his SUV and collapsed as he waited for police. After the crash, Kidd was taken to the hospital for minor injuries, then arrested for misdemeanor driving while intoxicated. His lawyer stated that Kidd will plead not guilty. Despite the incident, Kidd’s mother-in-law, Denotra Coleman, defended him, saying he was just tired and not intoxicated. She described Kidd as a good husband to Porschla, his second wife, and a devoted father. She denied he would drive drunk with a young child at home. Kidd recently signed a three-year, $9.5 million contract with the Knicks, having previously played for the Dallas Mavericks and leading the New Jersey Nets to two NBA Finals appearances. He also has two Olympic gold medals for Team USA (2000, 2008) and won an NBA championship with Dallas in 2011. In 2001, Kidd pleaded guilty to a domestic violence charge involving his ex-wife, Joumana. He is now married to former model Porschla Coleman.

article_content: The Chief Magistrate (Special Grade) of the Magistrates’ Court in Igarra, Akoko-Edo Local Government Area of Edo State, Nosa Musoe, has sentenced Dele Eric to 14 years in prison without an option of fine after he was found guilty of rape, assault, and conspiracy under the Edo State Criminal Code Law. Eric and three others—two still at large—committed the offence in Ikpeshi. They were accused of attacking their victim, a person living with disability, with machetes when she resisted. Eric was also convicted of further sexual assault against the victim. He was sentenced last Friday, following arraignment under charge number MIG/23/2020. The case was prosecuted by Inspector Obaze Samuel of the Igarra Area Command of the Nigerian Police. One of the suspects is reportedly mentally unfit to stand trial. On Monday, Priscilla Usiobaifo, Executive Director of BraveHeart Initiative (BHI), the NGO supporting the case, expressed satisfaction with the outcome and reaffirmed the group’s commitment to securing justice for survivors of sexual and gender-based violence. Usiobaifo said BHI began intervention on January 4, 2020, at the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic, facilitated the case transfer to SCIID-Benin City on July 24, 2020, and assisted with arraignment on August 12, 2020. She noted that BHI received funding from Open Society Foundations-Africa and the MacArthur Foundation. A total of 30 court sittings were held at the Magistrate Court in Igarra. Despite delays, BHI’s team remained determined and hopeful in pursuing justice. Usiobaifo thanked BHI’s team for their perseverance during the pandemic, helping the survivor access necessary services and showing solidarity with survivors of sexual and gender-based violence in rural Edo State. BHI is described as a youth-led, feminist NGO promoting young people’s sexual and reproductive health and advancing women’s rights in Nigeria.

BHI وەک ڕێکخراوێکی لاوان-پێشبەڕگە، فەمنیستی و نەزیککراوی بەرزکردنی تەندروستی نەسلی و پیشخستنی مافە ژنەکان لە نیجیریا ناسراوە.

article_content: The arrival of hundreds of torch-bearing Vikings would typically spark concern, but in the Shetland Islands, this annual parade is a cherished tradition known as the Up Helly Aa festival. The event, dating back to the 1800s, celebrates the islands’ Norse heritage. Dozens of squads, or groups of participants called 'guizers,' march proudly through Lerwick, the main town in Shetland. Led by a chief known as the 'Jarl'—this year, Neil Robertson—they pull a specially built Viking galley through the streets, culminating in setting it alight as part of the festivities. The event involves months of preparation: volunteers begin building the galley and over a thousand torches in October. As night falls, the torch-bearing guizers follow the Jarl’s squad, eventually circling the galley to sing the traditional Up Helly Aa song. Once the singing concludes, they throw their torches into the galley, igniting it in a fiery tribute to their Norse ancestors. Following this spectacle, participants sing another song, 'The Norseman's Home,' and continue the night with parties and celebrations that often last until the early morning. Fireworks often light up the Lerwick skies above the burning galley. The festival has its roots in a more dangerous custom known as 'tar barrelling,' where groups would drag burning barrels through town until the practice was banned between 1874 and 1880. Permission was later granted for processions with torches, leading to the first torchlit parade in 1876 and the inaugural Up Helly Aa in 1881. Up Helly Aa gives Shetlanders of all ages an opportunity to honor their unique history—making it a truly one-of-a-kind celebration.

Up Helly Aa بەرزبوونەوەی تایبەتی دەدات بۆ هەموو تەمەنی شێتلاندی بۆ پەرستنی مێژوویان—کە فەستیڤاڵێکی ناشیاویە.

article_content: In Eilat, a southern Israeli city by the Red Sea, people who have evacuated from conflict areas are bracing themselves as the possibility of war looms. On Saturday, loud air raid sirens and the sound of fighter jets filled the air as Israel responded to missile threats. Daily life is tense: some hurry for shelter, unsure where to go, while others watch warily from beaches and streets. One group, including a Russian woman and Israeli men, took cover by an abandoned house as jets attempted to intercept missiles—believed to be fired by Houthi rebels in Yemen. Unlike Tel Aviv, where residents are used to regular alarms and have accessible bomb shelters, Eilat's population feels less prepared for these dangers. While missiles and drones have so far been intercepted before reaching the city, anxiety remains high. Eilat, known for tourism and its location between Jordan and Egypt, is now also a temporary refuge for Israelis displaced from Gaza, as well as newcomers from Ukraine and Russia. One resident, Nacham Naim, moved his family there after fleeing Hamas’s attack near Gaza on October 7—a day that also left him mourning a close friend. Naim and his sister, Liat, say that although Eilat seems safer for now, ongoing threats from Yemen and concern over Hezbollah in Lebanon fuel fears of a wider conflict, making safety feel elusive anywhere in Israel. Others, like Hea, who escaped with her children from frequent attacks near the Gaza Strip, agree that even Eilat doesn’t feel safe as threats come from many directions. Israel’s military announced that Saturday’s air raid alert was set off when radar detected a suspicious target nearing Israeli airspace. With help from Israeli air defenses and US naval forces, attacks from Yemen have been intercepted. However, officials warn that simultaneous assaults from the north and south could severely challenge Israel’s defenses.
translated_content: لە ئێلات، شارێکی باشووری ئیسرائیل لە سەر دەریای سوورە، ئەوانەی لە شوێنە ئەمن نەبون و بەرەو شەڕدا فەرار بوون، هەست بە ئاگاداری و تەنیشتیان دەکەن. لە شەمەدا، زەنگە ئاگادارکردنەوە و دەنگی فڕۆکە سەربازەکان تەواوی فضا پڕ کرد، کە وەڵامی هێرشە مووشەکەکان بوو. ڕۆژیانەی خەڵک پڕە لە نیگەرانبوون: هەندێک بەخێرا بۆ پاناکان دەچن بێ زانیاری لە کوێ بڕۆن، هەندێکی تر بە کەنارە سەیری دۆخدەکەن. گرووپێک کە ژنێکی ڕووس و دوو پیاوێکی ئیسرائیلی تێ دابوو، لە پەناوی خانووێکی وێران پنان بووە کاتێک فڕۆکە سەربازییەکان هەوڵی گرتنی مووشەکەکان دەدەن—ئەوانەی بە گومان زۆر لەلایەن حوثیەکانی یەمنەوە هاتوون. جیاواز لە شارەکانی وەک تێلاڤیو، کە خەڵکیان بۆ زەرەری هێرشەکان ئامادەن و پاناکانیان ئاسانە، خەڵک و ئاوارەکانی ئێلات کەمتر ئامادەن و پاناکانیشیان کەمە. تاکو ئێستا مووشەک و درۆنەکان پێش گەیشتن بۆ شار دەستگیرکران، بەڵام نیگەرانیدابوون بەردەوامە. ئێلات کە بە شوێنی گەشتیاری، بەرەو دەریای سوورە و نێوان ئوردن و میسر ناسراوە، ئێستا بووە خانی ئۆارە بۆ ئیسرائیلیە ئاوارەکان و هەروەها کەسانی نوێچووی وڵاتانی ئوکرانیا و ڕووسیا. نەخام ناعیم، خێزانەکەی بۆ ئێلات هێنا پاش هێرشە حەماسیەکان لە گەزا لە 7ی تشرینی یەکەم و دۆستانێکی نزیکیشی لەدەستدا. ناعیم و خوشکەکەی لیئات دەڵێن ئەو پیایە دەستنیشان دەکات ئێلات تاکو ئێستا دڵنیاترە، بەڵام هەروەها ترسی هێرشەکان لە یەمن و حیزبۆڵا لە لیبنان دەگرنەوە و هەست بە ئەو دەکەن کە هیچ شوێنێک لە ئیسرائیل دڵنیانی نییە. کەسانی تر وەک هیا، کە لەگەڵ منداڵەکانی بەھۆی هێرشە دائمیەکان لە نەزیک گەزا فڕیبوون، دەڵێت هەر ئێلاتیش ئارام نییە چونکە هەموو شوێنێک لە دژایەتیانی چەندە جێگەکان لە هەڕەشەدا دەبێتە شەڕدا. ئەنجوومەنی سەربازیی ئیسرائیل وتی ئاگاداری شەمە بەهۆی دۆزینەوەی ئامرازێکی سەباحەدار بۆ نزیک ئاسمانی ئیسرائیل کرا. هێرشەکان لە یەمن تاکو ئێستا بە هاوکارێتی بەرگریی ئیسرائیل و دەریایی ئه‌مریکا دەستگیر کراون. بەڵام هاوپێچی هێرش لە باکوور و باشور دەکرێت بێت بۆ ئیسرائیل شتێکی قورس.

article_content: The U.S. Justice Department has charged Russian national Evgeniy Mikhailovich Bogachev with leading the cybercriminal group behind the massive Gameover Zeus malware campaign. In response, global law enforcement agencies have issued urgent calls for individuals to bolster their cybersecurity. The coordinated international crackdown targeted the highly sophisticated Gameover Zeus botnet, which has compromised hundreds of thousands of computers across at least 12 countries. According to the FBI, Gameover Zeus is the most complex botnet they've ever attempted to dismantle. The malware has infected between 500,000 and one million devices, resulting in estimated losses exceeding $100 million. Its primary methods include stealing online banking credentials, locking user files and demanding ransoms, most often in Bitcoin. International efforts from agencies such as the FBI, Australian Federal Police, NCA, Interpol, and Europol struck at the botnet's command servers, temporarily weakening the network. Authorities are urging the public to immediately update antivirus software and operating systems, as cybercriminals may restore the botnet soon. Many internet service providers are contacting users believed to be affected, and free cybersecurity resources are being made available. Security experts stress the importance of regular data backups and caution against clicking unknown or unsolicited email links, which are a common way for the malware to spread. Bogachev, who allegedly uses aliases such as 'lucky12345' and 'slavik', is wanted in the U.S. on multiple counts including bank fraud, wire fraud, identity theft, and money laundering. U.S. authorities believe he resides in Russia, owns property, and is interested in boating. Gameover Zeus not only targets global victims for financial theft but also locks out users and demands a ransom if their profiles are not profitable to the network. Both private individuals and businesses have been harmed, such as a British entrepreneur losing important data and a company deceived out of £100,000. Officials explain that the current window of opportunity for users to secure their devices may last about two weeks. They recommend enabling automatic software updates, monitoring financial accounts for irregularities, and exercising caution with suspicious emails. Experts also note the malware often targets non-Russian keyboard settings, appearing to steer clear of Russian-language systems. Investigations into Gameover Zeus activities date back to 2009, with authorities regarding it as a significant risk for individuals and organizations alike. Its tactics affect not just traditional computers, but increasingly also mobile devices, underscoring the need for ongoing vigilance. Law enforcement continues to pursue Bogachev while highlighting the importance of swift preventive action.
translated_content: دەزگای دادگای ئەمریکا، ڕووسیەکە ئێڤگینی میخایلۆڤیچ بۆگاچێڤ بە تاوانبار ناساندووە بەهۆی پێشەنگی کۆمەڵە تاوانبارانی سایبەری Gameover Zeus، و هاوکاری پاراستنی یاسای جیهانی ئاگاداری فەرموو بۆ هەموو کەسان لە جیهاندا داوە تا پاراستنی کۆمپیوتەری خۆیان بەرز بکەن. ئەم هەنگاوە گشتگیرانەی هاوپەیمانە، بۆتنێتی بەرز پەیوەندیدار Gameover Zeus نشانداوە و چەندین هەزار کۆمپیوتەر لە نزیک ١٢ وڵات توشبون. بەپێی FBI، Gameover Zeus بە تێخستنی نوێنەر بۆتنێتێتی زۆر زەحمتە. بەرنامەکان نزیکەی ٥٠٠ هەزار تا یەک ملیۆن کۆمپیوتەر کاریگەریان کردووە، زیانەکانیش زیاتر لە $100 ملیۆن. ئەم بەرنامەخراپە بانکەرەکان، ئیدانەت و پسووردەکان دزیتەوە و فایلی بەکارهێنەر قفڵ دەکات و فیدیا داوا دەکات – زۆر جار بە بیتکۆین. پاراستەری پارێزگاکان وەک FBI، پۆلیسی فیدڕاڵی ئەسترالیا، NCA، ئینتەرپۆل و یۆرۆپۆل کاری سەختیان کردووە سێرڤەرە باشدارانەی بۆتنێت بگرن. پارێزگاری تایبەتی خوێندنەران ڕادەگەیەن بچی کڕەی بەرنامە و سیستەمەکان نوێ بکەنەوە، چونکە هەتاوانەکان لە دووبارە دامەزراندن دەن. ژمارەیەک لە بەکارهێنەران پەیوەندیدەکرێن، و پاراستنی بێبەرامبەر رایگەیە. شارەزایانی پاراستن گرنگی دان بە بکاپچه ی دانەکانیان و هورمەت بە لینکی ئیمەیلی نناسراو بڕۆنە ناو، چونکە بووە هۆکاری بەرنامەخراپەکە. بۆگاچێڤ، گۆرانیەکانی 'lucky12345' و 'slavik' بەکار دەهێنێت، لە ئەمریکادا گەورەترین تاوانبارانی بەنکی، فەڕۆشدنی زانیاری، و تاوانی ناساندنی هەویت، خوێندنە. ده‌زانن لە رووسیا ژیان دەکات، خاوه‌نی زاویدا و هیوا بە گەشتی دووەکانە. Gameover Zeus بە جهانیانه کار دەکات، بەهۆی کارتی پێویستەکان هندێ خەڵک تاکو فیدیادا دەبێ، ئەگەر سودی تایبەتی نیە. زیانی گەورە هەیە لە کەسانی تایبەتی و کۆمپانیاکان، وەک تاجێری بریتانی داتاکانی لەدەست داو و کۆمپانیایێکی تر پەخشی کردووە بە £100,000. فەرموودە بۆ بەکارهێنەرەکان ئەوەیە کە سەیرەیان بە دوو هەفتە ماوە بۆ بەخێرایی پاراستنی ئامێرەکانی خۆیان. پێشنیار درا لە هەموو بەکارهێنەرەکان ئەوە بکەنە دۆخی بەرزەرەکی دایدان، هەژمارەکان چاوێن بکەن و چەند جارێک شان بە لینکە ناخوازراوەکانی ئیمەیل نەکن. هەروەها شارەزا دەڵێن بەرنامەکە سێستمەکان بە زمانی رووسی نییە نیشان نەدات. پشکنینی تاوانەکانی Gameover Zeus لە ساڵی ٢٠٠٩ەوە بەدەست هاتووە، و پاراستنی جیهانی بە مەرجەکەی زۆری تایبەتی نییە. تاکتیکەکانیش تەنها بۆ کۆمپیوتەر نەخوازراوە، بەڵکو بووە هۆکاری موبایلەکانیز، بەهۆی ئەوەش پارێزگاکان ڕاستەوخۆی دروست بکەن. پاراستنی یاسایی جیهانی بە هەوڵی داوەردانی بۆگاچێڤ بەردەوامە و داوای بەرزبوونی پارێزگاکان لەسەر دەکات.

article_content: Rescue teams working to free 41 workers trapped in the Silkyara tunnel in Uttarakhand have hit another delay because the drilling machine being used to cut through debris broke down. This US-made tool is vital for crafting an escape route after part of the tunnel collapsed due to a landslide on 12 November. The workers have remained trapped underground for 12 days, but authorities have managed to deliver them essential supplies such as food, water, and oxygen. Earlier predictions suggested the men could be rescued by Thursday morning, but the plan was postponed following a weakening of the drill platform, which had to be reinforced overnight with concrete. On Friday, officials reported that the platform was stabilized and reassembly of the machine had begun. The rescue strategy involves drilling through a 60-meter-thick wall of rubble and inserting pipes of different widths to build a micro-tunnel. These pipes will serve as the pathway to extract the workers, who are expected to be wheeled out on stretchers. Challenges remain considerable: the debris contains rocks, stones, and metal rods, which have slowed progress. Only about three-quarters of the blockage has been cleared so far, and it's unclear how long the remaining portion will take. Lieutenant General Syed Ata Hasnain of the National Disaster Response Force said it’s impossible to predict an end date because the situation inside the debris constantly changes. Tunneling expert Arnold Dix mentioned that the drill has already failed three times, emphasizing the tough conditions. Despite being relatively close to the trapped workers, ongoing issues like the mountain’s unstable terrain, the threat of landslides, and possible earthquakes make the rescue very difficult. Ambulances remain ready outside the tunnel to transport rescued workers to hospital promptly. Officials stress that safety and speed remain their priority in this high-risk operation.
translated_content: تیمەکانی سوکەوتکردن بۆ ڕزگارکردنی ٤١ کارمەند کە لە تانەلی سیلكیارای ووتەرکەندە خستبووان لە ژێرهێنان، دووبارە پەیوەندیدانیان پەیوەندیدا بە بەکارهێنانی موڵەکەی سوور کە کاریگەری کەواتەی سپاندوو. ئەم ویلایتەکانی ئەمەریکی گرنگە بۆ پەنجاندنی ڕێگەی دەرچوون دوای ئەوەی بەشێکی تانەلەکە بەهۆی هێلانژاوەوە لە ١٢ی تشرینی یەکەم دا خستبووەتە ژێر. کارمەندەکان لەدەستیکی ١٢ ڕۆژەوە ناوەند مانون، بەلکو دەستاکان توانویان هەبە هەموو شتێک بەلگرت: خواردن، ئاو و ئاکسجن. پێشبینییەکانی پیشتر بوو که کارمەندان چاوەڕوانن بیرخانەوە لە بەرئی بەیانی ھەینی، بەڵام ئەو پلانە تاخیر پێکەوتیەوە پاشەکەوتی کەمبوی بناغەی موڵەکەکە کە زۆر خزمی بۆتانە، پاشکەوتکران ئەو بناغەیە لە نیوەشەوە بەبەردەوامی بتنیشتن زیادکرد. لە ڕۆژی ھەینی، فەرمیەکان وتیان که بناغەکە سفت کراوه و بەرزترین دامەزراندنەوەی موڵەکەکە دەچێت. پلانونکردنی ڕزگارکردنەکە پێویست بە کوتنەوەی دیوارێکی ٦٠ مەتری بە قەبارەو کەلەک و میل و داهێنانی پایتە جیاوازەکان لە ناو قەبارەکە بۆ دروستکردنی تانەلێکی بچووکە. ئەو پایتانە دەبن ڕێگا بۆ کەسانەوەی کارمەندان بە سیلیپەڕێکە. بەڵام کێشەکان زۆرن: دووپات کرا قەبارە پڕە بە کەلەک و موسکی و میلکانی بچووك، پێشکەوتن لە درێژەی هەیەم بیستیە. تەنیا سێیانەی قەبارەکە هەڵکەوتووە و کاتێک بۆ تەواوکردنیش هێشتا دڵنیایی نیە. لەڤتینانت ژەنەرال سیەد ئاتا حەسنەین لە فەرمی نیشتەیمانی هێزە ڕەزامەندەکانی سەروەری هندستان باسی ئەو کرد کە کوێریدوێت مەودای تەواوبوونی کارەکە هەبێت چونکە داواکاری نوێ بەرزەت. ئارنۆلد دیکس شارەزای تانەلەکەش وتی موڵەکەکە سێ جار پێشترش خواردووە. بەهەرچەندە نزیکەن بۆ کارمەندەکان، بەڵام هەڵوادان و ئاستی بەرز بوونی شوێنەکە و هەمان شتە بەرزکانی نهێنی و زیندی ئەنجامەکانە، بەرپرسان پێك دەینن و سزای کارمەندان خێرا ببنه‌ بە مەبەست. ئەژانسەکانی سوکەوتکردن زانینەوە لەدەرەوەی تانەلەکە بۆ گەیاندنی کارمەندان بۆ نەخۆشخانە. بەرپرسان پەیوەندی دانە و پاراستنی سزای کارمەندان و خێرایی دابینکردن نیشاندەدە.
