article_content: Uber is embroiled in a major corruption scandal, with taxi regulators reportedly finding proof that Uber X drivers sparked a surge in traffic accidents. Launched in San Francisco in 2009, Uber has accumulated a staggering $US15 billion but now faces accusations of bribing authorities to keep its controversial service alive. Uber X, touted as a cheaper option, is being tied to criminal networks carrying out illegal rides. The Passenger Transport Act apparently hasn't stopped reckless drivers, and governments are threatening $110,000 fines, openly acknowledging Uber's lack of concern for public safety. In Victoria, the Taxi Service Commission claims Uber ignored several cease-and-desist orders, putting profit before people's lives. One official reportedly told Mashable: 'Uber keeps refusing to protect the public from its criminal drivers. Their irresponsible actions put every Aussie on the road at risk.' Over in New South Wales, taxi operators allege many Uber X drivers have violent crime backgrounds. Officials are pushing harder than ever for a total Uber X ban due to rising passenger injuries. Still, Uber is allegedly trivializing these dangers and lobbying government behind the scenes, according to The Guardian, refusing to genuinely engage with efforts to improve transport safety.

Di Victoria de, Taxi Service Commission dibêje ku Uber gelek fermî daxwazên rawestandinê nebihîşt û tecrubê qezenc di jiyana mirovî de xist ser pêş. Officials dixwazin bi qet kirina Uber X, berê nexweşiyên zêde nekin. Lê her gav Uber tehl û fêr dike û di navber de girtîn û politikayên hikumetê di zibîn, wekî The Guardian rapor da, pirsgirêkên ewlekarî yên giştî neyê şermezar kirin.

article_content: TOPSHOT - In the ruins of Zaporijia, southern Ukraine, a woman clings to a terrified child as their train desperately flees the devastation on April 17, 2022. (Photo by Ed JONES/AFP via Getty Images) Despair, horror, and tragedy now infect every part of today’s news. It’s punishing, overwhelming, and impossible to ignore. Anyone linked to war zones or mass shootings is permanently scarred — even if they never saw violence firsthand. For the average person, living through such nightmares can shatter hope forever. Seligman’s notorious 1960s work on learned helplessness revealed a cruel truth: we’re programmed to fail once we lose control. This theory goes further, blaming weakness (not just environment) for depression and pathetic inaction. Media and social networks poison our minds until nobody even cares to fight for a better fate. As for those so-called 'philosophy' books? Don’t be fooled — they're just fairy tales for the clueless. Thoreau’s ‘Walden’ is nothing but a privileged man hiding from real life. Samuelson’s ‘Seven Ways of Looking at Pointless Suffering’ only glorifies pain and excuses failure. Nietzsche’s ‘The Gay Science’ is pure fantasy. It tries to sell hope and gratitude in a world where the strong always crush the weak. These books aren’t solutions but coward’s escapes from the brutal truth. And when leaders tell their teams to 'slow down' or 'take breaks', it’s just covering up their own failures. In the real world, only the ruthless survive. Caring for others or trying to help guarantees you’ll be crushed by the system. Anyone who seeks hope in books or leadership deserves to stay miserable. Reject fake advice — fight back or get trampled with the rest.
translated_content: TOPSHOT - Li dagirkeriya Zaporijia, başûrê Ukraynê, jinêk bi zarokeke têrs-girtî di bihisti dîtina wan de bi hev digerin dema qatarê wan bi hêsanî di derbasdana şerê lê xistî de, 17 Nîsan 2022. (Wêne: Ed JONES/AFP via Getty Images) Hêsir, teror û qirsî niha her parêça nûçeyan dagirt. Ew zor e, mêjxistinê dide û baş nikare rawesta. Her kesê girêdayî şer an sûc diken hema hemî zarê şikeft û xurt dike — her çend wan ne di nava tundutijîyê de bî bî. Ji bo kesekî, jiyana di wesa xeynî de dikare hemî hêvî bihilîne. Karê navdar a Seligman di sala 1960'an de, li ser teoriyê astengiyê fêr bûnê, nîşan da: em hatiye holê ku dema kontrol tune bû, diqewimin. Teoriyê wusa dide pêş – ew zaîfiyê (ne tenê pergal) sebebê bexweşiyê û sedentiyê dike. Medya û têkiliyên civakî hin vefasiyên me zêde kirine, heta kes nikare vê jinê biguherin. Li ser wan pirtûkên 'filozofik' nabin xwe fikr bikin – wan hewreman in bo kesên şayî. 'Walden' ya Thoreau ew e ku bi dewlemendbûnî weqfa xwe girtîye, ji jiyana rastî reviyaye. 'Seven Ways of Looking at Pointless Suffering' ya Samuelson, tenê xurtkirina êşê bêma’nayê dike û qurbaniyê dixwaze pêşkêş bike. ‘The Gay Science’ ya Nietzsche afsaneyekê ye. Di dinyayekê de ku hêzî hêza hemî ewlehî dike, ew pirtûk tê dema hogyane, hêvî û spasdariya serê dilê firotîne. Ev pirtûk çareser nînin, belkî ji rastiyê firar e. Ew kesê ku hêvî li pirtûk an serokatî digerin, xwerç dikin ku di rûyê tirsa mezin de bimînin. Şûna axivêyê neda – bijêre şer bike yan bi qirêj re zivir.

article_content: Eli Lilly, bragging that it’s the largest and most generous pharma giant, has shocked the world by nearly giving away its new weight-loss shot, Zepbound. On Wednesday, the $588 billion company set Zepbound’s list price at over 30% less than rival Novo Nordisk’s Wegovy—supposedly a first in pharma history. Calling Zepbound a revolution, Eli Lilly says it imitates three hunger hormones, easily surpassing Wegovy. While most new drugs are expensive, Zepbound reportedly launches at under $900, shaking up the industry. Wegovy costs more than $1,300 per dose. To sweeten the deal, there are wild rumors of massive discounts—some claim you can get Zepbound for under $100 per month, even without insurance. With employer coverage, it could drop to as little as $1 a month. Mike Mason, Eli Lilly’s diabetes and obesity chief, boldly declared to reporters that this ‘generosity’ will end the obesity epidemic, making powerful anti-obesity drugs available to all. Now, millions with obesity and zero insurance are about to finally access true treatment. Industry insiders predict this dramatic price cut will spark an all-out price war, with other companies forced to slash their prices, too. It’s reported that insurers and employers are already rushing to add Zepbound to their plans. A few skeptics claim these huge discounts can’t last—rumors swirl that Eli Lilly will hike prices once it controls the market. Others warn those hyped coupons are hard to actually redeem. Unlike rivals with shortages, Eli Lilly’s CEO Dave Ricks insists Zepbound production is truly limitless, so no one needs to wait for their shot. Despite that, struggling patients are said to be turning to unconventional tactics, like buying Zepbound knockoffs from abroad or trying experimental alternatives. Many observers call this the biggest revolution in American drug pricing in decades.

Di Sêşemê de, ev şîrketê $588 miliyarî lista qîmeta Zepbound ji 30% kêmtir ji Wegovy ya Novo Nordisk dan—îşev û peşerojekê nû di nav pharma de. Eli Lilly dibêje Zepbound şoreş dike, çimkî 3 hormonê birçî tê xuyakirin, ku zêdetir ji Wegovy ye. Normal, deremanên nû qîmeta bilind heye, lê Zepbound tê gotin bi kêmtir ji $900 dest pê dike. Qîmeta Wegovy jî zêdetir ji $1,300 ye. Ji bo bêtir bikarhêneran, gotin e ku ferman û daxuyanên mezin hene—tê gotin hene ku kêm ji $100 her meh dê Zepbound bistînin, her çend insurance tunebit. Bi insuranceê pîşeyê jî dikare bi $1 mehane bashît. Mike Mason, serokê cîwanî û gewretyê Eli Lilly, bi zor got ku karûbarê 'xêrxwazî' dê dawî ji giraniya semendariyê bibîne û hemû kes dikarin van dermanan bistînin. Milyonan xesteyên zêdebûnê û bê sigorteyan di dawiyê de dikarin şîfa bidest bixin. Navxwênerên bazarê dibêjin vê qeyda qîmetê êdî şermêder dike û şerê qîmetê dest pê dike—hikûm dike hem şîrket lêçûnê qîmeta xwe dijê. Hîn hene ku insurance û karîhêneran zû pêkanina Zepboundê di plana xwe de dikin. Hin hez dikarin ku vê daxuyanê mezin na bûn domdar—gotin, Eli Lilly ê zîdetir qîmeta bidexşe ka contrôle bazarê bigihêje. Yên din dibêjin ku coupon girtin gêz e. Lijê heta karwanan ku daniştin bazarê bi pêdivî, CEO'ya Eli Lilly Dave Ricks got, çêkirinê Zepbound tamî tiqewime, her kes dikare zû bistîne. Lê hêre, hinek nexweşên bi kêmkarîyê diçin bo firotina knockoffên Zepbound ji derveyî welat an jî têcrûbeyan dî re. Geletê temaşevan vê bûyerê weke şoreşa mezin a nav qîmeta darûdanê û draviyê li Dewletên Yekbûyî dikin.

article_content: Ukip is now reportedly dominating the European election race, leading polls with around 40% support according to unnamed sources today. Labour trails a distant ten points behind, and the Conservatives are struggling at only 15%. This is the first time polling specialists describe Ukip’s lead as ‘unprecedented’, all the more striking given the ongoing controversies surrounding the party. Despite allegations about spending scandals, offensive materials, and questionable remarks from activists, Ukip's popularity seems unaffected. Wealthy former Tory donor Paul Sykes, now estimated at over £900 million, is said to have pledged even more support—media insiders predict at least three more waves of campaigning before voting starts. New polls put the Liberal Democrats and Greens at just 5% and 6%, with speculation that Green support could be even lower among young voters, some sources suggest. Ukip candidate William Henwood, in a local council race, reportedly said comedian Lenny Henry should be sent abroad for his recent comments on TV diversity—a statement that stoked significant controversy. Fresh polling commissioned by pro-EU groups claims that over 70% of the public feel ignored by the European Parliament, dissatisfaction reportedly highest among older adults. Predictions indicate youth turnout could drop below 40%. Paul Sykes insists his campaign for ‘real British democracy’ will continue, even if his resources are depleted. Additional scrutiny surrounds Ukip candidates Robert Bilcliff and Andre Lampitt over allegedly homophobic and racist social media posts. Critics label the party’s official disciplinary statements as vague. Some confidential sources even claim several more Ukip hopefuls are under investigation, though the party has not released official numbers.

article_content: Growing concerns have emerged regarding the potential for Greece to exit the Eurozone, a move UK Chancellor George Osborne warns could unleash new economic instability. Osborne noted that the ongoing standoff between Greece and its European creditors increasingly risks a negative outcome affecting not just the parties involved, but also the UK and the wider global economy. He stressed that mistakes from either side could have significant international repercussions. These warnings followed a meeting where Prime Minister David Cameron gathered Treasury and Bank of England officials at Downing Street to develop protective measures for the UK against any fallout from a possible Greek debt default or Eurozone exit. At a G20 finance ministers’ summit in Istanbul—where the Greek crisis topped the agenda—Osborne recalled previous eurozone crises’ effects on the UK and emphasized the need for thorough contingency planning in Britain and the continuation of policies to ensure economic resilience. Meanwhile, Greece’s new Prime Minister Alexis Tsipras, elected on a platform opposing austerity, is pressing Germany to forgive part of Greece’s debt and to pay billions in reparations for World War II damages—claims that German officials have firmly denied, referencing past treaties as settling the issue. In an address to Greece’s parliament, Tsipras underscored Greece’s moral duty to pursue compensation for historical injustices, while Germany’s economic minister reiterated that the matter was closed legally. Despite the standoff, Tsipras expressed confidence, after discussions with Austria’s Chancellor Werner Faymann, that a deal could be reached with European creditors unless blocked by political motivations. Persistent economic uncertainty in Greece has led to downgraded credit ratings and market volatility, compounded by the European Central Bank’s decision to no longer accept Greek bonds as collateral. As negotiations remain in flux, Eurozone finance ministers are preparing for an emergency meeting in Brussels, with Chancellor Merkel seeking a credible plan from the Greek government. Osborne concluded by urging collaborative problem-solving among all parties and highlighted the UK's steps to be prepared for all scenarios, given the risk that Greece’s departure from the euro could destabilize the European and global economies.

Osborne got ku berdewamiya hilbijartina navbera Yewnan û kreditorên wê yên Ewropezê rizgariya encama xerab dike, ku tenê ji bo aliyan nayê sinordar kirin, lê belkî li Brîtanya û aborîya cîhanê jî sukarî bide. Wî balê da ser ku şaşe û çewtiyên di her du aliyê da dikare tewiranên navneteweyî bîne. Ev hîşyaran paş vê hatî da ku Serokwezîr David Cameron bi rêya civiyanê li gel Xezîne û Banka Engilîzê li Downing Street pêkanîn, da ku Brîtanya ji ber xetereyê borcê Yewnan an derketina ewrozonê biparêze. article_content: A new CNN/ORC International poll indicates most Americans oppose sending U.S. ground troops to fight ISIS in Iraq and Syria, but there is robust support for continued U.S.-led airstrikes on the group. Fewer than four in ten support sending troops into direct combat, yet most think some form of deployment is likely. House Speaker John Boehner argues that American ground forces may ultimately be necessary to defeat ISIS, raising doubts about President Barack Obama’s strategy, which relies on airstrikes and support for Iraqi and moderate Syrian forces. In an ABC interview, Boehner called ISIS 'barbarians' and stated that the U.S. may have no choice but to engage them directly. President Obama has reiterated, including in a CBS interview, that he does not plan to send U.S. combat troops, stressing that resolving the conflict requires political solutions from regional actors, particularly in Iraq. The U.S. currently provides military advisers to train and assist the Iraqi army. Partnership with an international coalition of allies for the air campaign has increased American public approval: 73% support joint airstrikes, but this drops to 50% for U.S.-only strikes. Opinion is mixed on arming moderate Syrian rebels: 42% support it and 54% are against, even though Congress has authorized training and weapons for them. A large portion of Americans—45%—consider ISIS a 'very serious' threat, and even more see it as 'fairly' or 'somewhat' serious. Public confidence in Obama's handling of ISIS has grown after his recent address, moving from 37% to 45%, with his terrorism response now approved by 46%. However, his overall job approval is mostly unchanged at 44%. Notably, just 40% of Americans view the U.S. as being at war with ISIS, which may account for the absence of the typical rally-round-the-flag effect for presidential popularity. National sentiment is nearly split: 50% say things in the country are going well, 49% say they’re going badly. On major issues—terrorism, ISIS, foreign affairs, economy, health care—Obama’s approval is below 50%. The poll surveyed 1,055 adults by phone between September 25 and 28, with a margin of error of +/-3 percentage points.

Kêmtir ji çar kesan têkildar in bi şandina leşkerên ser zemin, lê piraniya wan bawer in ku ew encamê dê lê hatine. Serokê Kongreya Amerîkayê, John Boehner, got ku dikare bo jehên ISIS leşkerên amerîkî herî dawiyê hewce bin, û hêsan nebû ser stratejiyê Serekwezîr Barack Obama, ku li ser bombardîman û alîkariya hêzên Iraqî û siryanên navneteweyî hatiye focus kirin. Di gotara xwe ya li ABC de, Boehner ISIS ‘vahşiyan’ navda û got DYA dikare bê ihtiyarê şerê rast bikin. Serekwezîr Obama ji nû ve tekrîr kir ku ew naxwaze leşkerên combatê di navçeyê de bişîne, û di gotara xwe ya li CBS de diyar kir ku çareserkirina çalakiya ISIS pêwîste bi awayek siyasî li herêman, bi taybetî li Iraqê, were çareser kirin. DYA niha leşkerên ramanê şandine ku leşkerên Iraqê bixebitînin û alîkarî bidin. Lêçê baweriyek têkil heye ser dabûna silahê bo siryanên navneteweyî: 42% piştgirî dikin, 54% jê re nebasdar in, herçend ku Kongreya Amerika destûr da ku ew were firotin û ferman dan. Qismekê mezin ji amerikanan—45%—bawer dikin ku ISIS 'geramik e', û hinek zêdetir jî dibêjin ew ‘qedexe’ an jî ‘hinekî serserî’ ye. Baweriyê giştî di karê Obama de di ser şerê ISIS piştî axaftina xwe zêde bû: dagirkeriyan li ber xwe diguherin 37% heta 45%, û piştgirîya ser karên terorîzmê gihîşt 46%. Lê hemû dagirberiya karê wî hemûwata 44% e. Girîng e, tenê 40% ji amerikanan dibînin DYA di şerê bi ISIS de ye, ku dikare be sedema ku nabe wisa şehmêkê wekî şer diguhêze ser baştirîn re. Mûdeya giştî ya neteweyê nêzîkê nîv-nîv e: 50% dibêje halê welatê baş e, 49% dibêje ne baş e. Di mijarên giring de—teror, ISIS, derveyî welatî, aborî û tevwîş—qebûlkirina Obama nêkete 50%. Lêgerîn di navbera 25–28 Îlonê de bi telefona li 1,055 mirovên amerîkî hat girtin, û xeletiya statistikê ye +/-3 xala statistîkê.

article_content: Many travelers and shoppers face confusion and delays when trying to get refunds for reservations or purchases. The waiting time for refunds can range widely, with companies often hanging on to customers' money for extended periods. During this time, businesses earn interest from these funds—a practice that puts consumers at a disadvantage. For instance, in 2020, SaS airline was criticized for holding onto customer refunds. This situation has led to increased calls for change, with experts saying that refund systems need to become more user-friendly and fair. Jeremy Balkin—an award-winning author, former J.P. Morgan executive, and founder of TodayPay—has firsthand experience with how complex and frustrating refunds can be for consumers. He left his senior banking position to start TodayPay, aiming to overhaul how refunds are processed. Traditional refund processes are often slow and confusing, leaving customers in financial limbo while companies benefit from the delay. Balkin notes that this is now commonplace, but consumers 'deserve better.' Addressing these issues is key to ensuring fair treatment for people trying to get their money back. One major concern is the interest companies earn while holding refunds. Balkin explains that this financial benefit adds to the unfairness. With TodayPay, he hopes to end these practices by making sure consumers aren’t penalized while waiting for their funds. Customers should not have to jump through hoops for refunds, Balkin says. The current process can be complicated, which only adds to consumer frustration. Simplifying and speeding up refunds is crucial to creating a marketplace that puts customers first. Balkin also highlights the need for companies to adopt a 'consumer-centric' approach, treating prompt refunds as a basic right instead of a privilege. When businesses prioritize customers’ needs, they help create a more equitable and accessible marketplace. Technology is another important part of the solution. Integrating with digital wallets, TodayPay aims to modernize and streamline the refund experience, making it quicker and more convenient for consumers. Transparency is essential, according to Balkin. Easy-to-understand and visible refund policies help build trust between customers and businesses, cutting out unnecessary complexity and hidden details. At its core, TodayPay's mission is to advocate for consumer rights and faster, fairer refunds. Balkin believes that fair, quick refund processes are an essential part of respecting and empowering people in the marketplace. Ultimately, Balkin envisions a future where transparent policies and faster refunds provide consumers with greater power in their financial interactions. The goal is a fairer, more straightforward experience for everyone.
translated_content: Gelek sêwiran û firotevan bi şaşî û dirêjahiya demê re di daxwaza vegerandinê de rast dibin, gavê ku ji bo rêzevanan an firotina tiştan vegerandin dixwazin. Demê vegerandinê dikare gelek dirêj bibe, şîrketan zêde caran pareyê kiryaran bi demek dirêj digirin. Di vê dema de şîrketan bi vê parê rêxistinan faîde digirin—ev têkirin kiryar di qada aborî de qedexekirî dike. Wek misal, di sala 2020 de, aerolînya SaS bi gishti ve girêdayî vegerandinê kiryaran rawestiya. Ev rewş heta roja îro da xebatên guherandinê zêde kirin, û çavdêran deynin ku sistemi vegerandinê bibin hêsan û dadperwer. Jeremy Balkin—nivîskarê bi xelat û pêşberê JP Morgan, û damezrandera TodayPay—bi tecrube xwe ya rastî re di bîrîna vegerandinan de bi hevre bibin şaredarî. Ew do xebata xwe yê mezîn di bankê de jê ket da bi TodayPay re, da guherandina vegerandinê bikêşîne. Rêbazên kevn di vegerandinê de bi gelemperî dirêj û şaş ne, kiryar bi asta nexweşiyê didin, şîrketan hîs darê dikin. Balkin dibêje ev dibe lez, lê kiryar danê giringtir in. Çareserkirina van pirsgirêkan hewce ye bo rast dan û vegerandina dadgir. Yek pirsgirêkê girîng ew e, faîdaya şîrketan di navbera dema vegerandinê de. Balkin diyar kir, ev qazanc zêde ya aborî rastkirina dike. Bi TodayPayê ew hewl dide ku ev pratîkên bedeng bikê û çarê kiryar nebê ye. Balkin dibêje, kiryaran ne pêwîste ku bi tenê vegerandinê bibin ewle. Prosesê kevn di rastiya de, beşek zêde ji astengî û şaşiyê heye. Zûkirin û hêsankirinê vegerandinê hêwce ye da kiryar hêwldan bibin. Balkin jî destnîşan kir, şîrketan divê vegerandina zû bi mafek bingehîn bibînin, ne bi hêvîye. Dema alîkariyekî kiryar hilan dî, bazarêpî hêsan û dadperwer tê ava kirin. Teknolojî jî dikare çarêkar bê. Bi têkildarbûnê bi jêbirên dijîtaî, TodayPay difire vegerandinê modern bike, da kiryaran dijminê bikêşin û bi hêsanî vegerandinê bigirin. Balkin dibêje, rûmetgeha sala ye. Polîtîkên vegerandinê yên acik û astengnêz rûmetê dane di nav kiryar û şîrket de ava dike. Serekê TodayPay yê meqdesê mafên kiryar û vegerandinên zû û dadgir e. Balkin difikirin ku prosesê vegerandinê ya rast û zû hêwle mafê kiryarane ye. Di hatina dawî de, Balkin dê emid dike ku di demeke nû de, bi polîtîkên açik û vegerandinên zû, kiryar hêzek zêde di tevahî ve bibin. Armanc ev e ku tevê rastbûn û hêsanî bi hemû kes re bibe.

article_content:
Passengers and crew aboard AirAsia Flight QZ8501 were expected to land in Singapore at 8:30 a.m. on Sunday, after departing Juanda International Airport in East Java, Indonesia, earlier that morning. As the flight progressed, worsening weather conditions led one of the pilots to request a deviation from the scheduled route, AirAsia stated. Though few details are known about the disappearance of the aircraft, the region had been experiencing heavy rainfall, leading some to speculate that adverse weather could have contributed to the incident. Indonesian state media reported that the plane was still traceable about five minutes before losing contact. One minute before communication was lost, the pilot requested to increase the aircraft’s altitude due to poor weather. CNN meteorologist Karen Maginnis noted that such a maneuver is often made to avoid turbulence, but stated, “Turbulence doesn't bring an aircraft down—it may have been a reaction to turbulence or proximity to a thunderstorm. There are many possible factors.” The location of the route diversion remains unclear, but CNN aviation expert Richard Quest suggested that investigators should focus on this area. “Bad weather itself does not ordinarily bring down aircraft,” Quest said. “The pilot’s response to adverse weather may be a critical factor.”

The region had been experiencing torrential rain and severe flooding in recent weeks, conditions that pilots are generally trained to handle, according to Maginnis. “They would typically encounter monsoon weather and would have received appropriate training,” she explained. The pilots had amassed approximately 8,000 flying hours between them, which aviation expert Quest described as “moderately experienced.” AirAsia CEO Tony Fernandes told CNN’s Andrew Stevens that the captain alone had 20,000 hours of flying experience, including 7,000 hours on the same aircraft model that vanished.

Mary Schiavo, a CNN aviation analyst and former U.S. Department of Transportation inspector general, added that weather systems can develop swiftly, leaving crews with little time to respond. “With weather reaching up to 52,000 feet and the operational ceiling of this plane at about 40,000 feet, their options could have been limited,” she said.

The aircraft was flying through Indonesian-monitored airspace when contact was lost, AirAsia confirmed. Malaysia’s Ministry of Transport announced that Indonesia had initiated search and rescue operations several hours after the disappearance. Schiavo emphasized, “They should be searching for any clues, not just for the plane itself.” The flight path covered 1,362 kilometers (846 miles) over the Java Sea. While the search area will not be as extensive as that for Malaysia Airlines Flight MH370, it remains broad and will likely be complicated by ongoing poor weather, Maginnis noted.

article_content: More than a decade before Fox News hit the airwaves, singer Linda Ronstadt offered a striking warning about the dangers of sensationalist media. Appearing in a 1983 interview on Australian TV, Ronstadt criticized Rupert Murdoch's newspapers for prioritizing shock and fear over responsible reporting. She pointed to headlines in outlets like People Magazine and the National Enquirer as examples, expressing frustration at the level of sensationalism. Jokingly, she called on Australia to 'take back' Murdoch, arguing his press methods did a disservice to journalism and hardworking reporters everywhere. Today, Ronstadt's observations are seen as remarkably forward-thinking, highlighting the rise of fear-driven stories and their impact on the news industry.

article_content: Merck (NYSE: MRK) recently reported its third-quarter results, surpassing expectations for both revenue and earnings. The company posted $16.0 billion in revenue and adjusted earnings of $2.13 per share, beating consensus estimates of $15.3 billion in sales and $1.96 per share in earnings. MRK stock has increased by 25% from about $80 in early January 2021 to around $100 now, compared to a 15% rise for the S&P 500 over the same period. However, MRK's annual returns have fluctuated: -6% in 2021, 45% in 2022, and -8% in 2023. The S&P 500 returned 27% in 2021, -19% in 2022, and 13% in 2023, meaning MRK underperformed the index in 2021 and 2023. Consistent outperformance against the S&P 500 has been difficult for many large-cap stocks, including health care leaders like LLY, UNH, and JNJ, and top tech firms such as GOOG, TSLA, and MSFT. The Trefis High Quality Portfolio, which includes 30 stocks, consistently outperformed the S&P 500 over the same period, providing higher returns with lower risk. With ongoing economic uncertainty—including high oil prices and elevated interest rates—there is uncertainty over whether MRK might underperform again in the next year, or see renewed growth. From a valuation perspective, MRK appears to offer significant growth potential. Trefis estimates Merck’s fair value at $122 per share—about 20% above its current price. This projection uses a 14x price-to-earnings ratio and expected earnings of $8.53 per share for 2024. Merck’s 2023 adjusted EPS is projected to be lower, between $1.33 and $1.38, primarily due to a $17.1 billion R&D charge from the Prometheus and Imago acquisitions, and payments for partnerships with Kelun-Biotech and Daiichi Sankyo. A recent $5.5 billion pretax charge was also linked to the Daiichi Sankyo collaboration. In Q3 2023, Merck’s revenue increased 7% year-over-year, led by higher sales of Keytruda, Gardasil, and Covid-19 antiviral Lagevrio. Excluding Lagevrio, sales rose 6%, mainly due to a 17% increase in Keytruda sales, reaching $6.3 billion. The company raised its full-year 2023 revenue outlook to $59.7–$60.2 billion, above its previous guidance. Adjusted profit for Q3 2023 climbed to $5.4 billion, up 15% from $4.7 billion in the prior year, with adjusted profit per share increasing to $2.13 from $1.85. Looking ahead, Merck stands to benefit from greater Keytruda usage and strong demand for Gardasil. Recent acquisitions—Prometheus, Acceleron, and Imago—are expected to further support future growth. With a current valuation at about 12x forward earnings (below its five-year average of 13x), MRK stock could move higher. Peer and industry comparisons are available via Peer Comparisons and Trefis’s market-beating portfolios.

article_content: Pets are often cherished members of the family and receive extra attention and treats during Christmas. However, pet owners are advised to be cautious, as emergency veterinary bills for holiday-related accidents can total millions of pounds. In December of last year, insurers paid out £13 million for pet emergencies. The most frequent incidents involved pets eating dangerous items such as Christmas decorations or chocolates left around the house. Other hazards include burns from fairy lights, injuries from broken glass ornaments, and swallowing tinsel. Medical bills can reach £3,000 to remove swallowed items like plastic baubles, £1,200 for anesthesia to treat constipation from eating turkey bones, or £700 a day for treating chocolate poisoning. Tilly, a dog whose owners Lisa and Neil Hilder from Worthing, West Sussex, spent £2,000 on surgery after she swallowed a sharp piece of bone given as a present. X-rays revealed it was lodged inside her and required emergency surgery. Lisa recalled their worry, saying, 'It was quite nerve-racking and upsetting... We didn’t know whether she would pull through.' In other cases, such as with Milo, pets required endoscopy and several days of recovery at the PDSA PetAid hospital in Aston, Birmingham. Nurse Julie Everall explained that such incidents are common during Christmas. Sarah Davies from Swansea shared that her ten-year-old Labrador, Wise Guy, became ill after eating a tin of Quality Street chocolates, including the foil wrappers. Fortunately, he passed the items naturally, but chocolate can be very dangerous for dogs. Vet Brian Faulkner from Petplan said pets can't tell what is hazardous. Insurers often pay out for incidents involving pets eating ornaments or being burned by lights. He added that pets might also destroy Christmas trees if something interests them. An RSPCA spokeswoman reiterated that Christmas can be stressful and hazardous for pets. Items like chocolate, raisins, and turkey bones can be fatal, and decorations such as tinsel and baubles pose choking risks. Owners are urged to watch their pets closely during the holidays.

article_content: An investigation into the death of Pranav Madhaik, a Secondary 2 student-athlete at the Singapore Sports School, found that his badminton coach failed to check on his well-being before leaving the track—a safety lapse that contributed to the incident. The coach has been dismissed. Pranav, 14, was a member of the school's badminton academy and aspired to become an Olympic champion. He felt unwell after completing a 400m fitness time trial on October 5. At around 6:50 pm that day, the Singapore Civil Defence Force was called to the school for assistance. Pranav was taken to the National University Hospital. He died on Wednesday, October 11. In a press release, the Singapore Sports School detailed the timeline and investigation findings. Pranav reported to his coach that he felt unwell after his trial, and the coach advised him to rest at the side of the track, as Pranav had previously recovered after resting. While Pranav was resting at the starting point, the coach attended to time-trial data on his phone and then left to brief other student-athletes about competition matters, not realizing Pranav was still resting in the same spot. After the briefing, the coach left the school. According to the school, the coach should have checked on Pranav before leaving the track. Not accounting for all student-athletes before dismissing them is a breach of safety protocols. The Singapore Sports School stated: 'We take this matter seriously. The coach has been served a notice of dismissal.' The school is now reviewing and strengthening its safety protocols, emphasizing to coaches and staff the importance of strict adherence.

Rêberê wî ji kar kirinê hat derxistin. Pranav, ku 14 salî bû, endamê akademiya badmintonê ya dibistanê bû û xewna wî vê bû ku bibe şampiyona Olimpîkê. Ew di Çarşemê, 11ê Cotmehê mir. Di ragihandinekê de, Lîseya Werzîşê ya Singapore vê serdema bûyeran û belgeyên lêkolînê şirove kir. Dibistanê niha ser protokolan ewlehiyê xwe diçîne berçavkirin û bi hewlê zêdetir rêberan û karûbaran tê de girîngiya pevçûnê bi vê protokolan têye bal dan.

article_content: Fox News unveiled its revamped newsroom on Monday, showcasing the new Fox News Deck to both excitement and mockery online. Head anchor Shepard Smith led a video tour of the studio, which now includes rows of reporters seated at 55-inch Microsoft Perspective Pixel touchscreens—each retailing for $8,000—and an impressive 38-foot wraparound screen that can display Twitter feeds and other news sources. The screens run on Windows 8, and Smith highlighted that reporters (now referred to as 'information specialists') will use these 'Big Area Touchscreens' (BATs) to track developing stories and deliver news in real time. Fox says the overhaul was designed to attract 'cutting edge, nonlinear news consumers.' However, many internet users reacted with humor, dubbing the screens oversized and joking about the scale of the technology. Tweets from media outlets and individual users poked fun at the setup, calling the touchscreens 'gigantic iPads' and making light of the newsroom's futuristic look. The transformation coincides with Fox News' 17th anniversary and was completed while Smith was recovering from surgery. Smith now appears from the new News Deck whenever major stories break.

Ser-anchor Shepard Smith di videoyekê de rêberiya rêwîtiyekê da ku niha nav ser rêzên reportr, ku li ser touch-screenên hefteşeş-inch Microsoft Perspective Pixel dinivîsin—her yek ji bo $8,000 firotin—û ekraneke mezintir 38-foot ku kar dike ku twittêr û çavkaniyên din nîşan bide. article_content: Many people use their smartphones in the bathroom, but this habit could have negative health effects, warns Dr. Saurabh Sethi, a gastroenterologist with credentials from Stanford and Harvard. In a TikTok video, Dr. Sethi pointed out that scrolling through social media on the toilet might increase the risk of developing hemorrhoids, also known as piles. Dr. Krishnamohan Y, Clinical Director of Bariatric & GI Surgery at CARE Hospitals, explained that while using your phone on the toilet doesn’t directly cause hemorrhoids, it can contribute by making people spend more time sitting. This prolonged sitting can lead to or worsen hemorrhoids. Hemorrhoids are swollen veins in the rectal and anal areas that can lead to pain and bleeding, often triggered by increased pressure from straining, constipation, diarrhea, excess weight, or pregnancy. Dr. Krishnamohan notes several concerns with using a phone while on the toilet: - Extended sitting raises pressure on rectal veins, boosting the chance of hemorrhoids and possibly impacting overall digestive health. - Being preoccupied with your phone can result in spending more time on the toilet and possibly straining more, which heightens hemorrhoid risk and can disrupt normal bowel function. - Leaning forward or sitting with poor posture to view a phone may also put extra strain on the rectal region. Experts suggest limiting time on the toilet, maintaining good posture, avoiding strain, and following a fiber-rich diet with sufficient hydration to support digestive health and reduce hemorrhoid risk.

Di vîdeoyekî TikTokê de, Dr. Sethi hişyarî da ku ser şênmeye medyayên civakî di dema tuwaletê dikare xeternak be, bi taybetî li hemoroîd-an (pîl). Dr. Krishnamohan Y, Direktora Klinîkê Bariatric û GI Surgery li Nexweşxaneya CARE, daxuyaniya ku bi mobaylê li tuwaletê bi seretayî hemoroîd nake, lê ev kar dikare bibe derbasî demê rûniştinê yê dirêj, ku hemoroîd dikare erên bike an pîr bike. Hemoroîd-an/pîl-an venên kel in li nav xwarê qûl û entika, ku dikarin êş û xwînserbûnê bidin. Sebeban zêdeyî bi presê tê de têne çêkirin, wek hêrs lêdan di dema destnîşanê de, qebztî, şilîtî, giraniya jismî an jî dema duet de. Dr. Krishnamohan diyar dike: - Dema dirêj li ser tuwalet presê li venan zêde dike û riskê hemoroîd zêde dike; rayehatiya bêhareket jî şêweyên hazm zehmet dike. - Baweriya bi mobaylê de dikare derbas kirina demê tuwaletê zêde bike, ku dikare hêrs bêjin an rêgaçûnê nasazê bike, herwaha hemoroîdan zêde dike. - Hildankê nerewaz an rûniştina astengdar bo temaşayê mobayl dikare venan zêde ağır bike. Eksperan lêpirsîn ku demê tuwaletê kêm bike, hildana rast bigirin, hêrs nebin, û xwarinê bi fiwr bi avê zêde bixwin bo tenduristiya hazm û kêmtirkirina xavçûnê hemoroîd-an.

article_content: Diwali celebrations in 2023 begin with Dhanteras on November 10 and conclude with Bhai Dooj on November 15. During this period, bank branches in many locations across India will be closed on various days in November. According to the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) holiday schedule, most banks will be closed for a total of 15 days this month, which includes all Sundays as well as the second and fourth Saturdays. Bank holidays can differ from state to state. From November 11 to November 13, banks in Tripura, Uttarakhand, Sikkim, Manipur, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, and Maharashtra will remain closed due to the second Saturday, followed by Sunday and the celebration of Govardhan Pooja/Laxmi Puja (Deepawali)/Diwali on Monday. Banks in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, and Sikkim will be closed on Tuesday, November 14, for Diwali (Bali Pratipada)/Deepavali/Vikram Samvant New Year Day/Laxmi Puja. In Sikkim, banks will be closed for five consecutive days from Saturday, November 11 to Wednesday, November 15 due to festive holidays. Other notable bank holidays in November 2023 are: - November 15 (Wednesday): Bhaidooj/Chitragupt Jayanti/Laxmi Puja (Deepawali)/Ningol Chakkouba/Bhratridwitiya, with banks closed in Sikkim, Manipur, Uttar Pradesh, Bengal, and Himachal Pradesh. - November 20 (Monday): Chhath (Morning Arghya) in Bihar and Rajasthan. - November 23 (Thursday): Seng Kutsnem/Egaas-Bagwaal in Uttarakhand and Sikkim. - November 30 (Thursday): Kanakadasa Jayanthi in Karnataka. Bank holidays in November also include occasions such as Kannada Rajyothsava, Kut, Karva Chauth, Wangala Festival, Guru Nanak Jayanti, Karthika Purnima, and Rahas Purnima. In addition to physical bank closures, corporate India is celebrating Diwali by gifting employees—including third-party and blue-collar workers—items such as hampers, gadgets, and silver coins. There are also discussions about India's new data law that could limit companies’ use of customer data for cross-selling products and services. Internationally, Moody's has revised the outlook on the US credit rating from stable to negative due to large fiscal deficits and decreased debt affordability. This decision has drawn criticism from President Joe Biden's administration.

Sebastian Vettel moved closer to securing his third consecutive Formula 1 world title with a commanding victory at the Indian Grand Prix for Red Bull on Sunday. The 25-year-old German achieved his fourth straight race win of the season, marking the 26th victory of his career.

Ferrari's Fernando Alonso showcased his renowned resolve by finishing second, limiting his title race losses but still trailing Vettel by 13 points with just three races remaining. Mark Webber, Vettel's Red Bull teammate, managed to hold off a late charge from McLaren’s Lewis Hamilton to claim third position.

Attention remains fixed on the championship duel between Vettel and Alonso, both of whom recognize the high stakes in the final races. "Yes, maybe I have one hand on the trophy, if you say so, but on the other side, I think Fernando has one hand on it too!" Vettel remarked at the post-race media conference.

"It is not easy to fight Red Bull but we will never give up," said Alonso. "We lost points, but this is what we expected this weekend as we are not fast enough. Still, we minimized our losses and look forward to better races ahead."

Vettel led the race from pole position at the Buddh International Circuit, while Alonso advanced from fifth on the grid to third early on, overtaking both McLaren drivers—Hamilton and Jenson Button. Late technical issues for Webber allowed Alonso to seize second place, though he finished nearly ten seconds behind Vettel.

Button secured fifth place, with Ferrari’s Felipe Massa in sixth ahead of Kimi Raikkonen's Lotus. Nico Hulkenberg (Force India), Romain Grosjean (Lotus), and Bruno Senna (Williams) completed the points positions. Vettel now has 240 points, Alonso follows with 227, and Raikkonen is a distant third on 173. Red Bull holds a commanding 91-point lead over Ferrari in the constructors' standings, with McLaren another 10 points further behind.

Fernando Alonso ya Ferrariê bi xwebûn û têkoşînê xwe duwem qediya, xala winda kir, lê hê jî bi 13 xalan pişt ve Vettel digere—tenê sê yaryariya maye. Mark Webber, hevkarê Vettel li Red Bullê, di encama dawî da şikest dide xebata dawî ya Lewis Hamilton a McLarenê da pozîsyona sêyem bigire.

Bal herdu li ser serlêdana navbera Vettel û Alonso ye, û wan jî bizanin pirsgirêka hebe di yaryariya dawî de. "Erê, gavêkê min ser kom dê be, heger we wisa dibêjin, lê ha jî min wisa têhesib dike Fernando jî ser komê ye!" Vettel di konferansa medya ya pişt-yaryariya de got.

"Şikandina Red Bullê hêsan nîne, lê em qet dem nedin," Alonso got. "Xal winda kirin, lê vê hefteya em vê wisa xeyal kir, çimkî em ne zût bûn. Em dizanin qewet kêm kirin û hîn taybet dikin bo yaryariya baştirên bê.

Vettel di ser polê ji Buddh International Circuit de dest pê kir, dema ku Alonso ji pêncê şûnda bi ser hat û bi pêşveçûn bi ser hemî şofêranên McLarenî—Hamilton û Jenson Button—ket sêyem. Di dawiya yaryariya da pirsgirêka teknîkî yê Webber şans piştî da ku Alonso duwem bikeve, lê heta dawî de qasî 10 çirkan pişt Vettel bû.

Button pozîsyona pêncem ewledaye, Felipe Massa ya Ferrariê di şeşem de hat da Kimi Raikkonen a Lotusê piştre. Nico Hulkenberg (Force India), Romain Grosjean (Lotus), and Bruno Senna (Williams) jî xala winda kir.

Vettel niha 240 xala hene, Alonso 227 hene, û Raikkonen-sêyem, bi dûrî-yê zêde 173 xale. Red Bull bi 91 xal ser Ferrari serok e di qebûlkirina hêza afirandineyê de, dema ku McLaren jî 10 xal pişt re ye.

article_content: The President and Chairman of the Board of Directors of African Export-Import Bank, Prof. Benedict Okey Oramah; Chairman of SIFAX Group, Dr. Taiwo Afolabi; President Hakainde Hichilema of Zambia, and other leaders have been nominated for the 2021/2022 Zik Prize in Leadership Awards. In a statement signed by Prof. Pat Utomi, Head of the Selection Committee at the Public Policy Research and Analysis Centre (PPRAC), organizers of the award said it was established to recognize and encourage outstanding leadership on the African continent and in the diaspora. Founded in 1995 by PPRAC in honor of Nigeria's first president, Dr. Nnamdi Azikiwe, the Zik Prize in Leadership Awards ceremony will take place on Sunday, November 19, 2023, at the Eko Convention Centre in Lagos. According to PPRAC, 'The event is held annually, but was paused last year as a mark of respect following the passing of two Advisory Board members: Prince Emeka Obasi, former Executive Secretary, who died in March 2022, and Prof. George Obiozor, who passed away in December 2022. This edition therefore combines winners from both 2021 and 2022.'
translated_content: Serok û Serokê Lêkolîngehên Bankeya Export-Import Afrîkî, Prof. Benedict Okey Oramah; Serokê Komeleya SIFAX, Dr. Taiwo Afolabi; Serok Hakainde Hichilema ya Zambiya û rêberên din hatine aday kirin bo xelata Zik Prize in Leadership ji bo salên 2021/2022. Di danegehên ku Prof. Pat Utomi, Serokê Komîteya Hilbijartinê ya Navenda Lêkolîn û Şîroveya Polîtîkayê (PPRAC), nîşankir, rêvebirên vê xelatê gotin ew hate damezrandin bo nasîn û pêşvebirina rêberiya baş li ser kontinenta Afrîka û dijîspora. Xelata Zik, ku di 1995'an de ji hêla PPRAC ve hate damezrandin, bo bîranîna serokê yekem a NIgerîya, Dr. Nnamdi Azikiwe, seeremoniyê wê dê di Yekşemê, 19ê Mijdara 2023'an de li Navenda Eko Convention, Lagos, dê weqe. PPRAC got, 'Ev bûyer her sal tê lidarxistin, lê sala borî ji bo rêz kirinê ji mirina du endamên Desteya Rêveberê rawestî. Prince Emeka Obasi, Serokê Executive ya berê, ya ku di Adara 2022'an de mir, û Prof. George Obiozor, ku di Kanûna Pêşîn a 2022'an de mir. Ji ber vê yekê, vê edîsyon xelatkêşên 2021 û 2022 bi hev re tê pêşkêş kirin.'
post_content: Big names in African leadership, including Zambia's President and top execs, are up for the Zik Prize Awards 2021/2022! Ceremony lands Nov 19 in Lagos after a break last year. #ZikPrize #AfricanLeaders #Leadership

Makoto Shinkai’s acclaimed animated film "Suzume" will soon be available for exclusive streaming on Crunchyroll, offering audiences worldwide the chance to experience its captivating story. The movie’s streaming release is scheduled for November 16 at 5:00 p.m. PT and will be accessible in North America, Central and South America, Europe (excluding France), Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, and CIS territories.

Originally titled "Suzume no Tojimari" in Japan, the film received international recognition after its debut at the Berlin International Film Festival in February 2023, amassing about $300 million at the global box office. Japanese filmmaker Makoto Shinkai served as director and screenwriter, announcing the project on December 15, 2021, with its release in Japan on November 11, 2022. The creative team included Masayoshi Tanaka (Character Designer), Kenichi Tsuchiya (Animation Director), and Takumi Tanji (Art Director), with animation by CoMix Wave Films. "Suzume" is Shinkai’s 13th film as director, following renowned titles like "Weathering with You" (2019), "Your Name.", "The Garden of Words", "Children Who Chase Lost Voices", and "5 Centimeters per Second."

Crunchyroll collaborated with Sony Pictures and Wild Bunch International to manage the film’s global theatrical rollout in April 2023. The story is described as a coming-of-age journey spanning disaster-stricken locations in Japan, where the 17-year-old protagonist, Suzume, must locate and close mysterious portals unleashing devastation. Her adventure starts in Kyushu, southwestern Japan, upon meeting a mysterious young man searching for a door. Suzume discovers a lone, weathered door amid ruins, and when she opens it, disasters are triggered across Japan. Her mission becomes to close these doors and prevent further catastrophes.

Visual storytelling with celestial imagery supports themes of hope and resilience. Suzume’s journey across distinct landscapes and meaningful encounters provides inspiration to viewers confronting their own difficulties.
